AI.findings: 新银行对银行业联盟具有相关性，既带来创新和竞争益处，也带来监管、处置和制度设置方面的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了银行业联盟理论在金融科技背景下的应用，为新兴金融实体与现有监管框架的整合提供理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于如何将新银行纳入银行业联盟监管框架的实践建议，帮助监管机构应对金融创新带来的挑战。

title: Efficiency and Equity in an Experimental Repeated Entry Game
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Rady School of Management, INSEAD, Fundación Instituto de Empresa, S.L. - IE Business School and UCD, Michael Smurfit Graduate Business School

detail.title: Efficiency and Equity in an Experimental Repeated Entry Game

declarations.funderStatement: The study was funded by Grant PID2019-111512RBI00 from the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation and RMS Grant R21836 from the UCD College of Business.

detail.abstract: Motivated by the prevalence of competitive environments in which the same set of players face recurring entry decisions against one another, we experimentally study efficiency and equity in a repeated entry game. Analyzing 16,352 decisions from 511 subjects in 73 repeated entry games, we vary the prize structure (winner-take-all versus proportional), ability heterogeneity, the salience of performance feedback, and the availability of communication. Entry remains persistently above the efficient benchmark across all treatments, indicating that repetition alone does not eliminate it. A proportional prize lowers inequity but does not increase efficiency or reduce excess entry. Heterogeneous abilities improve efficiency but fail to reduce excess entry and worsen inequity. In contrast, providing a channel to communicate and salient feedback substantially reduces excess entry, improves efficiency, and produces more equitable outcomes. These joint gains arise because communication decreases the likelihood of momentum strategies, whereby early winners persistently re-enter, and facilitates coordinated turn-taking in which participants alternate entry over time. Our findings suggest that lightweight informational and communicative interventions can outperform structural incentive changes in improving long-run outcomes in repeated competitive environments.

AI.tldr: 实验研究重复进入博弈中的效率和公平问题，发现沟通和显性反馈能显著减少过度进入、提高效率并改善公平，而结构激励改变效果有限。
AI.research_question: 在重复竞争环境中，不同因素（奖金结构、能力异质性、反馈显著性、沟通机会）如何影响进入决策的效率与公平？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中常见同一组参与者在重复竞争中面对进入决策的情况，需要理解如何改善长期结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重复进入博弈理论、竞争环境中的协调与合作理论、行为经济学中的公平与效率权衡。
AI.method: 实验方法：收集511名被试在73个重复进入博弈中的16,352个决策，操纵四个因素（奖金结构、能力异质性、反馈显著性、沟通机会）。
AI.findings: 1) 进入持续高于效率基准；2) 比例奖金降低不公平但不提高效率；3) 能力异质性提高效率但加剧不公平；4) 沟通和显性反馈显著减少过度进入、提高效率并改善公平。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了重复竞争环境中协调机制的重要性，表明轻量级信息与沟通干预比结构激励改变更有效，提出了动量策略与轮流进入的协调机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者设计重复竞争环境提供了实用建议：优先考虑沟通渠道和绩效反馈机制，而非仅调整奖金结构或引入能力差异。

title: Market Entrance, Patents, and Preliminary Injunctions: A Model of Pharmaceutical Patent Litigation
affiliations: and Copenhagen Business School

detail.title: Market Entrance, Patents, and Preliminary Injunctions: A Model of Pharmaceutical Patent Litigation
detail.abstract: The Patent Holder wishing to enforce her patent has several ways of doing so. In the world of patent litigation, however, one of the most important remedies is the preliminary injunction (PI), whereby an allegedly infringing competitor is forced to stop selling the goods in the market in the interim period before the court reaches its final decision on the merits. In spite of this, the economic literature has afforded little attention to PIs. This article uses a simple economic model to investigate how a Patent Holder and an Alleged Infringer will behave with and without the PI instrument. We show that party behavior depends on the probability that the Patent Holder does indeed have a valid patent and will prevail in a final court decision and on the extent to which courts can determine damages correctly. We find that while patent rights benefit the Patent Holder, the PI instrument to a large extent benefits the Alleged Infringer. It does so by insuring him against large damages payments and allowing him to receive compensation for actions not taken, i.e. for not being on the market in the interim period before the final court decision. Finally, we discuss different decision rules a court could use to decide whether to grant a PI, and propose a decision rule whereby courts can take into account the social benefits or losses of an erroneous PI decision.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了专利诉讼中的临时禁令（PI）对专利持有者和被控侵权者行为的影响。研究发现，虽然专利权利有利于专利持有者，但临时禁令在很大程度上有利于被控侵权者，因为它为侵权者提供了保险，防止大额损害赔偿，并允许其获得因在最终判决前未进入市场而应得的补偿。
AI.research_question: 专利持有者和被控侵权者在有临时禁令和没有临时禁令的情况下会如何行为？临时禁令如何影响双方的利益分配？
AI.motivation: 临时禁令是专利诉讼中最重要的救济措施之一，但经济学文献对此关注不足。需要研究临时禁令对专利持有者和被控侵权者行为的影响，以及其对双方利益分配的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论和经济学模型，分析专利持有者和被控侵权者在有/无临时禁令情况下的策略选择。考虑专利有效性概率、法院正确确定损害赔偿的能力等因素。
AI.method: 使用简单的经济学模型来分析专利持有者和被控侵权者的行为。模型考虑了专利有效性概率、损害赔偿确定准确性等关键变量。
AI.findings: 1. 双方行为取决于专利持有者拥有有效专利并最终胜诉的概率，以及法院正确确定损害赔偿的能力。2. 专利权利有利于专利持有者，但临时禁令在很大程度上有利于被控侵权者。3. 临时禁令为被控侵权者提供保险，防止大额损害赔偿，并允许其获得因在最终判决前未进入市场而应得的补偿。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 填补了经济学文献对临时禁令研究的空白。2. 提出了分析临时禁令对专利诉讼双方行为影响的理论框架。3. 揭示了临时禁令在专利诉讼中利益分配的复杂作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法院提供了不同的决策规则来决定是否授予临时禁令。2. 提出了考虑错误临时禁令决策社会效益或损失的决策规则。3. 为专利持有者和被控侵权者提供了策略指导。

title: Does News Trading Crowd Out Value Trading? Evidence from a Structural Estimation
affiliations: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

detail.title: Does News Trading Crowd Out Value Trading? Evidence from a Structural Estimation

declarations.funderStatement: Albert is grateful for financial support from the Dutch Research Council (NWO) for grant number 016.Vici.185.068.

detail.abstract: Technology produces data streams at lower cost, which intensifies "news" trading. Does this trading on value changes crowd out trading on value levels, i.e., value trading? And, what is the net effect on liquidity and market efficiency? We propose a Kyle (1985)-type model to study these questions, both theoretically and empirically. The latter is possible, because closed-form solutions admit structural estimation. Implementing it on a 2013-2023 proprietary sample covering trades in the EURO STOXX 50 Index Futures reveals how liquidity, market efficiency, and the profit of both types of informed trading changed over time, and why.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了技术进步带来的低成本数据流如何加剧"新闻"交易，以及这种基于价值变化的交易是否会挤出基于价值水平的交易（价值交易），并分析其对流动性和市场效率的净影响。
AI.research_question: 1. 基于价值变化的交易（新闻交易）是否会挤出基于价值水平的交易（价值交易）？2. 这种交易行为变化对市场流动性和效率的净影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 技术进步降低了数据流的获取成本，这加剧了"新闻"交易。作者希望了解这种交易行为的变化如何影响市场结构，特别是价值交易是否被挤出，以及对市场质量和效率的最终影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kyle（1985）模型框架，构建理论模型来分析新闻交易和价值交易之间的相互作用及其对市场质量的影响。
AI.method: 采用理论建模与实证分析相结合的方法：1. 理论层面构建Kyle型模型；2. 实证层面利用闭式解进行结构估计；3. 使用2013-2023年EURO STOXX 50指数期货的专有交易数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 研究揭示了流动性、市场效率以及两类知情交易利润随时间的变化模式，并解释了这些变化的原因。具体发现包括新闻交易和价值交易之间的动态关系，以及它们对市场质量的综合影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了Kyle模型框架，将新闻交易和价值交易纳入统一分析；2. 提供了分析技术进步对交易行为影响的理论框架；3. 推导出可用于结构估计的闭式解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为市场参与者和监管者理解技术进步对市场结构的影响提供实证证据；2. 帮助投资者理解不同交易策略的盈利模式变化；3. 为市场设计和监管政策提供参考依据。

title: Using Patent Valuation Methods to Assess Damages in Patent Infringement cases Under the Unified Patent Court
affiliations: and University of Oxford

detail.title: Using Patent Valuation Methods to Assess Damages in Patent Infringement cases Under the Unified Patent Court
detail.abstract: We illustrate how publicly sanctioned IP valuation guidelines prevailing in Europe can be applied to assess damages as foreseen under the provisions of the UPC Agreement. With the help of a hypothetical example, we then evaluate if and to what extent the various ways proposed by European institutions to value IP fit with the provisions of the UPCA. We find that in situations where courts have all the necessary information required to determine damages, the IP valuation methods are a very useful tool in determining damages. It can however be expensive to obtain the necessary data to adequately determine damages.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧洲公开认可的IP估值指南如何应用于UPC协议下的损害赔偿评估，通过假设案例分析了欧洲机构提出的各种IP估值方法与UPCA条款的契合度，发现当法院拥有充分信息时，IP估值方法是确定损害赔偿的有用工具，但获取必要数据可能成本高昂。
AI.research_question: 欧洲公开认可的IP估值指南如何应用于UPC协议下的损害赔偿评估？欧洲机构提出的各种IP估值方法在多大程度上与UPCA条款相契合？
AI.motivation: 随着统一专利法院（UPC）的建立，需要明确IP估值方法在损害赔偿评估中的适用性，为法院提供实用的评估工具，同时识别实施中的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧洲IP估值指南框架、UPC协议（UPCA）的法律规定、损害赔偿评估理论，以及知识产权经济学理论。
AI.method: 采用理论分析与假设案例研究相结合的方法，通过构建假设情景来评估不同IP估值方法在UPCA框架下的适用性和局限性。
AI.findings: 当法院拥有确定损害赔偿所需的所有必要信息时，IP估值方法是非常有用的工具；然而，获取充分确定损害赔偿所需的必要数据可能成本高昂。
AI.theory_contributions: 将欧洲IP估值指南与UPC法律框架进行理论整合，为知识产权损害赔偿评估提供了跨学科的理论连接，丰富了IP估值在司法实践中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院和从业者提供了在UPC框架下应用IP估值指南的具体指导，识别了数据获取成本这一实际挑战，有助于提高损害赔偿评估的效率和准确性。

title: From Fiscal to Legal Fragmentation: Coherence Challenges in Global Trade Governance

detail.title: From Fiscal to Legal Fragmentation: Coherence Challenges in Global Trade Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest. The research was conducted independently and without any financial or institutional influence that could be perceived as affecting its objectivity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based solely on doctrinal and comparative legal analysis of publicly available sources. No human participants, personal data, or confidential materials were involved. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Tax havens exemplify the structural vulnerabilities of the international commercial order. They reveal how the nonapplication of coherent regulatory mechanisms between tax, trade and regulatory regimes has led to the existing state of affairs of fiscal sovereignty and global interdependence as they currently exist. This article argues that the existence of tax havens is not a mere fiscal anomaly, but rather the symptom of a deeper crisis of law and institutions in the fragmentation of international trade governance. By linking fiscal fragmentation with the legal fragmentation of law, the paper shows how the same forces which have brought about offshore financial regimes regulatory competition, insecure enforcement, and asymmetrical institutional power now return in the governance of digital and sustainable trade. Through a doctrinal and comparative analysis of regimes of tax, trade and environmental law, the paper identifies a parallel between the collapse of coherence of global tax law and the growing divergence between the WTO and the EU. It is concluded that in viewing tax havens as an early warning of systemic incoherence, the potential to inform the design of a new Legal Alignment Model for the reconciliation of multilateral and regional norms of trade law. The paper thus offers a new view of coherence as a preventive principle in international economic law.

AI.tldr: 本文认为避税天堂并非单纯的财政异常，而是国际贸易治理碎片化中法律与制度深层危机的症状。通过分析税收、贸易和环境法律体系，文章揭示了全球税法一致性崩溃与WTO-EU分歧之间的平行关系，提出将一致性作为国际经济法的预防性原则。
AI.research_question: 避税天堂如何反映国际贸易治理的碎片化危机？这种碎片化如何影响数字和可持续贸易治理？如何通过法律一致性原则解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 避税天堂暴露了国际商业秩序的结构性脆弱性，揭示了税收、贸易和监管机制之间缺乏一致性监管的问题。这种碎片化不仅影响财政主权和全球相互依存，还在数字和可持续贸易治理中重现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律碎片化理论、国际治理一致性理论、监管竞争理论、制度权力不对称理论
AI.method: 教义分析和比较分析方法，分析税收、贸易和环境法律体系，比较WTO和欧盟的制度差异
AI.findings: 1. 避税天堂是法律与制度深层危机的症状而非原因；2. 导致离岸金融制度的监管竞争、执行不力和制度权力不对称在数字和可持续贸易治理中重现；3. 全球税法一致性崩溃与WTO-EU分歧之间存在平行关系
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出将一致性作为国际经济法的预防性原则；2. 建立"法律协调模型"用于调和多边与区域贸易规范；3. 将避税天堂视为系统性不一致的早期预警信号
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供设计新法律协调框架的理论基础，帮助解决国际贸易治理中的碎片化问题，特别是在数字和可持续贸易领域

title: Estimating Euler Equations with Measurement Error: A Nonparametric Approach
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Estimating Euler Equations with Measurement Error: A Nonparametric Approach
detail.abstract: This paper proposes two new identification schemes for estimating the parameter of intertemporal allocation, exploiting the equilibrium condition delivered by the rational expectations consumption model. The two identification schemes constitute an alternative to the existing methods of estimating Euler equations in the presence of measurement error. The small sample performance of the proposed identification schemes as well as that of existing approaches are evaluated by way of a MonteCarlo experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种新的识别方案来估计跨期分配参数，利用理性预期消费模型提供的均衡条件。这些方案为存在测量误差时估计欧拉方程提供了替代方法，并通过蒙特卡洛实验评估了其小样本性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在存在测量误差的情况下，更有效地识别和估计理性预期消费模型中的跨期分配参数？
AI.motivation: 现有估计欧拉方程的方法在存在测量误差时存在问题，需要开发更稳健的识别方案来提高参数估计的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期消费模型，跨期分配理论，欧拉方程，测量误差问题
AI.method: 提出两种新的识别方案，利用均衡条件进行参数识别；通过蒙特卡洛实验评估新方案和现有方法的小样本性能
AI.findings: 通过蒙特卡洛实验验证了所提识别方案在存在测量误差情况下的性能表现，并与现有方法进行比较
AI.theory_contributions: 为理性预期消费模型中的参数识别提供了新的理论框架，特别是在处理测量误差方面做出了贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究中存在测量误差时的参数估计提供了更可靠的替代方法，提高了估计结果的准确性

title: Mergers and R&D Investment: A Unified Approach
affiliations: VU University Amsterdam and VU University Amsterdam - Department of Economics

detail.title: Mergers and R&D Investment: A Unified Approach
detail.abstract: We investigate the impact of mergers on R&D incentives within a framework of R&D competition where effort can influence both the probability of innovation and the payoff conditional on success. Our framework nests the results of two classes of existing models and reveals assumptions that are restrictive. In models where R&D effort increases the probability of innovation but does not directly affect the payoff upon success, we show that the assumption of zero payoff upon innovation failure is restrictive. In models where R&D effort influences the payoff conditional on success, but not the probability of success itself, the assumption of deterministic innovation success (i.e., a success probability of one) is similarly restrictive. Across both modeling approaches, we offer a novel insight: the shape of investment costs, and by implication the pre-merger level of innovation, can be pivotal in determining whether a merger strengthens or weakens firms' incentives to invest in R&D. In an extensions section, we further examine the role of R&D input and output synergies, firm asymmetries, as well as the implications for consumer surplus.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了并购对研发激励的影响，提出了一个统一的框架来整合现有两类模型，并揭示了这些模型的限制性假设。研究发现，投资成本曲线的形状和并购前的创新水平是决定并购增强还是削弱研发激励的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 并购如何影响企业在研发竞争中的创新激励？
AI.motivation: 现有关于并购对研发激励影响的文献存在两类模型，但它们都基于限制性假设。需要建立一个更一般的框架来理解并购对研发激励的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研发竞争框架，其中研发努力可以同时影响创新成功的概率和成功后的收益。该框架整合了现有两类模型：1）研发努力只影响成功概率的模型；2）研发努力只影响成功收益的模型。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建一个统一的研发竞争框架来分析并购对研发激励的影响。通过模型推导和比较静态分析来检验不同假设下的结果。
AI.findings: 1）现有两类模型都基于限制性假设：第一类假设失败时收益为零，第二类假设成功概率为1；2）投资成本曲线的形状和并购前的创新水平是决定并购增强还是削弱研发激励的关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一个统一的框架来整合现有两类研发竞争模型；2）揭示了现有模型的限制性假设；3）发现了投资成本曲线形状对并购激励效应的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业管理者提供了更准确的工具来评估并购对创新激励的影响，特别是在考虑研发投入和产出协同效应、企业不对称性以及消费者福利时。

title: Sticking to Their Guns: Short-Horizon Exchange Rate Expectations
affiliations: University of Washington and London School of Economics

detail.title: Sticking to Their Guns: Short-Horizon Exchange Rate Expectations
detail.abstract: Short-horizon exchange rate forecasts systematically (and incorrectly) predict a partial reversal of their previous errors, both in consensus measures and forecaster-by-forecaster. This simple pattern spans almost 40% of the total variation in individual forecasts and explains their poor predictive performance at short horizons. We decompose short-term forecasts into three distinct components: (i) a component aligned with long-term forecasts, (ii) a component loading on the past error, and (iii) a residual component. The first two components account for three-quarters of forecast variance and--individually and jointly--predict exchange rate realizations. However, the second component predicts with a negative sign, offsetting the strong performance of the first component in the overall forecast.

AI.tldr: 短期汇率预测存在系统性错误：预测者倾向于部分修正前一期预测误差，但这种修正方向错误，导致短期预测表现不佳。研究发现短期预测可分解为三个部分，其中两个主要部分（与长期预测一致的部分和基于过去误差的部分）虽然能预测汇率实现，但基于过去误差的部分预测符号为负，抵消了另一部分的正面贡献。
AI.research_question: 短期汇率预测为何表现不佳？预测者如何系统性修正前一期预测误差？短期预测的构成成分及其对预测准确性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 短期汇率预测在实证中表现不佳，预测者似乎存在系统性偏差。理解这种偏差的机制和构成，有助于改进预测模型和解释预测失败的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的预测偏差理论，特别是锚定与调整启发式；汇率预测的分解框架；预测误差修正模式分析。
AI.method: 实证分析：使用共识预测和个体预测数据；方差分解方法；将短期预测分解为三个组成部分：与长期预测一致的部分、基于过去误差的部分、残差部分；回归分析检验各成分的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. 短期汇率预测存在系统性模式：预测者倾向于部分修正前一期预测误差，但修正方向错误；2. 这种模式解释了约40%的个体预测变异；3. 短期预测可分解为三个部分，前两个部分解释了75%的预测方差；4. 两个主要部分都能预测汇率实现，但基于过去误差的部分预测符号为负，抵消了另一部分的正面贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了短期汇率预测的系统性偏差模式；2. 提出了短期预测的三成分分解框架；3. 解释了为何短期预测表现不佳：预测者对过去误差的修正方向错误；4. 为行为金融学中的预测偏差提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为汇率预测者提供了改进预测方法的洞见；2. 帮助投资者理解专业预测的局限性；3. 为风险管理提供参考：短期预测可能存在系统性偏差；4. 为政策制定者评估市场预期提供分析框架。

title: In Search of Sparsity: Bayesian Sparse Factor Models and the Factor Zoo
affiliations: Government of Canada - Bank of Canada, CUNEF Universidad and Indiana University - Kelley School of Business

detail.title: In Search of Sparsity: Bayesian Sparse Factor Models and the Factor Zoo
detail.abstract: We develop a Bayesian Sparse Factor Model for asset pricing in factor zoo environments with correlated and weak factors. Observed factors are modeled as noisy measurements of latent priced risks, with hierarchical spike-and-slab priors on loadings to induce sparsity and quantify uncertainty about the factor structure. We embed the extracted factors in a Bayesian two-pass pricing framework that delivers inference on risk premia, pricing errors, and the implied stochastic discount factor (SDF). Empirically, three sparse latent factors summarize the zoo, remain competitive on the BHJ benchmark test sets, and produce tighter posteriors and a more stable SDF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯稀疏因子模型，用于处理因子动物园环境中相关且弱因子的资产定价问题。模型将观测因子视为潜在定价风险的有噪声测量，使用分层尖峰-平板先验实现稀疏性并量化因子结构的不确定性。通过贝叶斯两阶段定价框架，提供风险溢价、定价误差和隐含随机贴现因子的推断。
AI.research_question: 如何在因子动物园环境中，处理相关且弱的因子，准确提取稀疏的潜在定价风险因子，并进行可靠的资产定价推断？
AI.motivation: 资产定价领域存在大量候选因子（因子动物园），这些因子往往相关且信号较弱，传统方法难以有效区分真正定价因子与虚假因子，导致过拟合和推断不可靠。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯稀疏因子模型框架，将观测因子视为潜在定价风险的有噪声测量；分层尖峰-平板先验用于实现稀疏性；贝叶斯两阶段定价框架用于风险溢价推断。
AI.method: 开发贝叶斯稀疏因子模型，使用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法进行后验推断；将提取的因子嵌入贝叶斯两阶段定价框架；实证分析使用BHJ基准测试集进行评估。
AI.findings: 实证结果显示，三个稀疏潜在因子能够有效总结因子动物园；在BHJ基准测试集上保持竞争力；产生更紧密的后验分布和更稳定的随机贴现因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出处理因子动物园中相关弱因子的贝叶斯稀疏因子模型；开发分层尖峰-平板先验量化因子结构不确定性；建立贝叶斯两阶段定价框架进行综合推断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供处理因子动物园的实用工具；产生更可靠的定价推断；识别真正重要的定价因子；改善投资组合构建和风险管理决策。

title: European Union's AI Act: Protecting the Public at the Cost of Innovation?
affiliations: Universidad de Chile, Arizona State University and

detail.title: European Union's AI Act: Protecting the Public at the Cost of Innovation?
detail.abstract: The Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) was adopted by the European Union (EU) in 2024, marking the first major regulation on AI. In this study, we analyze market reactions to cost-increasing and cost-decreasing events that preceded the Act's adoption, where cost-increasing (decreasing) events denote stricter (more lenient) regulation of AI but higher (lower) potential public trust benefits. We also investigate how country-level AI features and company characteristics moderate market reactions to these events. We find that the EU-wide market reaction to cost-increasing events is significantly negative and more pronounced in EU jurisdictions with high AI investment. Company-specific factors also moderate the market response. Larger companies experience positive abnormal returns on cost-increasing events, raising concerns that smaller firms may face a disproportionate regulatory burden (limiting competition for large companies). R&D spending is negatively associated with abnormal returns for cost-increasing events, particularly among companies operating in jurisdictions with high AI investment and industries expected to be affected by the regulation. These results suggest that EU investors expect higher costs and slower innovation following the AI Act. Rather than enhancing EU firms' competitive edge, the Act could widen the gap between the EU and its global AI competitors. This study is the first to examine market reactions to the AI Act, a landmark AI regulation.

AI.tldr: 欧盟AI法案通过前，市场对成本增加事件（更严格监管）反应负面，尤其在高AI投资地区；大公司受益而小公司承压，研发支出与异常回报负相关，显示投资者预期法案将增加成本、减缓创新，可能扩大欧盟与全球AI竞争者差距。
AI.research_question: 欧盟AI法案通过前，市场对成本增加和成本减少事件的反应如何？国家层面的AI特征和公司特征如何调节这些市场反应？
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案是首个主要AI法规，研究市场反应有助于理解投资者对AI监管的预期，评估法案对欧盟AI产业竞争力的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于事件研究法分析市场反应，结合监管成本理论（成本增加vs成本减少事件），考察国家层面AI投资特征和公司特征（规模、研发支出）的调节作用。
AI.method: 采用事件研究法分析欧盟AI法案通过前的市场反应，区分成本增加事件（更严格监管）和成本减少事件（更宽松监管），检验国家AI投资水平和公司特征的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1）欧盟市场对成本增加事件反应显著负面，在高AI投资地区更明显；2）大公司在成本增加事件中获得正异常回报，小公司可能面临不成比例的监管负担；3）研发支出与成本增加事件的异常回报负相关，尤其在高AI投资地区和受监管影响行业。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证检验AI监管的市场反应，扩展了监管经济学在AI领域的应用，揭示了AI监管对不同规模公司和研发密集企业的差异化影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据：AI法案可能加剧大公司优势、抑制创新，不利于欧盟AI产业竞争力；为企业提供战略参考，特别是小公司和研发密集型企业需应对监管挑战。

title: Atemporal Structure of Monetary Units
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Atemporal Structure of Monetary Units
detail.abstract:
This study theoretically investigates the structural tension inherent in the functional definition of classical money under conditions of dynamic economic growth. Mainstream economics assumes that money simultaneously and perfectly performs its three functions — measure of value, medium of exchange, and store of value — but this paper argues that such a configuration constitutes a special solution that is only valid in a static model with fixed total factor productivity.

The object of this inquiry is not the practical efficiency of money's actual operation, but a more fundamental question: when economic theory presupposes the monetary unit as a 'time-invariant scalar,' can the formal conditions for that presupposition hold in a dynamic economy? This study argues that the essence of the problem lies in a structure in which no temporal dimension is embedded within the monetary unit — what this paper terms the 'Absence of a Temporal Axis.'

To this end, money is redefined as a 'future claim for intertemporal exchange,' and Lancaster's (1966) characteristics theory is extended to model the qualitative heterogeneity of goods as a vector z(t). The valuation function V(z(t)) = P(t) is axiomatically defined. After explicitly establishing the normative condition for the measure-of-value function — the condition that nominal prices must be monotonically proportional to productivity — this study mathematically proves that the store-of-value function and the measure-of-value function of money are necessarily in a trade-off relationship in an economy where productivity continuously improves through technological progress.

This trade-off is the logical consequence of the scalar structure in which the monetary unit does not embed a temporal dimension. In conclusion, this study argues that this structural tension is a theoretical necessity that holds in any dynamic economy in general, not a flaw of a specific institutional arrangement, and proposes the possibility of a new theory of monetary units that internalizes a temporal axis as a theoretical agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文理论分析了动态经济增长条件下古典货币功能定义的结构性张力。主流经济学假设货币同时完美执行价值尺度、交换媒介和价值贮藏三大功能，但本文认为这种配置仅在静态模型中成立。通过将货币重新定义为"跨期交换的未来索取权"，并扩展兰卡斯特特征理论，本文数学证明在技术持续进步的经济中，货币的价值贮藏功能与价值尺度功能必然存在权衡关系，这是货币单位缺乏时间维度的逻辑结果。
AI.research_question: 当经济理论预设货币单位为"时间不变标量"时，这种预设的形式条件在动态经济中能否成立？货币的三大功能（价值尺度、交换媒介、价值贮藏）在动态经济增长条件下是否存在结构性张力？
AI.motivation: 主流经济学假设货币同时完美执行三大功能，但这种配置仅在静态模型（固定全要素生产率）中成立。本文关注更根本的问题：货币单位作为"时间不变标量"的预设条件在动态经济中是否成立，以及货币功能之间的结构性张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 古典货币功能理论（价值尺度、交换媒介、价值贮藏）；2. 兰卡斯特（1966）特征理论扩展，将商品质量异质性建模为向量z(t)；3. 货币重新定义为"跨期交换的未来索取权"；4. 价值函数V(z(t)) = P(t)的公理化定义；5. 货币单位缺乏时间维度的"时间轴缺失"概念。
AI.method: 理论分析方法：1. 重新定义货币概念；2. 扩展兰卡斯特特征理论，建立商品质量异质性的动态模型；3. 公理化定义价值函数；4. 建立价值尺度功能的规范条件（名义价格必须与生产率单调正比）；5. 数学证明在技术持续进步的经济中，货币的价值贮藏功能与价值尺度功能必然存在权衡关系。
AI.findings: 1. 在动态经济（技术持续进步）中，货币的价值贮藏功能与价值尺度功能必然存在权衡关系；2. 这种权衡是货币单位缺乏时间维度的逻辑结果；3. 货币三大功能同时完美执行仅在静态经济中成立；4. 结构性张力是任何动态经济的理论必然，而非特定制度安排的缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了古典货币功能理论在动态经济中的内在矛盾；2. 提出了"时间轴缺失"的概念框架；3. 数学证明了货币功能间的必然权衡关系；4. 为包含时间维度的新货币单位理论提供了理论基础；5. 挑战了主流经济学关于货币功能完美兼容的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解现实经济中货币政策的局限性提供理论依据；2. 揭示了通货膨胀与经济增长之间的深层理论联系；3. 为设计更适应动态经济的货币制度提供理论指导；4. 为中央银行政策制定提供新的分析框架；5. 提出了包含时间维度的新货币单位理论的研究议程。

title: Litigating Human Rights Harm in Global Value Chains: Evolving Pathways to Corporate Accountability
affiliations: University of Essex School of Law and Human Rights Centre and Independent

detail.title: Litigating Human Rights Harm in Global Value Chains: Evolving Pathways to Corporate Accountability
detail.abstract: Litigation seeking corporate accountability for human rights harms has mostly targeted parent companies for adverse impacts by their subsidiaries. Although human rights abuses in global value chains (GVCs) have long been on the business and human rights agenda, legal action has focused mainly on parentsubsidiary relationships rather than buyer-supplier dynamics. Despite obstacles to establishing parent company liability, this route has proven more viable due to closer relationships within corporate groups. By contrast, the ostensibly arm's-length, transactional nature of GVC relations has fostered reluctance to hold buyers liable for harms arising from their suppliers' operations, even when the former exert significant influence or leverage over the latter. Nonetheless, principles from parent-subsidiary litigation have created new possibilities for GVC litigation, which are now being tested before courts. This chapter explores the potential and limits of litigation for corporate accountability in GVCs. It traces this litigation trend in business and human rights, surveying key causes of action in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, and France. It evaluates the impact of human rights due diligence legislationespecially the French Law on the Corporate Duty of Vigilance-on future GVC claims.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了全球价值链中企业人权责任的诉讼可能性与限制，分析了从母公司-子公司诉讼到买方-供应商诉讼的发展趋势，并评估了人权尽职调查立法对全球价值链诉讼的影响。
AI.research_question: 全球价值链中企业人权责任的诉讼可能性与限制是什么？如何从母公司-子公司诉讼经验中发展出适用于买方-供应商关系的诉讼策略？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，企业人权诉讼主要针对母公司对子公司行为的责任，而全球价值链中的买方-供应商关系虽然存在类似的人权侵害问题，却因"保持距离"的交易性质而难以追究买方责任。然而，母公司责任诉讼的原则为全球价值链诉讼创造了新的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业人权责任理论、全球价值链治理理论、母公司责任原则、人权尽职调查理论、跨国企业责任框架
AI.method: 比较法分析：调查美国、加拿大、英国、德国和法国的关键诉讼案由；趋势分析：追踪企业人权诉讼的发展趋势；立法评估：分析法国《企业警戒义务法》等人权尽职调查立法对未来全球价值链诉讼的影响
AI.findings: 1. 母公司-子公司诉讼已建立相对成熟的追责路径；2. 全球价值链中的买方-供应商诉讼面临更多障碍，但正在测试新的可能性；3. 人权尽职调查立法（特别是法国警戒义务法）可能显著改变全球价值链诉讼格局；4. 不同法域的诉讼策略存在差异
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将母公司责任原则扩展到全球价值链关系；2. 构建买方在供应链中的人权责任理论框架；3. 分析人权尽职调查立法对诉讼策略的理论影响；4. 发展跨国企业责任的新理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为全球价值链人权诉讼提供实践指导；2. 帮助企业了解不同法域的诉讼风险；3. 为立法者完善人权尽职调查制度提供参考；4. 为维权组织设计诉讼策略提供框架

title: Credit Growth and GDP Growth: A Cross-Country Measurement of Co-Movement

detail.title: Credit Growth and GDP Growth: A Cross-Country Measurement of Co-Movement
detail.abstract: How does credit growth co-move with GDP growth across countries and time horizons? This paper constructs a country-by-year panel of the credit-GDP co-movement ratio ω = Δlog(Y)/Δlog(M) for 43 countries over up to 79 years using BIS Total Credit Statistics. Two measurement contributions emerge. First, credit-GDP co-movement exhibits a frequency gradient: the Jordà LP coefficient rises from 0.54 (annual) to 0.83 (10-year), and from 0.19 to 0.47 in CPI-deflated real terms. The gradient survives wild cluster bootstrap inference and is not an artifact of co-trending. Second, crosscountry dispersion in ω far exceeds what independent or cointegrated trending would produce (empirical SD = 0.39 vs. mixed-null SD = 0.20, p < 0.001), revealing genuine heterogeneity in how economies convert credit into output. Advanced economies show particularly low annual co-movement (mean 0.13), consistent with large non-GDP credit sectors. A pre-/post-1971 regime difference (nominal Δω =-0.52) vanishes entirely under CPI deflation (Δω_real =-0.03, p = 0.80), indicating an inflation-regime effect rather than a structural change. The co-movement ratio ω carries no structural or causal interpretation; it is a descriptive statistic that complements the credit-to-GDP ratio by capturing growth-rate dynamics invisible in levels.

AI.tldr: 本文使用BIS总信贷统计数据，构建了43个国家长达79年的信贷-GDP联动比率ω=Δlog(Y)/Δlog(M)的面板数据，发现信贷与GDP联动存在频率梯度（长期联动更强），且跨国异质性远超趋势模型预测，揭示了经济体将信贷转化为产出的真实差异。
AI.research_question: 信贷增长与GDP增长在不同国家和时间维度上如何联动？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注信贷-GDP比率水平，但缺乏对信贷与GDP增长率动态关系的系统性分析，需要探索信贷转化为产出的实际效率及其跨国异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷与经济增长关系的理论框架，但强调ω比率是描述性统计量而非结构性或因果性指标，是对信贷-GDP比率水平的补充。
AI.method: 使用BIS总信贷统计数据，构建43个国家长达79年的面板数据，计算信贷-GDP联动比率ω=Δlog(Y)/Δlog(M)，采用Jordà局部投影系数分析不同时间维度（从年度到10年期）的联动变化，并进行wild cluster bootstrap推断检验。
AI.findings: 1. 信贷-GDP联动存在频率梯度：名义联动从0.54（年度）升至0.83（10年期），实际联动从0.19升至0.47；2. 跨国异质性远超独立或协整趋势模型预测（实际标准差0.39 vs 混合零假设0.20）；3. 发达经济体年度联动较低（平均0.13）；4. 1971年前后名义联动差异（Δω=-0.52）在CPI平减后消失（Δω_real=-0.03），表明是通胀体制效应而非结构性变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出信贷-GDP联动比率ω作为描述信贷与GDP增长率动态关系的新统计量；2. 揭示了信贷-GDP联动的频率梯度现象；3. 证明了经济体将信贷转化为产出的效率存在真实跨国异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了评估信贷增长对经济增长实际影响的描述性工具；2. 帮助识别不同经济体制下信贷传导效率的差异；3. 区分了通胀体制效应与结构性变化对信贷-GDP关系的影响。

title: Predicting Stock Market Crashes through Structural Properties of News: An Unsupervised Approach Beyond Sentiment Analysis

detail.title: Predicting Stock Market Crashes through Structural Properties of News: An Unsupervised Approach Beyond Sentiment Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research was conducted independently with no commercial or financial relationships that could be perceived as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available market data (Yahoo Finance) and news metadata (BigKinds). No human participants were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted using consumer hardware (NVIDIA RTX 4060 Ti) and publicly available data. Total cost including LLM API fees: approximately $6.

detail.abstract: We present a novel framework for predicting stock market crashes by analyzing structural properties of news articles rather than their sentiment. Our core hypothesis is that seemingly unrelated events accumulate structural characteristics such as information asymmetry, policy-reality gaps, and structural instability propagation that reach critical thresholds before market crashes. Using 20 years of KOSPI (Korea Composite Stock Price Index) data and 46.5 million news articles from the BigKinds database, we construct an end-to-end pipeline that: (1) extracts structural properties from news through unsupervised LLM-based generation with strict zero-bias protocols, (2) identifies statistically significant pre-crash patterns via temporal frequency analysis with FDR correction, and (3) builds a weighted risk scoring model. Our model achieves a test AUC of 0.907 with perfect precision (1.0) and 57.8% recall at zero false positive rate, notably outperforming its training-period performance (AUC 0.69), suggesting that structural patterns have become more pronounced in recent years. Further trajectory-based clustering analysis reveals two distinct crash types: structurally accumulated crashes (70/141, 49.6%) that the model can detect, and non-structural external shock crashes that are inherently unpredictable from news structure alone. This distinction itself constitutes a methodological contribution, refining the boundary of what news-based crash prediction can and cannot achieve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过分析新闻文章结构特性而非情感来预测股市崩盘的新框架。研究发现，看似无关的事件会积累信息不对称、政策-现实差距和结构不稳定传播等结构特征，这些特征在崩盘前达到临界阈值。基于20年KOSPI数据和4650万篇新闻文章，模型在测试集上AUC达到0.907，完美精度1.0，零假阳性率下召回率57.8%。研究还识别出两种崩盘类型：结构积累型崩盘（可预测）和非结构外部冲击型崩盘（不可预测）。
AI.research_question: 如何通过分析新闻文章的结构特性而非情感来预测股市崩盘？新闻文章的结构特征（如信息不对称、政策-现实差距、结构不稳定传播）是否能在市场崩盘前达到可检测的临界阈值？
AI.motivation: 传统基于情感分析的股市预测方法存在局限性，本文认为新闻的结构特性可能包含更重要的崩盘预警信号。看似无关的事件可能积累结构特征，最终导致市场崩溃，这一假设尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 结构特性理论：信息不对称、政策-现实差距、结构不稳定传播等结构特征积累达到临界阈值；2. 崩盘类型学：结构积累型崩盘 vs. 非结构外部冲击型崩盘；3. 新闻结构可预测性边界理论
AI.method: 1. 使用20年KOSPI数据和4650万篇BigKinds新闻文章；2. 无监督LLM生成结构特性提取，采用严格零偏差协议；3. 时间频率分析结合FDR校正识别统计显著崩盘前模式；4. 构建加权风险评分模型；5. 轨迹聚类分析识别崩盘类型
AI.findings: 1. 模型测试AUC 0.907，完美精度1.0，零假阳性率下召回率57.8%；2. 测试性能显著优于训练期（AUC 0.69），表明结构模式近年更加明显；3. 识别两种崩盘类型：结构积累型（49.6%，可预测）和非结构外部冲击型（不可预测）
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出新闻结构特性预测崩盘的新理论框架；2. 建立崩盘类型学，区分可预测和不可预测崩盘；3. 明确新闻结构分析在崩盘预测中的能力边界；4. 验证结构特征临界阈值理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发端到端崩盘预测管道，AUC达0.907；2. 提供可操作的风险评分模型；3. 帮助投资者识别可预测崩盘类型；4. 为监管机构提供早期预警系统；5. 模型在近期数据上表现更好，具有实际应用价值

title: Why Martingales Cannot Predict Markets -And What Riemannian Geometry Can Do Instead
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Why Martingales Cannot Predict Markets -And What Riemannian Geometry Can Do Instead

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Evangelos Papadopoulos, is the Lead Architect of the Universe Risk Framework (URF) and holds an affiliation with TRIDENT-AI Research. This research was conducted as part of the foundational development of the EconoSymographe. The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research does not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive personal data. The study is based entirely on publicly available financial market data (GICS sectors, commodity indices, and macroeconomic indicators) and does not require institutional ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: The author is the primary developer of the EconoSymographe and the Universe Risk Framework (URF) discussed in this paper. While this work represents independent scientific research on Riemannian manifolds and financial price formation, the concepts and methodologies described (including the Two-Price Theory and Residual Stress indicators) are the intellectual property of the author and TRIDENT-AI Research. No external funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract:
Financial markets have traditionally relied on a single observable: the spot price. Yet spot prices are noisy, regime-dependent, and statistically unstable, making them extremely difficult to model within classical stochastic frameworks. 

This paper introduces a second, structurally determined fundamental: the geometric price, defined by the geodesic trajectory of the covariance manifold Sym + (17). This high-dimensional representation integrates the 11 GICS sectors, Gold, Crude Oil, the VIX, and key macroeconomic indicators. 

Unlike the spot price, the geometric price is neither an average nor a smoothed estimate; it is the deterministic equilibrium path dictated by the intrinsic curvature of the market. We establish the Two-Price Theory of Markets, wherein price dynamics arise from the interaction between the observable spot projection and the underlying geometric necessity. Their divergence defines Residual Stress, a measurable physical quantity that captures the tension between observed and structural states. Residual Stress admits a natural theoretical classification into compression, rupture, and suture regimes. 

While URF-3 provides the full geometric model for these regimes, their empirical computation requires complete spot-geodesic trajectories and will be delivered through the Econosysmographe as a Premium diagnostic module. Our empirical evaluation, based on a seven-window walk-forward audit using eight years of data (2018-2025), demonstrates strong structural congruence between spot and geometric prices. Sector ETFs, Gold, and long-duration Treasuries exhibit high directional accuracy (86-99%) and stable geometric inertia. Volatile assets such as Crude Oil and the VIX display curvature-breaking behavior, consistent with the theoretical predictions of the Two-Price framework. 

These findings challenge the Martingale paradigm by revealing that price formation is governed by deterministic geometric forces encoded in the covariance structure. URF-3 provides the foundational metrology for a new financial infrastructure and prepares the transition to URF-4, where the manifold acquires a Lorentzian signature, introducing causal structure and finite propagation speed into price dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了金融市场双价格理论，引入几何价格作为结构性基本面，与观测到的现货价格相互作用形成价格动态。几何价格由协方差流形的测地线轨迹定义，捕捉市场内在曲率。两者的差异定义为残余应力，可分类为压缩、破裂和缝合三种状态。实证研究显示几何价格与现货价格具有高度结构一致性，挑战了传统的鞅范式。
AI.research_question: 金融市场价格形成是否由确定性几何力量而非随机过程主导？如何通过协方差流形的几何结构来理解价格动态？
AI.motivation: 传统金融市场仅依赖现货价格这一单一观测变量，但现货价格具有噪声大、制度依赖性强、统计不稳定等缺陷，难以在经典随机框架内建模。需要引入结构性基本面来更好地理解价格形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双价格市场理论：价格动态源于可观测的现货投影与底层几何必要性之间的相互作用。几何价格由协方差流形Sym+(17)的测地线轨迹定义。残余应力理论：现货价格与几何价格的差异，可分类为压缩、破裂和缝合三种状态。
AI.method: 引入高维表示整合11个GICS行业、黄金、原油、VIX和关键宏观经济指标。使用七年窗口前向审计方法（2018-2025年数据）。通过Econosysmographe作为高级诊断模块进行实证计算。
AI.findings: 现货价格与几何价格具有强结构一致性。行业ETF、黄金和长期国债表现出高方向准确性（86-99%）和稳定的几何惯性。原油和VIX等波动性资产显示出曲率断裂行为，符合双价格框架的理论预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了鞅范式，揭示价格形成由协方差结构中编码的确定性几何力量主导。建立了金融市场双价格理论框架。为URF-4中引入洛伦兹签名和因果结构奠定了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了新的金融基础设施基础计量学。通过Econosysmographe提供高级诊断模块。为资产配置和风险管理提供了新的分析框架，特别是对波动性资产的行为预测。

title: Government Involvement in a Mandated Insurance Market: The Case of Workers' Compensation Insurance
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Government Involvement in a Mandated Insurance Market: The Case of Workers' Compensation Insurance
detail.abstract: I exploit the formation in the 1990s of state entities that provide health and disability insurance for work-related injuries and illnesses (workers' compensation) in competition with the private market. We can think of these entities as "public options," similar to those discussed in health care. By investigating the effects of these formations on insurer competition and underwriting performance, I offer insight on the debate about the merits of public options. I find that the introduction of public options increased market concentration overall, with public options gaining significant market share. Aggregate underwriting profitability appears to improve following the formation of public options, but this was largely driven by cuts in legislated benefit levels, rather than the public options themselves. I also document that the public options tend to charge higher prices, which may help to achieve the goal of stabilizing the private market through market segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1990年代美国各州建立的工伤补偿保险公共选择方案作为自然实验，研究公共选择对保险市场竞争和承保绩效的影响。研究发现公共选择增加了市场集中度，公共选择方案获得显著市场份额，整体承保盈利能力改善主要源于法定福利水平削减而非公共选择本身，且公共选择倾向于收取更高价格以实现市场分割稳定私人市场。
AI.research_question: 公共选择方案（如工伤补偿保险中的公共选项）对保险市场竞争和承保绩效有何影响？
AI.motivation: 当前关于公共选择方案的辩论缺乏实证证据，特别是在医疗保健等领域。利用1990年代各州建立的工伤补偿保险公共选择方案作为自然实验，可以为公共选择的优劣提供实证见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共选择理论、市场竞争理论、保险市场结构理论、市场分割理论
AI.method: 利用1990年代美国各州建立工伤补偿保险公共选择方案的自然实验，采用实证分析方法研究其对市场集中度、市场份额、承保盈利能力、价格水平等指标的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 公共选择引入增加了整体市场集中度，公共选项获得显著市场份额；2) 整体承保盈利能力改善主要源于法定福利水平削减，而非公共选择本身；3) 公共选择倾向于收取更高价格，这可能通过市场分割实现稳定私人市场的目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公共选择理论提供实证证据，揭示公共选择对市场竞争结构的影响机制，阐明市场分割在稳定私人市场中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于公共选择方案实际效果的实证依据，帮助理解公共选择对保险市场的影响，为医疗保健等领域的公共选择政策设计提供参考。

title: Zoning Report: Massachusetts
affiliations: Land Use Atlas, Inc., Suffolk University Law School, Land Use Atlas, Inc., Independent and

detail.title: Zoning Report: Massachusetts

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Legal Studies Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Massachusetts is facing a housing affordability crisis. Rising home prices and rents from Cape Cod to the Berkshires are pushing long-time residents out of their communities and harming local economies. While many factors inflate housing costs, locally adopted zoning rules regulating land uses, lots, and structures are one major contributor that is entirely within our control to change. Zoning codes are enforced in nearly every community across Massachusetts. And when they are used to ban apartments and small lot developments, they hike up costs by leaving residents with few options other than the most expensive type of housing: large-lot single-family homes. 

The Massachusetts state legislature has recognized the power of zoning to shape housing affordability. In 2021, legislators passed a zoning reform measure, the Massachusetts Bay Transit Authority (MBTA) Communities Act, which requires 177 jurisdictions in eastern Massachusetts to allow apartments near transit stations. At the time of the bill, they had only a partial picture of what zoning looked like across the state. Now, five years later, a first-of-its-kind dataset built by the National Zoning Atlas (NZA) allows us to take a step back and assess the state’s zoning landscape in full, measure the changes delivered by the MBTA Communities Act so far, and target future reform.

This report presents the first comprehensive, statewide analysis of zoning in Massachusetts. Building from our previous regional analysis, Zoning Report: Cape Cod, and drawing from the NZA database’s unprecedented ability to compare zoning codes across places through time, it identifies five key facts about how Massachusetts zones. 

Part I begins this report by exploring the state’s housing challenges and providing an overview of zoning’s influence on them.

Part II describes the NZA’s methodology for analyzing, digitizing, and updating zoning codes, highlighting land use issues unique to Massachusetts. This methodology enables data collection at an unprecedented scale, increasing public understanding of zoning through accessible visualizations and evidence-based analysis.

Part III details five key features about zoning conditions across Massachusetts today. It discusses the prevalence of zoning across the state, the strict limitations on where apartments can be built, the large minimum lot size requirements, the restrictions still placed on ADU construction despite the Affordable Homes Act, onerous parking requirements, and unit densities across Massachusetts’s Gateway Cities. Collectively, these rules severely constrain where diverse housing types can go.

Part IV turns to our assessment of the MBTA Communities Act. Taking advantage of our unique ability to compare zoning rules through time at scale, it discusses how zoning conditions have changed in the 115 MBTA communities that (a) adopted new zoning rules to come into full compliance with the law by December 2025 and (b) made their updated zoning text and map available to the public by that date. This Part reveals how this law has changed the region’s zoning landscape five years after it was adopted — and where it has fallen short.

Part V concludes the report with a set of actionable recommendations to support reforms to Massachusetts’s zoning framework, promote more accessible and affordable housing, and build communities that better reflect the needs and preferences of today’s residents.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次对马萨诸塞州全州分区法规进行全面分析，揭示分区规则如何加剧住房可负担性危机，并评估MBTA社区法案的实施效果，提出改革建议。
AI.research_question: 马萨诸塞州的分区法规如何影响住房可负担性？MBTA社区法案在改变分区格局方面取得了哪些成效和不足？
AI.motivation: 马萨诸塞州面临严重的住房可负担性危机，房价和租金上涨迫使长期居民离开社区并损害地方经济。分区法规作为完全可控的因素，通过禁止公寓和小地块开发，限制了住房选择，推高了成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分区经济学理论，研究探讨土地使用管制如何通过限制住房供应影响市场价格；同时应用政策评估框架分析MBTA社区法案的实施效果。
AI.method: 利用国家分区地图集(NZA)数据库，采用大规模数据收集和数字化方法，对马萨诸塞州全州分区法规进行首次全面分析，包括时间序列比较和空间可视化。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1)分区法规在全州普遍存在；2)公寓建设受到严格限制；3)最小地块面积要求过大；4)附属住宅单元建设仍受限制；5)停车要求繁重；6)门户城市单位密度受限。MBTA社区法案在115个社区中改变了分区格局，但仍存在不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供马萨诸塞州全州分区法规的实证证据，建立了分区法规与住房可负担性之间的量化联系，为分区经济学理论提供了新的实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供基于证据的改革建议，支持马萨诸塞州分区框架改革，促进更易获得和可负担的住房，帮助建设更符合居民需求的社区。

title: Green Investment, Inequality and Misallocation
affiliations: Banque de France, Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Green Investment, Inequality and Misallocation
detail.abstract: I propose a simple framework that accounts for many poverty-related empirical results in the literature on green investment and explains why ensuring a level playing field between the poor and the rich improves the economic and environmental efficiency of green investments. I depart from the traditional margin-based approach and focus on frictions. The poor have higher present biases and face higher interest rates, but under simplifying assumptions, the latter alone are important when deciding whether to invest in a green durable good. Non-discriminating subsidies favor the rich, who are more likely to choose green durable goods, but they incentivize the poor more strongly. Only full subsidies (i.e., subsidies that fully compensate for the initial price difference between green and brown durable goods) can ensure full allocative efficiency and fairness. Such full subsidies induce the systematic choice of the green durable good and are therefore not compatible with a positive private, social or environmental discount rate. The latter is defined as a social discount rate consistent with the net-zero target: it is lower than usual social discount rates, but is still positive in the presence of carbon capture technologies. Credit policies can ensure the allocative efficiency and fairness of a decentralized equilibrium over a wider range of situations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个解释绿色投资中贫困相关实证结果的框架，强调公平竞争环境的重要性。研究发现非歧视性补贴偏向富人，只有全额补贴能确保分配效率和公平，而信贷政策能在更广泛情况下实现效率与公平。
AI.research_question: 为什么确保穷人和富人之间的公平竞争环境能提高绿色投资的经济和环境效率？什么样的政策工具能实现绿色投资的分配效率和公平？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中关于绿色投资与贫困关系的实证结果需要统一的理论解释框架，传统边际分析方法无法充分解释贫困群体在绿色投资决策中的行为差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于摩擦理论而非传统边际分析，关注穷人的现时偏见和面临的更高利率，强调利率差异在绿色耐用品投资决策中的关键作用。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，通过简化假设分析穷人和富人在绿色耐用品投资决策中的行为差异，比较不同补贴政策和信贷政策的效果。
AI.findings: 1. 非歧视性补贴偏向富人（他们更可能选择绿色耐用品），但对穷人的激励更强；2. 只有全额补贴能确保完全分配效率和公平；3. 全额补贴与正的社会/环境贴现率不兼容；4. 信贷政策能在更广泛情况下确保分散均衡的分配效率和公平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出解释绿色投资中贫困相关实证结果的统一框架；2. 强调摩擦而非边际在绿色投资决策中的重要性；3. 引入环境贴现率概念（与净零目标一致的社会贴现率）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供设计绿色投资补贴政策的指导；2. 指出全额补贴的局限性；3. 推荐信贷政策作为更有效的工具来实现绿色投资的效率和公平。

title: P vs NP Problem in Portfolio Optimization: Integrating the Markowitz-CAPM Framework with Cardinality Constraints and Black-Scholes Derivative Pricing
affiliations: Business and Technology University. Georgia

detail.title: P vs NP Problem in Portfolio Optimization: Integrating the Markowitz-CAPM Framework with Cardinality Constraints and Black-Scholes Derivative Pricing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The study was conducted independently, and no commercial entity had any role in the study design; data collection, analysis, or interpretation; manuscript preparation; or the decision to post the paper on SSRN.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it does not involve human participants, patient data, animal subjects, or identifiable personal data. The analysis relies exclusively on publicly available, aggregated financial/industry data and standard quantitative methods.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was supported solely by the author’s own time and computing resources.

detail.abstract: This study develops an integrated economic-computational framework for portfolio construction that makes the P versus NP divide operational within a financially auditable Markowitz-CAPM setting. Starting from the convex mean-variance program, we impose a hard cardinality constraint |supp(w)| ≤ K, which couples discrete subset selection with continuous weight optimization and yields a mixed-integer quadratic program (MIQP). To ensure empirical transparency, the asset universe is built from approximately n≈94 U.S. industry portfolios from Aswath Damodaran, using levered betas and annualized equity volatilities to calibrate expected returns via μ_i = R_f + β_i•ERP and to construct a fully reconstructible covariance matrix through a single-index (market-model) structure. Because the resulting search space grows combinatorially (≈C(n,K)), the paper treats scalable optimization as an approximation problem and evaluates practical solution schemes-greedy screening, Monte Carlo sampling over K-subsets, and genetic algorithms-under a replication-oriented protocol with random-seed logging, distributional performance reporting (median/IQR/quantiles), convergence/effort curves, and runtime profiling. Dependence diagnostics (median pairwise correlation, tail correlation shares, eigenvalue concentration, PSD checks) are reported as first-class outputs to connect algorithmic behavior to the geometry implied by Σ. To support financial realism beyond linear assets, the framework is extended to a derivative-augmented universe by embedding a Black-Scholes European call as an additional instrument, mapped into CAPM-consistent moments via delta-based linearization and validated by moneyness-maturity robustness and a bump test (delta vs. repricing). Results demonstrate that (i) the hard cardinality rule materially reshapes attainable efficient frontiers and induces discontinuities relative to the unconstrained benchmark; (ii) heuristic performance must be assessed by stability and compute-cost trade-offs rather than single best-run outcomes; and (iii) under a single-index covariance, strong common-factor dependence limits diversification, explaining why high-β industries and clustered sectors may co-appear in K-sparse solutions. Overall, the paper provides a journal-grade, reproducible template for studying NP-hard portfolio selection with transparent inputs and extensible derivative overlays.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个经济-计算集成框架，用于在金融可审计的Markowitz-CAPM环境中研究P与NP问题的实际应用。通过引入硬基数约束，将离散子集选择与连续权重优化结合为混合整数二次规划问题，并评估多种启发式算法。框架扩展到包含衍生品，展示了基数约束如何重塑有效前沿并影响投资组合选择。
AI.research_question: 在Markowitz-CAPM框架下，如何操作化处理P与NP问题？硬基数约束如何影响投资组合构建？在单指数协方差结构下，哪些启发式算法能有效解决组合优化问题？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合优化面临计算复杂性挑战，特别是当引入离散约束时。需要开发透明、可复现的框架来研究NP-hard问题在实际金融环境中的应用，同时考虑衍生品等复杂资产。
AI.theoretical_framework: Markowitz均值-方差理论，资本资产定价模型（CAPM），混合整数二次规划（MIQP），单指数市场模型，Black-Scholes期权定价理论。
AI.method: 构建包含约94个美国行业投资组合的资产池，使用杠杆贝塔和年化波动率校准预期收益，建立完全可重构的协方差矩阵。引入硬基数约束形成MIQP问题，评估贪婪筛选、蒙特卡洛抽样和遗传算法等启发式方法，采用复制导向协议进行性能评估。
AI.findings: 1) 硬基数约束显著重塑可达有效前沿，产生相对于无约束基准的不连续性；2) 启发式算法性能需通过稳定性和计算成本权衡评估；3) 在单指数协方差下，强共同因子依赖性限制分散化，导致高贝塔行业和聚类行业在稀疏解中共同出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将P与NP问题操作化到金融可审计的Markowitz-CAPM环境中；2) 开发了可扩展的混合整数二次规划框架；3) 建立了连接算法行为与协方差矩阵几何结构的依赖诊断方法；4) 将框架扩展到包含衍生品的资产宇宙。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供期刊级、可复现的研究模板；2) 为从业者提供透明输入和可扩展衍生品覆盖的实用框架；3) 展示了启发式算法在实际约束下的性能特征；4) 建立了评估算法稳定性和计算成本的方法论。

title: Objective vs. Perceived Corporate Greenness: Do Individuals Understand Corporate Sustainability Information?
affiliations: University of Bern and

detail.title: Objective vs. Perceived Corporate Greenness: Do Individuals Understand Corporate Sustainability Information?
detail.abstract: We investigate whether individuals correctly interpret corporate sustainability disclosures using a pre-registered survey experiment. We provide novel evidence that individuals can meaningfully differentiate emissions of firms along a greenness scale, even though their assessments exhibit a central tendency bias. This leads to overestimation of greenness among browner firms and underestimation among greener firms, with the bias disproportionately stronger for greener firms. We observe this bias even among finance professionals and sustainability experts. As a result, firms' financial incentives to invest in emissions reductions may be attenuated. However, we also demonstrate that some disclosure design features improve individuals' differentiation ability.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，个人在解读企业可持续性披露时存在中心化倾向偏差，导致对"棕色"企业环保程度高估，对"绿色"企业环保程度低估，且偏差对绿色企业更强。这种偏差在金融专业人士和可持续性专家中也存在，可能削弱企业减排投资的经济激励。但某些披露设计特征能改善个人的区分能力。
AI.research_question: 个人是否能正确解读企业可持续性披露？如果存在偏差，这种偏差如何影响企业减排投资的经济激励？哪些披露设计特征能改善个人的区分能力？
AI.motivation: 随着企业可持续性披露日益重要，了解个人如何解读这些信息至关重要。如果个人无法准确评估企业的环保表现，可能削弱企业投资减排的经济激励，影响可持续性政策的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的认知偏差理论，特别是中心化倾向偏差；信息不对称理论；企业可持续性披露的有效性理论。
AI.method: 采用预注册的调查研究实验方法，通过实验设计测试个人对企业排放水平的评估能力，包括对不同专业背景参与者的比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 个人能有效区分企业在绿色程度量表上的排放水平；2. 但存在中心化倾向偏差，导致对棕色企业环保程度高估，对绿色企业环保程度低估；3. 偏差对绿色企业更强；4. 金融专业人士和可持续性专家也存在相同偏差；5. 某些披露设计特征能改善个人的区分能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证证明个人在可持续性披露解读中存在中心化倾向偏差；2. 揭示了这种偏差在不同专业群体中的普遍性；3. 为行为经济学在可持续性信息披露领域的应用提供新证据；4. 拓展了信息不对称理论在环境披露情境下的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示政策制定者当前可持续性披露可能无法有效激励企业减排投资；2. 为监管机构设计更有效的披露框架提供实证依据；3. 帮助企业理解投资者对其环保表现的认知偏差；4. 为改进披露设计以增强信息有效性提供具体方向。

title: Issuer-Side Governance and IPO Price Formation: Evidence from Independent Advisers
affiliations: University of Oxford, Saïd Business School, University of Oxford - Said Business School and University of Oxford, Saïd Business School

detail.title: Issuer-Side Governance and IPO Price Formation: Evidence from Independent Advisers
detail.abstract: Issuer-side governance plays a central but understudied role in price formation in initial public offerings (IPOs). While the IPO literature primarily focuses on investor information production and underwriter incentives, issuers increasingly introduce an additional intermediary into the process: independent IPO advisers who oversee underwriter selection, investor engagement and pricing strategy. Using a new dataset on adviser participation in U.S. and European IPOs from 2010–2023 constructed from hand-collected advisory mandates and underwriting fee data, we document systematic differences between advised and non-advised offerings. Because adviser adoption is endogenous, however, such cross-sectional patterns may reflect underlying differences across offerings rather than the effects of advisory governance itself. Our empirical strategy leverages an institutional feature of IPO markets. Practitioner surveys and advisory fee structures suggest that advisory mandates become more prevalent once offerings reach a scale of roughly $250M, consistent with the fixed-cost nature of advisory services. In the data, adviser participation rises sharply around this deal-size scale. Using a fuzzy regression-kink design centered on this threshold, we examine how localized variation in adviser adoption around $250M relates to differences in IPO outcomes. Diagnostic tests show no evidence of manipulation or discontinuities in deal characteristics around the threshold. Applying this framework, two consistent patterns emerge. First, a one standard deviation increase in predicted adviser involvement is associated with a 4.80 percentage-point reduction in offer-price adjustments relative to the filing-range midpoint. Second, the same increase corresponds to approximately $19.1 million less underpricing for the average-sized IPO in our sample ($341 million), or a 5.61 percentage-point reduction in first-day returns. We find no corresponding association with underwriting spreads or withdrawal rates. These findings suggest that advisory governance is associated with earlier incorporation of information in the IPO process, and with reduced incentives for underwriters to underprice and strategically allocate shares. More broadly, the evidence highlights how issuer-side governance structures can influence both information aggregation and price formation in primary equity markets. These findings underscore the role of market design in shaping IPO price discovery.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨独立IPO顾问在IPO价格形成中的作用，发现顾问参与能显著降低发行价调整幅度和首日抑价，表明顾问治理有助于信息更早融入定价过程并减少承销商策略性抑价动机。
AI.research_question: 独立IPO顾问的参与如何影响IPO价格形成过程？具体而言，顾问治理对发行价调整、首日抑价、承销费用和撤销率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有IPO文献主要关注投资者信息生产和承销商激励，但发行方治理（特别是独立IPO顾问的作用）在价格形成中的角色被低估。随着发行人越来越多地引入独立顾问来监督承销商选择、投资者参与和定价策略，需要实证研究这些顾问的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论、代理理论和市场设计理论。研究探讨顾问如何缓解发行人与承销商之间的信息不对称，改善信息聚合过程，并通过监督承销商行为减少策略性抑价动机。
AI.method: 使用2010-2023年美国及欧洲IPO手工收集的顾问委托和承销费用数据。采用模糊回归拐点设计，利用顾问服务固定成本特性（约2.5亿美元交易规模阈值），分析阈值附近顾问参与变化对IPO结果的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 预测顾问参与度增加一个标准差，发行价相对于申报区间中点的调整幅度减少4.80个百分点；2) 相同增加对应样本平均规模IPO（3.41亿美元）减少约1910万美元抑价，或首日回报减少5.61个百分点；3) 对承销费用和撤销率无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统实证检验独立IPO顾问在价格形成中的作用；2) 拓展IPO治理文献，强调发行方治理结构的重要性；3) 为信息聚合和价格发现理论提供新证据；4) 展示市场设计如何影响IPO价格发现过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为发行人提供聘请独立顾问的价值证据；2) 帮助监管机构理解IPO市场结构对定价效率的影响；3) 为承销商和投资者提供关于IPO治理机制的新见解；4) 为IPO市场设计提供实证依据。

title: Access Gained, Outcomes Unchanged: The Effects of ACA Medicaid Expansion on Self-Reported Mental Health
affiliations: Georgia State University

detail.title: Access Gained, Outcomes Unchanged: The Effects of ACA Medicaid Expansion on Self-Reported Mental Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether ACA Medicaid expansion improved self-reported mental health among low income non-elderly adults. Using BRFSS data from 2011 to 2019 and a difference-in-differences framework robust to staggered treatment timing, I estimate the effects of expansion on poor mental health days and frequent mental distress. Medicaid expansion increased insurance coverage by about 4 percentage points, reduced cost-related barriers to care by roughly 2 percentage points, and modestly increased routine checkups. Despite these improvements in access, I do not detect measurable improvements in broad self-reported mental health. The null results are stable across alternative control groups, event study specifications, robustness checks, and subgroup analyses. These findings suggest that expanding insurance improved financial access to care but was not, on its own, enough to generate measurable short-run gains in mental health. More broadly, the results are consistent with a setting in which provider capacity, treatment uptake, and other nonfinancial barriers limit the translation of coverage gains into better mental health outcomes.

AI.tldr: ACA医疗补助扩展增加了低收入非老年成人的保险覆盖和减少了医疗成本障碍，但并未显著改善自我报告的心理健康状况。
AI.research_question: ACA医疗补助扩展是否改善了低收入非老年成人的自我报告心理健康？
AI.motivation: 研究ACA医疗补助扩展对心理健康的影响，了解保险覆盖增加是否能够转化为实际的心理健康改善。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗保健获取理论，假设保险覆盖增加会减少成本障碍，改善医疗服务利用，最终提升健康结果。
AI.method: 使用2011-2019年BRFSS数据，采用双重差分法（DID）框架，处理交错治疗时间问题，估计扩展对心理健康天数和频繁心理困扰的影响。
AI.findings: 医疗补助扩展增加了约4个百分点的保险覆盖，减少了约2个百分点的成本相关障碍，轻微增加了常规检查，但未检测到自我报告心理健康的可测量改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了保险覆盖自动转化为健康改善的简单假设，强调非财务障碍（如提供者能力、治疗采纳）在健康结果转化中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定者需要超越单纯扩大保险覆盖，考虑医疗系统能力、治疗可及性等非财务因素，才能有效改善心理健康结果。

title: Causal Machine Learning Reveals Divergent Effectiveness of Governance Modes for Sustainable Agricultural Transformation
affiliations: , McGill University - Department of Agricultural Economics, McGill University, Desautels Faculty of Management, Students and Independent

detail.title: Causal Machine Learning Reveals Divergent Effectiveness of Governance Modes for Sustainable Agricultural Transformation
detail.abstract: Agrifood structural transformation underpins progress toward Sustainable Development Goals, Yet whether the state should withdraw, deregulate, or inject this transition remains contested. We evaluate three governance modes across over 2,700 Chinese counties and two decades, applying Causal Forest with double/debiased machine learning to three policy reforms the 2006 agricultural tax abolition (withdraw), the 2016 supply-side reform (deregulate), and the 2014 targeted poverty alleviation campaign (inject). Governance design, not fiscal magnitude, determines effectiveness, and each mode’s impact is conditional on local institutional context: withdrawal accelerates the shift out of agriculture, where pre-reform distortions bind most tightly; deregulation diversifies cropping structures; yet injection produces no significant average effect, masking offsetting heterogeneity along fiscal-capacity lines. Data-driven targeting robustly outperforms administrative allocation in out-of-sample validation while disproportionately retaining the poorest counties. Sustainable agricultural transitions thus depend on the political economy of policy execution, not on spending magnitude.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了中国三种农业治理模式（退出、放松管制、注入）对农业结构转型的影响，发现治理设计而非财政规模决定政策效果，且效果受地方制度环境影响。数据驱动的目标定位优于行政分配。
AI.research_question: 国家在农业结构转型中应采取何种治理模式（退出、放松管制还是注入资源）？不同治理模式的效果如何受地方制度环境影响？
AI.motivation: 农业结构转型对实现可持续发展目标至关重要，但国家应如何干预（退出、放松管制还是注入资源）存在争议。需要实证评估不同治理模式的效果及其条件性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、制度经济学、治理理论、农业结构转型理论、政策执行理论
AI.method: 使用因果森林与双重/去偏机器学习方法，分析中国2700多个县20年的数据，评估三项政策改革：2006年农业税废除（退出）、2016年供给侧改革（放松管制）、2014年精准扶贫（注入）
AI.findings: 1. 治理设计而非财政规模决定政策有效性；2. 退出模式在改革前扭曲最严重的地区加速农业转型；3. 放松管制促进种植结构多样化；4. 注入模式平均效果不显著，存在财政能力异质性；5. 数据驱动目标定位优于行政分配且更惠及贫困县
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为农业治理模式选择提供理论框架；2. 强调政策执行的政治经济学重要性；3. 揭示治理效果对地方制度环境的条件依赖性；4. 验证数据驱动政策设计的优越性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供治理模式选择的实证依据；2. 强调政策设计需考虑地方制度环境；3. 推广数据驱动的精准政策分配方法；4. 为可持续发展目标下的农业转型提供政策建议

title: Urban Sprawl, Sustainability, and Housing Affordability Trade-offs in African Cities: A Panel SEM Analysis of Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya

detail.title: Urban Sprawl, Sustainability, and Housing Affordability Trade-offs in African Cities: A Panel SEM Analysis of Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could have influenced, or be perceived to have influenced, the conduct, analysis, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted without financial support from any public, commercial, or non-profit funding agencies.

detail.abstract: The effects of cities' expansion on sustainability, housing affordability, and carbon emissions are critical for formulating effective policies. This study examines the relationships between urban expansion and key outcomes such as CO₂ emissions, green space, and housing price-to-income ratios in cities in Nigeria, Kenya, and Ghana. Standardized data on multiple urban indicators were analysed using linear regression, mediation analysis, and structural equation modelling (SEM) to separate direct and indirect effects. Regression results indicate that urban expansion increases CO₂ emissions and affects housing affordability, while built-up area and economic factors moderate these effects. Mediation analysis shows that infrastructure spending partially explains the effect of urban expansion on green space, though its impact on CO₂ emissions and housing affordability is limited. SEM confirms these findings, demonstrating strong explanatory power for CO₂ emissions and housing affordability and revealing interconnections between environmental and social outcomes. The study shows that rapid urban expansion can intensify environmental degradation and housing challenges, but targeted infrastructure investment can help mitigate these risks. These results provide empirical evidence to guide urban planning policies aimed at balancing growth, environmental sustainability, and housing affordability.

AI.tldr: 研究尼日利亚、肯尼亚和加纳城市扩张对CO₂排放、绿地和房价收入比的影响，发现城市扩张加剧环境退化和住房挑战，但基础设施投资可缓解风险。
AI.research_question: 城市扩张如何影响CO₂排放、绿地和住房可负担性？这些影响在尼日利亚、肯尼亚和加纳的城市中有何表现？
AI.motivation: 城市扩张对可持续性、住房可负担性和碳排放的影响对制定有效政策至关重要，需要实证证据指导城市规划政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市扩张理论、环境经济学、住房可负担性理论、可持续发展理论。
AI.method: 使用线性回归、中介分析和结构方程模型(SEM)分析标准化城市指标数据，分离直接和间接效应。
AI.findings: 1) 城市扩张增加CO₂排放并影响住房可负担性；2) 建成区面积和经济因素调节这些效应；3) 基础设施支出部分解释城市扩张对绿地的影响；4) SEM证实了CO₂排放和住房可负担性的强解释力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证城市扩张对环境和住房的复合影响；2) 揭示基础设施投资的中介作用；3) 建立环境与社会结果之间的互连机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为平衡增长、环境可持续性和住房可负担性的城市规划政策提供实证依据；2) 指出基础设施投资可作为缓解城市扩张负面影响的政策工具。

title: Rethinking Tobacco Control: The Global Case for Differentiated Regulation of Smoke-Free Alternatives
affiliations: Tel-Hai College and

detail.title: Rethinking Tobacco Control: The Global Case for Differentiated Regulation of Smoke-Free Alternatives

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Over the past years, governments have made substantial progress in tobacco control through higher taxes, advertising bans, and public smoking restrictions. Yet, in many advanced economies, smoking rates have stopped falling despite these strong measures. This stagnation suggests that traditional approaches, focused solely on discouraging all nicotine use, may have reached their limits. Simultaneously, the emergence of novel nicotine delivery systems-such as e-cigarettes, heated tobacco products, and nicotine pouches-has introduced a new dynamic. Although these products are not risk-free, they are generally associated with a significant reduction in toxicant exposure relative to conventional cigarettes. Policy responses to this technological development vary: some countries have adopted regulatory frameworks that differentiate products based on their relative health risks, while others apply uniform restrictions across all nicotine-containing products. This study analyzes the effect of these divergent regulatory frameworks on smoking prevalence across a cohort of 42 highly developed countries (Human Development Index (HDI) > 0.83). Using Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression models controlling for development levels (measured by HDI index) and taxation levels, the findings indicate that countries adopting a differentiated, risk-proportionate policy exhibit smoking rates approximately 7 percentage points lower than those maintaining non-differentiated regulatory regimes. Furthermore, the analysis reveals that in this high-HDI cohort, differences in taxation levels alone no longer explain the variance in smoking prevalence, highlighting the importance of product substitution toward lower-risk nicotine products in sustaining progress in tobacco control.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了42个高HDI国家中，不同尼古丁产品监管框架对吸烟率的影响。研究发现，采用基于相对健康风险的差异化监管政策的国家，其吸烟率比采用统一限制政策的国家低约7个百分点。
AI.research_question: 不同尼古丁产品监管框架（差异化风险比例监管 vs. 统一限制）如何影响高发展水平国家的吸烟率？
AI.motivation: 尽管各国政府通过提高税收、广告禁令和公共场所禁烟等措施在控烟方面取得了实质性进展，但在许多发达经济体中，吸烟率已停止下降。同时，新型尼古丁输送系统（如电子烟、加热烟草产品和尼古丁袋）的出现引入了新的动态。各国对这些产品的监管政策存在差异，需要研究这些不同监管框架对吸烟率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险比例监管理论、产品替代理论、公共卫生政策评估框架
AI.method: 使用普通最小二乘法（OLS）回归模型，分析42个高人类发展指数（HDI > 0.83）国家的数据，控制发展水平（HDI指数）和税收水平等变量。
AI.findings:
1. 采用差异化、风险比例监管政策的国家，吸烟率比维持非差异化监管制度的国家低约7个百分点。
2. 在这个高HDI国家群体中，税收水平的差异不再能解释吸烟率的变化。
3. 产品替代（转向低风险尼古丁产品）在维持控烟进展中具有重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为风险比例监管理论提供了实证支持，表明基于相对健康风险的差异化监管比统一限制更有效。
2. 挑战了传统控烟政策中"一刀切"的假设，强调了产品替代在控烟中的重要性。
3. 在高发展水平国家中，税收政策对吸烟率的影响可能已达到饱和点，需要新的政策工具。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了实证证据，支持采用基于风险的差异化尼古丁产品监管框架。
2. 建议在高发展水平国家中，控烟政策应更加注重产品替代策略，而不仅仅是提高税收。
3. 为国际控烟政策协调提供了参考，鼓励各国根据科学证据调整监管方法。

title: The Elephant vs Donkey and Rank-and-file Employee Compensation
affiliations: California State University, San Marcos - College of Business Administration and San Diego State University

detail.title: The Elephant vs Donkey and Rank-and-file Employee Compensation
detail.abstract: We examine how executive political ideology shapes rank-and-file employee compensation. Using over 300,000 H-1B applications from 2010-2020, we document that firms led by Republican-leaning executives pay approximately 8% lower wages to H-1B workers than Democratic-leaning firms, after considering firm, job, and location characteristics. These findings align with agency theory and upper-echelons theory, which predict that managerial preferences influence organizational policies when discretion is high. Wage gaps intensify among financially constrained firms, firms with greater bargaining power, and in political environments with reduced scrutiny of rentextracting practices. The mechanism reflects managerial rent-seeking that leverages labor market frictions faced by H-1B workers. These compensation decisions carry real consequences: underpaying firms subsequently exhibit reduced innovation, lower valuations, and higher risks. Our findings show that executive political ideology has a significant influence on rank-and-file employee compensation, which affects worker productivity and firm performance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，共和党倾向高管领导的公司比民主党倾向公司少支付H-1B工人约8%的工资，这种薪酬差距在财务约束公司、议价能力强的公司以及政治监督较弱的环境中更为明显，最终导致创新减少、估值降低和风险增加。
AI.research_question: 高管政治意识形态如何影响普通员工薪酬？
AI.motivation: 探讨高管个人政治信仰如何通过组织决策影响员工薪酬，特别是在H-1B工人这一受劳动力市场摩擦影响的群体中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论和高层梯队理论，认为当管理自由裁量权较高时，管理者的个人偏好会影响组织政策。
AI.method: 使用2010-2020年间超过300,000份H-1B申请数据，控制公司、职位和地理位置特征进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 共和党倾向高管领导的公司比民主党倾向公司少支付H-1B工人约8%的工资；薪酬差距在财务约束公司、议价能力强的公司以及政治监督较弱的环境中更为明显；这种薪酬决策导致创新减少、估值降低和风险增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 将高管政治意识形态与员工薪酬联系起来，扩展了代理理论和高层梯队理论的应用；揭示了政治意识形态如何通过管理自由裁量权影响组织政策。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于H-1B工人薪酬不平等的实证证据；帮助公司认识到高管政治意识形态对组织绩效的实际影响；为投资者评估公司治理风险提供参考。

title: From Musk's Prophecy to Human Nature Institutionalism: A New Governance Paradigm for "Technology-Society" Imbalance in the AI Era

detail.title: From Musk's Prophecy to Human Nature Institutionalism: A New Governance Paradigm for "Technology-Society" Imbalance in the AI Era
detail.abstract: Focusing on the "technology-society" imbalance risk revealed by Elon Musk's AGI prophecy, this paper analyzes the impact of the capital-technology binding model on labor-capital balance, wealth distribution and institutional systems, proposes and systematically expounds the governance scheme of Human Nature Institutionalism with "short-sighted human nature" as the axiomatic starting point and "three theorems and two lemmas" as the core framework, and demonstrates the necessity and feasibility of this new governance paradigm centered on "human nature adaptation" for avoiding the risks of technological monopoly and social rift and guiding the society towards a "people-oriented" development direction. The research shows that the deep-seated crisis in the AI era stems from the double mismatch between the traditional governance paradigm and the laws of human behavior as well as the speed of technological change. By integrating multidisciplinary resources such as behavioral science, Marxist human studies, traditional Chinese people-oriented thought, philosophical anthropology and evolutionary psychology, Human Nature Institutionalism systematically injects the laws of human nature into institutional design, and constructs a four-dimensional governance system of "human nature adaptationtechnology guidance-fairness guarantee-rationality cultivation", providing an original theoretical tool and practical path for solving the predicament of the prophecy that "great wealth coexists with social rift".

AI.tldr: 该论文针对马斯克AGI预言揭示的"技术-社会"失衡风险，分析了资本-技术绑定模式对劳资平衡、财富分配和制度体系的影响，提出并系统阐述了以"短视人性"为公理起点、"三定理两引理"为核心框架的人性制度主义治理方案，论证了这种以"人性适应"为中心的新治理范式对于避免技术垄断和社会撕裂风险、引导社会向"以人为本"方向发展的必要性和可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过制度设计解决AI时代资本-技术绑定模式导致的劳资失衡、财富分配不均和社会撕裂风险？
AI.motivation: 马斯克AGI预言揭示了"技术-社会"失衡风险，传统治理范式与人类行为规律及技术变革速度存在双重不匹配，导致深层危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人性制度主义，以"短视人性"为公理起点，"三定理两引理"为核心框架，整合行为科学、马克思主义人学、中国传统民本思想、哲学人类学和进化心理学等多学科资源。
AI.method: 理论分析与系统阐述，通过整合多学科资源构建理论框架，并提出四维治理体系。
AI.findings: AI时代的深层危机源于传统治理范式与人类行为规律及技术变革速度的双重不匹配；人性制度主义通过将人性规律注入制度设计，构建"人性适应-技术引导-公平保障-理性培育"四维治理体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了原创的人性制度主义理论框架，为理解技术-社会关系提供了新视角；构建了"三定理两引理"的核心理论架构；整合了多学科资源形成跨学科理论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为解决"巨大财富与社会撕裂共存"的预言困境提供了理论工具和实践路径；设计了可操作的"四维治理体系"；为政策制定者提供了避免技术垄断和社会撕裂的具体治理方案。

title: Organized Crime, Hidden Pollution, and Long-Run Health Costs
affiliations: Catholic University of the Sacred Heart of Milan, University of Bologna - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Organized Crime, Hidden Pollution, and Long-Run Health Costs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare that there are not competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: All authors declare that they did not receive any funding.

detail.abstract: We study the long-run health effects of illegal toxic waste disposal conducted by organized crime in Italy. We exploit quasi-random variation in historical wind direction around contaminated sites combined with a difference-in-differences design. Using administrative cancer mortality data spanning four decades, we find that wind exposure to pollutants stemming from the contaminated sites increases cancer mortality substantially. The effects emerge after long latencies and grow over time. In later years, wind exposure implies roughly two additional cancer deaths per municipality-year relative to unexposed municipalities equally proximate to contaminated sites. Our findings reveal a previously unmeasured health externality of organized crime.

AI.tldr: 研究意大利有组织犯罪非法处置有毒废物对健康的长期影响，利用历史风向变化和双重差分法，发现暴露于污染物会增加癌症死亡率，且效应随时间增长。
AI.research_question: 有组织犯罪非法处置有毒废物对长期健康（特别是癌症死亡率）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 有组织犯罪非法处置有毒废物是一个严重但研究不足的公共卫生问题，需要量化其对健康的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境健康经济学、犯罪经济学、外部性理论
AI.method: 利用历史风向的准随机变化作为自然实验，结合双重差分设计，分析行政癌症死亡率数据（跨越40年）
AI.findings: 暴露于污染物的风向会增加癌症死亡率，效应有长期潜伏期且随时间增长；后期每年每个市镇约增加2例癌症死亡
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化有组织犯罪非法处置有毒废物的健康外部性，为环境犯罪经济学提供实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供非法废物处置健康成本的量化依据，支持加强环境监管和执法

title: Additionality in the Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program: Panel and Cross-Section Evidence from Maryland
affiliations: and College of Agriculture & Natural Resources

detail.title: Additionality in the Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program: Panel and Cross-Section Evidence from Maryland

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Neither author has personal or financial relationships that could have or perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Agri-environmental programs aimed at working farmland have played an increasingly significant role in agricultural support policies within developed countries. A critical issue that arises correspondingly is the efficiency of these programs in allocating spending, particularly regarding the additionality of agri-environmental subsidies. This paper focuses on the Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program (CREP) in Maryland, specifically subsidies for the installation of riparian buffers. We provide estimates of additionality using: (i) a first-difference estimator applied to panel data and (ii) semiparametric and parametric estimators applied to cross-sectional data. All results indicate that CREP offers modest additionality, with estimates ranging from 65% to 70% that are robust across a variety of model specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了马里兰州保护储备增强计划（CREP）中河岸缓冲带补贴的额外性，发现该计划仅提供中等程度的额外性（65%-70%），表明大部分补贴可能流向了原本就会实施环保措施的农户。
AI.research_question: 保护储备增强计划（CREP）中河岸缓冲带补贴的额外性程度如何？即这些补贴在多大程度上真正激励了原本不会发生的环保实践？
AI.motivation: 发达国家农业支持政策中针对耕地的农业环境项目日益重要，但这些项目的支出分配效率，特别是补贴的额外性问题成为关键议题。需要评估这些补贴是否真正激励了额外的环保行为，还是主要补贴了原本就会实施的措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业环境政策评估理论，特别是补贴额外性评估框架。关注政策干预的因果效应，区分补贴引致的行为变化与农户原本的行为模式。
AI.method: 采用两种方法评估额外性：(1) 对面板数据应用一阶差分估计量；(2) 对横截面数据应用半参数和参数估计量。所有模型都用于估计CREP补贴的额外性程度。
AI.findings: 所有结果一致表明CREP仅提供中等程度的额外性，估计值在65%到70%之间，且在不同模型设定下结果稳健。这意味着约30%-35%的补贴可能流向了原本就会安装河岸缓冲带的农户。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业环境政策评估提供了实证方法比较，验证了不同估计方法在评估补贴额外性时的一致性。深化了对农业环境补贴效率的理论理解，特别是关于"搭便车"问题的量化分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的效率评估结果，表明CREP项目存在改进空间。建议优化补贴设计以减少对原本就会实施环保措施的农户的补贴，提高公共资金使用效率。为其他类似农业环境项目的评估提供了方法论参考。

title: Kuwait's Digital Commerce Law: Flexibility, Innovation, and Rights Protection Kuwait's Anticipated Digital Commerce Bill: The Need for Flexible Legislation and the Risks of Rights Erosion
affiliations: Kuwait International Law School

detail.title: Kuwait's Digital Commerce Law: Flexibility, Innovation, and Rights Protection Kuwait's Anticipated Digital Commerce Bill: The Need for Flexible Legislation and the Risks of Rights Erosion
detail.abstract:
The Kuwaiti economy is characterized by its youthful, emerging, and promising nature, teeming with ambitious capabilities possessing broad vision and advanced modern orientations, alongside financial resources capable of building, managing, and developing an independent economic sector represented in digital commerce.

However, the main obstacle lies in the sluggish legislative movement that has delayed establishing a comprehensive legal framework ensuring rights protection and practice regulation according to ethical standards governing digital commerce, thereby guaranteeing this sector's safe arrival to shore, all in service of sustainable development goals and achieving Kuwait's New Vision 2035.

AI.tldr: 科威特经济具有年轻、新兴、充满潜力的特点，拥有雄心勃勃的数字商务能力，但立法滞后阻碍了建立全面的法律框架，影响了数字商务的规范发展和科威特2035新愿景的实现。
AI.research_question: 科威特数字商务发展面临的主要障碍是什么？如何通过建立法律框架来促进数字商务的规范发展，以支持可持续发展和科威特2035新愿景？
AI.motivation: 科威特经济具有年轻、新兴、充满潜力的特点，拥有雄心勃勃的数字商务能力和充足的金融资源，但立法滞后阻碍了建立全面的法律框架，影响了数字商务的规范发展和科威特2035新愿景的实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字商务发展理论、法律框架与经济发展关系理论、可持续发展理论、数字经济治理理论。
AI.method: 文献分析法、法律框架比较分析、案例研究法、政策分析。
AI.findings: 科威特数字商务发展面临的主要障碍是立法滞后，缺乏全面的法律框架来保护权利、规范实践、确保符合道德标准，这阻碍了数字商务部门的健康发展和对可持续发展目标及科威特2035新愿景的贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新兴经济体数字商务发展中的法律框架重要性理论，强调了立法滞后对数字经济健康发展的制约作用，丰富了数字经济治理理论在发展中国家的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科威特政府提供了建立数字商务法律框架的具体建议，有助于促进数字商务的规范发展，支持可持续发展和科威特2035新愿景的实现，对其他类似新兴经济体具有借鉴意义。

title: Breaking the Deadlock with Human Nature Institutionalism: From "Buried" to "Empowered" Original Talents

detail.title: Breaking the Deadlock with Human Nature Institutionalism: From "Buried" to "Empowered" Original Talents
detail.abstract: Aiming at the "Ye Gong's love for dragons" dilemma in the current scientific research field, where the slogan of "supporting originality" is disconnected from practice, this paper takes human nature institutionalism as an analytical tool to decode the root causes of three major splits in the scientific research ecosystem: the split between value advocacy and assessment logic, the split between the demand for talent spotters and the risk of identifying talents, and the split between academic laws and administrative control. It points out that the core crux lies in the deviation of institutional design from the underlying axiom of "human nature being myopic, pursuing immediate interests and avoiding harms". Based on the three theorems, two lemmas and the "melon-slicing theory" of human nature institutionalism, this paper proposes the "China Annual Original Talent Selection Competition" mechanism. By reconstructing the incentives for talent spotters, empowering original talents and optimizing the efficiency of research funds, this mechanism realizes the adaptation between institutions and human nature. This mechanism is not a castle in the air, but an upgrading of existing talent selection practices. It also faces potential challenges such as review impartiality and fund control, and ensures sustainability through a dynamic constraint mechanism. The research provides theoretical support and practical paths for solving the dilemma of buried original talents and improving the efficiency of research funds.

AI.tldr: 本文针对科研领域"叶公好龙"困境，以人性制度主义为分析工具，解码科研生态三大分裂根源，提出"中国年度原创人才选拔赛"机制，实现制度与人性的适配。
AI.research_question: 如何解决科研领域"支持原创"口号与实践脱节的"叶公好龙"困境，通过制度设计适配人性本质，提升原创人才发现效率和科研资金使用效率？
AI.motivation: 当前科研领域存在"叶公好龙"现象，即口头支持原创但实践脱节，导致原创人才被埋没、科研资金效率低下，需要从制度层面解决这一根本矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人性制度主义（Human Nature Institutionalism），基于"人性短视、趋利避害"的底层公理，包含三个定理、两个引理和"切瓜理论"。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，基于人性制度主义解码科研生态三大分裂，提出"中国年度原创人才选拔赛"机制设计，分析其可行性和约束机制。
AI.findings: 科研生态存在三大分裂：价值倡导与评估逻辑分裂、伯乐需求与识才风险分裂、学术规律与行政控制分裂；核心症结是制度设计偏离人性本质；提出的选拔赛机制能重构伯乐激励、赋能原创人才、优化资金效率。
