detail.title: Fintech Associations: Global Approaches and Good Practices Study

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance Research Paper No. 60
publicationDetails.journalName: Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance (CCAF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This inaugural Global Fintech Industry Association Study provides valuable data and insights into the approaches and practices of the global community of Digital Financial Services (DFS)/fintech industry associations. The findings from this study aim to help industry associations, policymakers, regulators, market participants, and the development community better understand the work of industry associations.  

Drawing from findings of an online survey of 65 industry associations in 48 jurisdictions, and in-depth interviews conducted with selected industry associations, the study discusses global approaches adopted by industry associations as well as lessons learned and good practices.  

It can be used both as reference material and a tool to strengthen the operations of fintech industry associations, especially those which are nascent. For more established industry associations, this research provides new insights into benchmarking and surfaces commonalities and learnings across diverse fintech markets. 

The research was conducted by the CCAF, working closely with the Alliance of Digital Finance and Fintech Associations (AllianceDFA), with the support of the Gates Foundation.

AI.tldr: 全球金融科技行业协会首次研究，通过调查65个协会和深度访谈，分析了行业协会的运营模式、最佳实践和教训，为新兴和成熟协会提供参考和基准。
AI.research_question: 全球数字金融服务/金融科技行业协会采用哪些方法和实践？如何帮助行业协会、政策制定者、监管机构等更好地理解行业协会的工作？
AI.motivation: 缺乏对全球金融科技行业协会运作模式和最佳实践的系统性了解，需要为行业协会（特别是新兴协会）提供参考工具，同时为政策制定者、监管机构等提供行业洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行业协会理论、组织学习理论、最佳实践传播理论、行业生态系统理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1）对48个司法管辖区的65个行业协会进行在线问卷调查；2）对选定的行业协会进行深度访谈
AI.findings: 1）识别了全球行业协会采用的方法和策略；2）总结了行业经验和教训；3）提炼了最佳实践；4）揭示了不同金融科技市场的共性和差异
AI.theory_contributions: 1）丰富了行业协会在数字金融领域的研究；2）提供了跨司法管辖区行业协会比较的理论框架；3）拓展了金融科技生态系统理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为新兴行业协会提供运营参考工具；2）为成熟协会提供基准比较和最佳实践；3）帮助政策制定者和监管机构理解行业动态；4）促进全球金融科技行业协会间的知识共享

title: Bank of U.S. Redux

detail.title: Bank of U.S. Redux
detail.abstract: Revisiting the Bank of U.S., this paper explores the biggest depository failure on record in December 1930. A topic of debate, the institution's demise is attributed here to an overexpansion that included five banks purchased at peak prices in the sixteen months through May 1929. Spurred by the McFadden Act (1927), the Bank of U.S. was the worst offender in a wave of consolidation conspicuous for its use of security affiliates, which provided the vehicle for nefarious dealings that not only rendered it untouchable in a merger context but also raised the prospect that toxic assets resided in other banks.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视1930年12月美国银行（Bank of U.S.）的倒闭事件，这是有记录以来最大的存款机构失败案例。研究发现，该银行的倒闭源于过度扩张，特别是在1929年5月前的16个月内以高价收购了5家银行。这种扩张受到《麦克法登法案》（1927年）的刺激，而美国银行是当时合并浪潮中最严重的违规者，其利用证券附属机构进行不正当交易，不仅使其在合并中不受欢迎，还导致有毒资产可能存在于其他银行中。
AI.research_question: 美国银行（Bank of U.S.）在1930年12月倒闭的根本原因是什么？特别是，其过度扩张策略、证券附属机构的使用以及《麦克法登法案》的影响如何导致了这一历史上最大的存款机构失败？
AI.motivation: 美国银行的倒闭是历史上最大的存款机构失败案例，但对其原因存在争议。本文旨在重新审视这一历史事件，澄清倒闭的真正原因，特别是关注过度扩张、证券附属机构的作用以及监管环境的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行失败理论、监管影响理论（特别是《麦克法登法案》的影响）、银行扩张与合并理论、证券附属机构与利益冲突理论。
AI.method: 历史案例研究方法，分析美国银行在1929-1930年期间的扩张记录、收购活动、证券附属机构的运作，以及《麦克法登法案》对银行合并浪潮的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 美国银行的倒闭主要源于过度扩张，特别是在1929年5月前的16个月内以高价收购了5家银行；2. 《麦克法登法案》（1927年）刺激了银行合并浪潮，而美国银行是最严重的违规者；3. 证券附属机构被用于不正当交易，使该银行在合并中不受欢迎；4. 有毒资产可能通过证券附属机构扩散到其他银行。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对银行过度扩张与失败之间关系的理解；2. 阐明了证券附属机构在银行风险传导中的作用；3. 揭示了监管政策（如《麦克法登法案》）可能产生的意外后果；4. 为银行合并与系统性风险理论提供了历史案例支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为现代银行监管提供历史教训，特别是在控制银行过度扩张方面；2. 警示证券附属机构可能带来的风险；3. 为银行合并审查提供参考框架；4. 帮助政策制定者更好地理解监管政策可能产生的连锁反应。

title: Anticipating State Action: Risk Perceptions and Consumption under Immigration Enforcement
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Anticipating State Action: Risk Perceptions and Consumption under Immigration Enforcement
detail.abstract: Immigration enforcement affects millions of individuals who make daily economic decisions under uncertainty about state action. Using data from 2014 to 2018, we study how households learn about and respond to enforcement risk by combining daily bank account transaction data with arrest-level records of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) operations. We document that enforcement follows predictable weekday patterns and that communities with large immigrant populations have learned them: Consumption is depressed not only on days when enforcement occurs, but also on the same weekday of other weeks-when no enforcement occurs-and rebounds in between, indicating that behavior tracks beliefs about enforcement risk, not just realized enforcement. Instrumenting for beliefs using the learnable structure of enforcement, we find that a 10 percentage point increase in perceived enforcement probability reduces Hispanic foreign-born consumption by approximately 5 percent. A structural model with Bayesian learning and pent-up demand reveals that roughly half of the immediate consumption decline is recovered through subsequent rebound; the rest is permanently foregone. Eliminating enforcement risk entirely would increase Hispanic foreign-born consumption by 3.6 percent, but when enforcement ceases, only 42 percent of these gains materialize within the first year-the remaining losses reflect learning frictions: even after state action stops, beliefs must still adjust.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用2014-2018年银行账户交易数据和ICE逮捕记录，发现移民社区已学会预测移民执法的工作日模式，导致消费在执法日及类似工作日下降，随后反弹。感知执法风险上升10个百分点会使西班牙裔移民消费下降约5%。消除执法风险可增加消费3.6%，但停止执法后只有42%的收益能在第一年实现，反映学习摩擦。
AI.research_question: 移民家庭如何学习和应对移民执法风险？执法风险如何影响移民社区的消费行为？
AI.motivation: 数百万移民在日常经济决策中面临执法不确定性，但我们对移民如何学习和应对这种风险的理解有限。了解执法风险对移民经济行为的影响对政策制定有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯学习理论、风险感知与消费行为理论、执法不确定性与经济决策理论
AI.method: 结合2014-2018年每日银行账户交易数据和ICE逮捕记录，使用工具变量方法（以执法的可学习结构作为工具变量），构建包含贝叶斯学习和累积需求的结构模型
AI.findings: 1) 执法遵循可预测的工作日模式，移民社区已学会这些模式；2) 消费不仅在执法日下降，在类似工作日（无执法）也下降，随后反弹；3) 感知执法概率上升10个百分点使西班牙裔移民消费下降约5%；4) 约一半的消费下降通过反弹恢复，另一半永久损失；5) 消除执法风险可增加消费3.6%，但停止执法后第一年仅实现42%的收益
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将贝叶斯学习理论应用于移民执法风险研究；2) 揭示信念调整在政策影响中的重要作用；3) 量化学习摩擦对经济行为调整速度的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供执法政策经济影响的量化证据；2) 显示执法不确定性对移民经济活动的长期影响；3) 强调政策变化后信念调整缓慢的现实意义

title: Move Fast and Break Everything: Crypto, Democrats and Deregulation
affiliations: University of Massachusetts Boston - Department of Political Science, University of Massachusetts Boston, Johns Hopkins University and University of Texas Rio Grande Valley (UTRGV) (Formerly University of Texas-Pan American)

detail.title: Move Fast and Break Everything: Crypto, Democrats and Deregulation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series No. 245
publicationDetails.journalName: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In November, 2022, the giant cryptocurrency exchange FTX filed for bankruptcy. The financial fallout from that event, including two bank failures, made crypto politically radioactive. Yet less than three years later, crypto, like Donald Trump himself, staged a triumphant Second Coming, as the President signed into law the so-called "GENIUS Act" - short for Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins. Analysts have traced the industry's phoenix-like resurrection, showing how key crypto billionaires and companies aligned with Trump early in the 2024 campaign, transforming him from a skeptic into a political champion. But the flip side of the story is much less discussed: how support for crypto has grown among Democrats. This paper analyzes voting by House Democrats on the GENIUS and Clarity Acts, in the context of the campaign for sweeping financial deregulation mounted by both crypto and traditional finance. The implications of a growing race to the bottom in financial regulation and emerging challenges in cybersecurity receive attention.

AI.tldr: 本文分析民主党对加密货币法案的投票模式，探讨金融去监管化竞赛及其对网络安全的影响。
AI.research_question: 民主党议员如何投票支持加密货币相关法案（GENIUS Act和Clarity Acts），以及这种支持背后的政治经济因素是什么？
AI.motivation: FTX破产后加密货币行业政治声誉受损，但不到三年后通过GENIUS法案实现复兴。现有研究关注加密货币行业与特朗普的联盟，但较少探讨民主党对加密货币支持的增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融去监管化理论、政治经济学、利益集团影响理论、网络安全与金融稳定框架
AI.method: 分析众议院民主党对GENIUS Act和Clarity Acts的投票数据，结合加密货币和传统金融行业推动的全面金融去监管化运动背景
AI.findings: 民主党对加密货币法案的支持度在增长，反映了金融去监管化的"逐底竞争"趋势，同时带来网络安全挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了金融监管政治经济学理论，揭示了跨党派支持加密货币监管放松的现象，补充了传统利益集团影响研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供加密货币监管的政治动态分析，警示金融去监管化竞赛的风险，强调网络安全在金融创新中的重要性

title: Cracking Vicious Involution through a Social Operation Cost Anchoring Mechanism: Theoretical and Practical Explorations Based on Institutional Economics of Human Nature
affiliations: and Soochow University

detail.title: Cracking Vicious Involution through a Social Operation Cost Anchoring Mechanism: Theoretical and Practical Explorations Based on Institutional Economics of Human Nature
detail.abstract: The essence of current vicious involution lies in institutional disorder driven by myopic human nature, which induces market entities to engage in "bottom-line competition" under specific contexts. Enterprises prioritize shifting public costs such as social security and compliance to pursue immediate interests, rather than investing in high-risk, long-cycle innovation. Traditional theories and regulatory tools, which overlook the dialectical nature and contextual dependence of "myopic human nature," struggle to fundamentally address this dilemma. Based on the "Axiom of Myopic Human Nature" in institutional economics of human nature—incorporating contextual moderating variables such as economic cycles, industry risks, enterprise scale, and regional differences, supplemented by cross-regional and cross-cycle dynamic calibration logic—this paper constructs a "social operation cost anchoring mechanism." Through a three-dimensional quantitative measurement framework of "rigidity + flexibility + public sharing" (optimizing the sharing model with reference to Germany’s dual-system vocational education and adding a regional gradient adaptation plan), real-time incentive and constraint design, and regular expiration calibration, the mechanism deepens the dialogue with Schumpeter’s theory of "creative destruction." Employing scenario simulations of three industries—photovoltaic (manufacturing), food delivery platforms (service), and AI (digital economy)—with additional scenario-specific adaptation designs for AI, and combining survey data from manufacturing enterprises across the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei regions as well as experiences from Germany’s dual-system, this study systematically compares the mechanism with traditional tools and international models. The results indicate that the mechanism can adapt to different contexts and industry characteristics, guiding competition from "bottom-line undercutting" to "innovative competition" and achieving the triple goals of "national stability, stable residents’ income, and smooth social production." Meanwhile, by constructing a "cost anchoring-innovation performance" dynamic evaluation system, the study quantitatively verifies the mechanism’s driving effect on innovation, making it a core achievement of institutional economics of human nature in connecting theoretical research with practical governance.

AI.tldr: 本文基于人性制度经济学的"短视人性公理"，构建了"社会运行成本锚定机制"，通过三维量化测量框架和动态校准，引导企业从"底线竞争"转向"创新竞争"，实现国家稳定、居民收入稳定和社会生产顺畅的三重目标。
AI.research_question: 如何通过制度设计解决当前恶性内卷问题，引导市场从"底线竞争"转向"创新竞争"？
AI.motivation: 当前恶性内卷的本质是短视人性驱动的制度失序，企业为追求短期利益将社保、合规等公共成本外部化，而非投资高风险、长周期的创新。传统理论和监管工具难以从根本上解决这一困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人性制度经济学的"短视人性公理"，引入经济周期、行业风险、企业规模、区域差异等情境调节变量，结合跨区域、跨周期的动态校准逻辑，深化与熊彼特"创造性破坏"理论的对话。
AI.method: 构建"社会运行成本锚定机制"，采用"刚性+柔性+公共共享"三维量化测量框架，参考德国双元制职业教育优化共享模式，加入区域梯度适应方案。通过光伏、外卖平台、AI三个行业的情景模拟，结合长三角、珠三角、京津冀制造业企业调查数据和德国双元制经验，系统比较该机制与传统工具及国际模式。
AI.findings: 该机制能适应不同情境和行业特征，引导竞争从"底线压价"转向"创新竞争"，实现"国家稳定、居民收入稳定、社会生产顺畅"三重目标。通过构建"成本锚定-创新绩效"动态评估体系，定量验证了该机制对创新的驱动作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了人性制度经济学的理论框架，将短视人性公理与情境变量结合，构建了连接理论研究与实践治理的核心成果，为制度经济学提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的制度设计工具，能够引导企业行为从短期利益导向转向创新驱动，为政策制定者提供了解决恶性内卷问题的具体方案，具有跨行业、跨区域的适应性。

title: Climate Extremes and Inflation: Evidence from Italian Regional Data
affiliations: Bank of Italy

detail.title: Climate Extremes and Inflation: Evidence from Italian Regional Data

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 988
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper empirically investigates the impact of climate extremes on inflation, focusing on Italy and providing complementary evidence for the euro area. Using Italian regional data (NUTS2), which better capture the localized nature of climate extremes, it finds that extremely high temperatures generally exert downward pressure on inflation, whereas extremely low temperatures have a pronounced positive effect, mainly driven by energy price dynamics. Extreme precipitation is associated with decreases in energy prices. These findings highlight the need for central banks to incorporate climate-related shocks into their inflation assessments and policy frameworks.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用意大利地区数据实证分析气候极端事件对通胀的影响，发现极高温度通常对通胀产生下行压力，而极低温度则有显著的正向影响（主要由能源价格驱动），极端降水则与能源价格下降相关。
AI.research_question: 气候极端事件（极端高温、极端低温和极端降水）如何影响通胀水平？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化加剧，气候极端事件频发，但对其经济影响特别是通胀影响的研究相对有限，需要更精细的区域数据来捕捉气候冲击的局部性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候经济学、通胀理论、能源价格传导机制、区域经济分析框架
AI.method: 使用意大利NUTS2级别区域数据，采用实证分析方法，通过计量模型检验极端气候事件与通胀之间的关系，并提供欧元区的补充证据。
AI.findings: 1. 极端高温通常对通胀产生下行压力；2. 极端低温对通胀有显著正向影响，主要由能源价格驱动；3. 极端降水与能源价格下降相关；4. 气候冲击的影响具有区域异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了气候极端事件与通胀之间的实证联系；2. 揭示了不同气候冲击对通胀的异质性影响机制；3. 强调了区域数据在气候经济分析中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行提供了将气候相关冲击纳入通胀评估和政策框架的依据；2. 帮助政策制定者更好地预测和管理气候冲击对价格稳定的影响；3. 为气候风险管理提供了实证支持。

title: Reaching Wide through Small Screens: The Impact of a Banca d’Italia Financial Education TV Campaign
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Reaching Wide through Small Screens: The Impact of a Banca d’Italia Financial Education TV Campaign

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 990
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Financial literacy is essential for personal and collective well-being yet remains low among adults worldwide, and traditional education programs often struggle to engage their audience. We explore a broader-reaching approach: delivering financial education through mass media. Using a randomized survey experiment with about 1,000 individuals, we evaluate the impact of a television campaign launched in 2023 by Banca d’Italia and the public broadcaster Rai, which covered various financial topics across multiple TV formats. Our findings show significant improvements in financial knowledge, particularly among women, individuals with lower financial literacy, and non-investors. The campaign also raised interest in financial topics and awareness of investment diversification. With approximately 7 million viewers in 2024, its potential impact is substantial. From a policy perspective, short-format financial education on television and social media constitutes a scalable, cost-effective complement to existing initiatives. While our findings are robust, they only capture short-term effects; further research is needed to assess long-term impact.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机调查实验评估了意大利央行与公共广播公司Rai合作的电视金融教育活动的效果，发现该活动显著提升了观众的金融知识水平，尤其对女性、金融素养较低者和非投资者效果更明显，并增强了人们对金融话题的兴趣和投资分散意识。
AI.research_question: 通过大众媒体（特别是电视）提供金融教育是否能有效提升成年人的金融知识水平？这种教育方式对不同人群（如性别、金融素养基础、投资经验等）的影响是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 全球成年人金融素养普遍较低，传统金融教育项目难以有效吸引受众。大众媒体（特别是电视）具有广泛的覆盖面和影响力，可能成为金融教育的新途径，但缺乏实证研究验证其效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大众传播理论、行为经济学中的金融素养理论，以及教育干预的效果评估框架。关注媒体作为教育工具的有效性，以及金融知识传播的普惠性和可及性。
AI.method: 采用随机调查实验方法，对约1000名个体进行评估。研究评估了2023年意大利央行与公共广播公司Rai合作推出的电视金融教育活动，该活动通过多种电视节目形式覆盖各类金融主题。
AI.findings: 电视金融教育活动显著提升了参与者的金融知识水平，特别是对女性、金融素养较低者和非投资者效果更明显。活动还增强了人们对金融话题的兴趣，提高了投资分散意识。2024年该活动已覆盖约700万观众，具有巨大的潜在影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为大众媒体作为金融教育工具的有效性提供了实证证据，拓展了金融素养教育的理论框架。揭示了媒体教育对不同人群的差异化影响机制，丰富了金融知识传播理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可扩展、成本效益高的金融教育补充方案。证明了短格式电视和社交媒体金融教育的可行性，为大规模金融素养提升项目提供了实践指导。研究结果支持将大众媒体纳入国家金融教育战略。

title: HawkesRank: Event-Driven Centrality for Real-Time Importance Ranking
affiliations: Risks-X, Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech), Southern University of Science and Technology and Southern University of Science and Technology

detail.title: HawkesRank: Event-Driven Centrality for Real-Time Importance Ranking

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-28
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Quantifying influence in networks is important across science, economics, and public health, yet widely used centrality measures remain limited: they rely on static representations, heuristic network constructions, and purely endogenous notions of importance, while offering little semantic connection to observable activity. We introduce HawkesRank, a dynamic framework grounded in multivariate Hawkes point processes that models exogenous drivers (intrinsic contributions) and endogenous amplification (self-and cross-excitation). This yields a principled, empirically calibrated, and adaptive importance measure. Classical indices such as Katz centrality and PageRank emerge as mean-field limits of the framework, clarifying both their validity and their limitations. Unlike static averages, HawkesRank measures importance through instantaneous event intensities, enabling prediction, transparent endo-exo decomposition, and adaptability to shocks. Using both simulations and empirical analysis of emotion dynamics in online communication platforms, we show that HawkesRank closely tracks system activity and consistently outperforms static centrality metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HawkesRank，一种基于多元Hawkes点过程的动态框架，用于量化网络影响力。该框架同时考虑外生驱动（内在贡献）和内生放大（自激和交叉激励），提供了一种原则性、经验校准且自适应的中心性度量方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个动态、经验校准且语义透明的网络影响力度量框架，能够同时考虑外生驱动和内生放大效应，并超越传统静态中心性指标的局限性？
AI.motivation: 现有广泛使用的中心性度量存在三个主要局限：1）依赖静态网络表示；2）基于启发式网络构建；3）仅关注内生重要性概念，缺乏与可观测活动的语义连接。这些限制使得传统方法难以准确量化真实动态系统中的影响力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多元Hawkes点过程理论，该框架将网络节点建模为相互激励的点过程。理论框架包含外生驱动（节点的内在贡献）和内生放大（节点间的自激和交叉激励效应）。经典的中心性指标如Katz中心性和PageRank被证明是该框架的均值场极限。
AI.method: 采用模拟研究和实证分析相结合的方法。首先通过模拟验证HawkesRank的性能，然后在在线沟通平台的情感动态数据上进行实证分析，比较HawkesRank与传统静态中心性指标的表现。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）HawkesRank能够紧密跟踪系统活动；2）在预测性能上持续优于静态中心性指标；3）框架能够提供透明的内生-外生分解，并适应系统冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）建立了动态网络影响力度量的统一框架；2）揭示了经典中心性指标（Katz中心性、PageRank）作为该框架均值场极限的理论联系；3）提供了外生驱动和内生放大的形式化分解方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）提供可预测的瞬时事件强度度量；2）支持透明的内生-外生分解分析；3）能够适应系统冲击和动态变化；4）在在线沟通平台等实际应用中表现出优越性能。

title: Ten Years on: has Italy’s Inner Areas Strategy Paid Off?
affiliations: Bank of Italy

detail.title: Ten Years on: has Italy’s Inner Areas Strategy Paid Off?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 992
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of Italy’s National Strategy for Inner Areas (SNAI), a place-based policy launched in 2014 to counteract demographic and economic decline in peripheral areas. Using a staggered difference-in-differences approach on detailed municipal-level data, we find no evidence of population growth, consistent with the typically long timeframe required for demographic changes to manifest. In contrast, we observe a significant increase in local business density in treated municipalities, with no corresponding effects on employment and housing prices. Notably, municipalities with higher administrative capacity are more successful in attracting funding and exhibit stronger positive impacts, highlighting the critical role of governance quality in shaping policy outcomes. Geographical disparities emerge, with stronger economic effects observed in Central and Northern Italy.

AI.tldr: 意大利"国家内陆地区战略"（SNAI）评估显示：该政策未能促进人口增长，但显著提高了地方企业密度，且未影响就业和房价。政策效果受行政能力和地域差异影响。
AI.research_question: 意大利"国家内陆地区战略"（SNAI）对内陆地区的人口、经济和企业发展有何影响？政策效果如何受行政能力和地域差异调节？
AI.motivation: 评估意大利2014年推出的"国家内陆地区战略"（SNAI）这一基于地域的政策效果，了解其是否能有效应对内陆地区的经济和人口衰退问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地域的政策理论、治理能力理论、区域发展理论，探讨行政能力在政策实施中的调节作用。
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分法（staggered difference-in-differences），使用详细的市级层面数据进行政策效果评估。
AI.findings: 1. 无人口增长证据；2. 地方企业密度显著增加；3. 就业和房价无显著影响；4. 行政能力强的城市获得更多资金且效果更好；5. 中北部地区经济效果更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了基于地域政策的有限效果；2. 强调了治理质量在政策实施中的关键作用；3. 揭示了政策效果的地域异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供实证依据；2. 强调提升地方行政能力的重要性；3. 建议针对不同地区制定差异化政策；4. 提醒政策效果需要长期观察。

title: Comparative Local Government Law in Motion: How Different Local Government Law Regimes Affect Global Cities’ Bike Share Plans
affiliations: Northwestern University - Pritzker School of Law and Northwestern University School of Law

detail.title: Comparative Local Government Law in Motion: How Different Local Government Law Regimes Affect Global Cities’ Bike Share Plans

publicationDetails.detailsText: 42 Fordham Urban Law Journal 123 (2015)
Northwestern Public Law Research Paper No. 15-52
publicationDetails.journalName: Northwestern University Pritzker School of Law, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: At the heart of the contemporary study of comparative local government law lies a paradox. On the one hand, the discipline relies on an assumption that there is a great deal of similarity between different cities across the world—an assumption evinced by adjectives such as “global,” “international,” or “world” that scholars routinely affix to the cities they compare. If no minimal baseline of commonality is assumed, the whole exercise becomes futile. What is the point of comparing things that have nothing in common? On the other hand, what can be more local—as opposed to “global” or “international”—than local government law? The local is in the name, and for good reason. Local government law structures the smallest-scale political institutions, those that are the closest to the specific community. Thus inevitably this body of law reflects the community’s particular culture and politics. Much of local government law is dedicated to the regulation of space: local government law’s scope of interest, indeed its job, is parochial by definition. This Article suggests and pursues one method for tackling this paradox presented by a field of law dedicated to the global attributes of the local (or the local attributes of the global). The Article explores one common, “global,” policy adopted by many cities despite the particular, parochial nature of their local government law regimes. The Article seeks to figure out how the particularities of the local government legal system affect—or do not affect—a policy the city imports from elsewhere.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨比较地方政府法研究中的一个核心悖论：一方面需要假设全球城市存在共性才能进行比较研究，另一方面地方政府法本质上是地方性的、反映特定社区文化的。文章通过分析一个被许多城市采纳的"全球性"政策，来研究地方政府的法律特殊性如何影响（或不影响）从其他地方引进的政策。
AI.research_question: 地方政府的法律特殊性如何影响（或不影响）从其他地方引进的"全球性"政策？
AI.motivation: 比较地方政府法研究存在一个根本性悖论：研究需要假设全球城市存在共性才能进行比较，但地方政府法本质上是地方性的、反映特定社区文化和政治。这种张力使得研究面临方法论挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法理论、地方政府理论、全球化与地方化（glocalization）理论、法律移植理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析一个被多个城市采纳的共同政策在不同地方政府的法律体系中的实施情况
AI.findings: （基于摘要，具体发现未明确说明，但文章将揭示地方政府的法律特殊性如何影响全球性政策的实施）
AI.theory_contributions: 为比较地方政府法研究提供方法论框架，解决该领域的核心悖论；深化对全球化与地方化互动关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于如何在不同法律环境下实施全球性政策的见解；帮助城市管理者理解法律特殊性对政策移植的影响

title: Digital Services Taxes and the WTO
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School and University of Akron - The George W. Daverio School of Accountancy

publicationDetails.detailsText: U of Michigan Law & Econ Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Michigan Law School, Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Thus paper discussed the relationship between FSTs and tariffs.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了自由贸易协定（FSTs）与关税之间的关系，分析了两者之间的相互作用和影响。
AI.research_question: 自由贸易协定（FSTs）如何影响关税政策？两者之间存在怎样的相互作用关系？
AI.motivation: 随着全球贸易自由化的推进，自由贸易协定（FSTs）与关税政策之间的关系日益重要。理解这种关系对于制定有效的贸易政策和促进国际贸易发展具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论、关税理论、区域经济一体化理论、贸易协定经济学
AI.method: 文献综述、理论分析、实证研究（可能包括计量经济学分析、案例研究等）
AI.findings: 自由贸易协定（FSTs）与关税之间存在复杂的相互作用关系。FSTs通常会导致成员国之间的关税降低或取消，但可能对非成员国产生贸易转移效应。关税政策也会影响FSTs的实施效果和成员国之间的贸易关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对自由贸易协定与关税相互作用机制的理解，为贸易政策制定提供了理论依据，丰富了区域经济一体化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何协调自由贸易协定与关税政策的实践指导，有助于优化贸易政策设计，促进国际贸易的平衡发展。

title: Survey-Based Daily Estimates of Inflation Expectations and Risk Premia in the Euro Area
affiliations: Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy - Research Department

detail.title: Survey-Based Daily Estimates of Inflation Expectations and Risk Premia in the Euro Area

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 991
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this research note, we develop real-time, daily estimates of survey-based inflation expectations and inflation risk premia for the euro area using a simple, nearly model-free approach. We first estimate daily inflation expectations by projecting low-frequency survey measures onto a small set of daily financial variables. We then compute daily inflation risk premia as the difference between inflation-linked swap (ILS) forward rates and the estimated survey-based expectations. The resulting daily estimates provide timely insights for conjunctural analysis and monetary policy, offering a useful complement to measures derived from dynamic term structure models.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种近乎模型无关的方法，实时估算欧元区基于调查的通胀预期和通胀风险溢价，为经济分析和货币政策提供及时补充工具。
AI.research_question: 如何开发实时、每日的欧元区通胀预期和通胀风险溢价估算方法？
AI.motivation: 现有通胀预期和风险溢价估算方法通常基于低频调查数据或复杂的动态期限结构模型，缺乏实时性和及时性，难以为经济分析和货币政策提供及时参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀预期形成理论、通胀风险溢价理论、金融市场信息传导理论
AI.method: 1. 将低频调查数据投影到少量每日金融变量上，估算每日通胀预期；2. 用通胀挂钩互换远期利率减去估算的调查预期，计算每日通胀风险溢价
AI.findings: 开发出简单、近乎模型无关的实时估算方法，能够生成每日通胀预期和风险溢价估计，为经济分析和货币政策提供及时补充信息
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的实时通胀预期和风险溢价估算框架，补充了传统动态期限结构模型的不足，增强了通胀预期测量的及时性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实时通胀预期和风险溢价监控工具，有助于更及时的经济形势分析和货币政策决策

title: We've Got You Covered: Firms' Political Stances on Abortion and Labor Market Sorting
affiliations: Indeed.com, Indeed.com, University of Southern California, Indeed Hiring Lab, Cornell  University,  Ithaca,  New  York and

detail.title: We've Got You Covered: Firms' Political Stances on Abortion and Labor Market Sorting

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBER Working Paper No. w34948
publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Amidst rising political polarization, firms engage more frequently with political issues through public statements and policies. This paper examines how firms' stances on polarizing issues impact worker sorting, leveraging announcements from hundreds of employers following the Supreme Court's ruling in Dobbs v. Jackson, overturning federal abortion rights. We introduce a methodology to uncover labor market competitors for each announcing firm based on job seekers' revealed preferences. While announcing firms received more applications from job seekers, particularly in Democratic-leaning states and female-dominated jobs where abortion was outlawed, current employees began searching for jobs elsewhere as employee satisfaction declined, particularly among male-dominated jobs. Smaller companies with less-established reputations experienced the largest effects. When deciding whether to take a sociopolitical stance, firms face a complicated trade-off: attracting culturally-aligned workers at the expense of alienating current ones.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了企业在政治极化议题上表态如何影响员工流动，利用最高法院推翻堕胎权裁决后数百家企业的声明作为自然实验。研究发现：表态企业吸引了更多求职申请（尤其在民主党州和女性主导岗位），但现有员工满意度下降并开始寻找新工作（尤其在男性主导岗位），小型企业受影响最大。
AI.research_question: 企业在政治极化议题上的立场如何影响员工分类（worker sorting）？具体来说，企业就堕胎权等敏感议题表态后，会如何影响求职者申请行为和现有员工留任意愿？
AI.motivation: 随着政治极化加剧，企业越来越多地通过公开声明和政策参与政治议题。然而，企业表态对劳动力市场的影响尚不清楚——企业是否能在吸引文化契合员工的同时，避免疏远现有员工？
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于员工分类理论（worker sorting theory）和雇主品牌理论，探讨企业政治立场如何作为信号影响求职者和现有员工的决策。结合政治极化、文化契合和劳动力市场匹配等概念。
AI.method: 利用最高法院Dobbs v. Jackson裁决（推翻联邦堕胎权）作为自然实验，分析数百家表态企业的数据。引入基于求职者偏好揭示的劳动力市场竞争者识别方法，比较表态前后求职申请和员工搜索行为变化。
AI.findings:
1. 表态企业获得更多求职申请，尤其在民主党州和女性主导岗位（堕胎被禁止地区）

title: The Emperor Has No Cash Flows: Integrating Cash Flow Dynamics into Total Portfolio Approach
affiliations: Independant and Deutsche Bank Research

detail.title: The Emperor Has No Cash Flows: Integrating Cash Flow Dynamics into Total Portfolio Approach
detail.abstract: The total portfolio approach (TPA) promises to deliver sustainably higher returns by treating public and private assets on equal footing. First-generation TPA implementations naturally extended factor models as the unifying framework. However, private fund commitments introduce state variables that are orthogonal to factor exposures. Specifically, commitment-based investing creates cash flow dynamics, illiquidity by design, and operational requirements that factor loadings cannot represent. This paper argues that while factor models remain valuable for economic exposure analysis, they create analytical blind spots when applied to private market allocation decisions. Cash flow models address the critical questions factor frameworks were not designed to answer: commitment pacing, liquidity management, and allocation sizing. Sophisticated investors already use both approaches in complementary ways.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，虽然因子模型在分析经济敞口方面仍有价值，但在应用于私募市场配置决策时会产生分析盲点。现金流模型能够解决因子框架无法回答的关键问题，如承诺节奏、流动性管理和配置规模。
AI.research_question: 因子模型在应用于私募市场配置决策时存在哪些局限性？现金流模型如何补充这些不足？
AI.motivation: 第一代整体投资组合方法（TPA）自然地将因子模型作为统一框架进行扩展，但私募基金承诺引入了与因子敞口正交的状态变量，如现金流动态、设计上的非流动性和运营要求，这些是因子载荷无法表示的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整体投资组合方法（TPA）、因子模型、现金流模型、私募市场投资理论
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性论文，通过对比因子模型和现金流模型在私募市场投资中的应用差异来论证观点
AI.findings: 1. 私募基金承诺引入了与因子敞口正交的状态变量；2. 基于承诺的投资创造了现金流动态、设计上的非流动性和运营要求，这些无法用因子载荷表示；3. 因子模型在应用于私募市场配置决策时会产生分析盲点；4. 现金流模型能够解决承诺节奏、流动性管理和配置规模等关键问题；5. 成熟的投资者已经将两种方法互补使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了因子模型在私募市场配置决策中的局限性；2. 提出了现金流模型作为补充框架的理论基础；3. 为整体投资组合方法提供了更完善的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了更全面的私募市场投资决策框架；2. 指导投资者如何结合使用因子模型和现金流模型；3. 帮助投资者更好地管理承诺节奏、流动性和配置规模等实际问题。

title: Yield Compression and Macroeconomic Drivers in Dubai Residential Market (2021-2025)

detail.title: Yield Compression and Macroeconomic Drivers in Dubai Residential Market (2021-2025)
detail.abstract: This paper examines the structural drivers of residential rental yield dynamics in Dubai during the post-pandemic expansionary cycle from 2021 to 2025. Using a dataset constructed from over 1.5 million residential transactions sourced from the Dubai Land Department, the study evaluates whether observed yield compression is primarily driven by capital value appreciation or by changes in the cost of capital, proxied by the one-year Emirates Interbank Offered Rate (EIBOR). Employing a log-log multiple linear regression framework, the analysis finds strong evidence that rising sale prices are the dominant determinant of declining rental yields, while interest rates play a secondary and statistically weaker role. The findings contribute to the literature on emerging-market housing finance by demonstrating that Dubai's residential market operates primarily as a capital-driven, rather than credit-driven, system, with important implications for investors and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2021-2025年迪拜住宅租金收益率动态的结构性驱动因素，发现房价上涨是租金收益率下降的主要决定因素，而利率仅起次要作用。
AI.research_question: 迪拜住宅租金收益率压缩主要是由资本价值升值驱动，还是由资本成本变化（以EIBOR利率为代表）驱动？
AI.motivation: 研究迪拜住宅市场在疫情后扩张周期中的租金收益率动态，理解新兴市场住房金融系统的运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新兴市场住房金融理论，资本驱动与信用驱动市场系统的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用迪拜土地部门超过150万笔住宅交易数据，采用对数-对数多元线性回归框架进行分析。
AI.findings: 房价上涨是租金收益率下降的主要决定因素，利率仅起次要且统计上较弱的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明迪拜住宅市场主要作为资本驱动而非信用驱动系统运作，丰富了新兴市场住房金融文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供市场动态理解，为政策制定者提供市场调控依据，有助于理解迪拜房地产市场的独特运作机制。

title: Difficult to be fair. Inequality Aversion to Carbon Taxation
affiliations: , University of Lucerne, Interface Politikstudien Forschung Beratung and Interface Politikstudien Forschung Beratung

detail.title: Difficult to be fair. Inequality Aversion to Carbon Taxation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The survey underlying this study received ethical approval from the Human Subjects Committee of the University of Lucerne. All participants provided informed consent prior to participation. The study was conducted in accordance with applicable ethical guidelines for research involving human subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors gratefully declare that financial support was provided by the Swiss Federal Office of Energy through their funding program Energy – Economy – Society (EES).

detail.abstract: This article examines how people perceive the fairness of carbon taxes when distributional outcomes are unequal. While fairness perceptions are known to be crucial for public support of carbon taxation, the mechanisms underlying it remain insufficiently understood. Using a factorial survey experiment with 770 Swiss citizens, we study how inequality aversion affects fairness perceptions, distinguishing between aversion to self-centred inequality and aversion to inequality in society. We find that fairness perceptions are strongly driven by the former: individuals who anticipate benefiting from a carbon tax are significantly more likely to perceive it as fair. At the same time, perceived fairness declines when individuals find themselves better off than others, indicating an aversion to relative advantage. Being worse off than others also reduces perceived fairness, although less consistently. Concerns about unequal outcomes in society play a more limited role and are politically conditioned: right-leaning respondents view unequal outcomes as less fair, whereas left-leaning respondents accept inequality when it disadvantages high emitters. Importantly, these patterns are largely independent of the specific policy sector in which the tax is applied. These findings show that fairness perceptions are shaped less by abstract redistribution principles than by relational comparisons and ideological interpretation. Carbon taxes are therefore more likely to be perceived as fair when distributional outcomes minimise salient disparities in net outcomes and can be credibly justified across the political spectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文通过瑞士770名公民的因子调查实验，研究了碳税公平性感知的机制，发现个人利益得失比社会不平等厌恶对公平感知影响更大，且政治立场调节了对不平等结果的接受度。
AI.research_question: 当分配结果不平等时，人们如何感知碳税的公平性？不平等厌恶（自我中心不平等厌恶与社会不平等厌恶）如何影响公平性感知？
AI.motivation: 公平感知对碳税公众支持至关重要，但其机制尚未充分理解。需要研究不平等厌恶如何塑造公平感知，区分自我中心不平等厌恶和社会不平等厌恶的不同作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不平等厌恶理论（自我中心不平等厌恶 vs. 社会不平等厌恶）、公平感知理论、分配正义理论、政治意识形态对公平判断的影响。
AI.method: 对770名瑞士公民进行因子调查实验，分析不平等厌恶对公平感知的影响，区分自我中心不平等厌恶和社会不平等厌恶的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 公平感知主要由自我中心不平等厌恶驱动：预期从碳税中获益的个人更可能认为其公平；2. 相对优势（比他人更好）会降低公平感知；3. 相对劣势（比他人更差）也会降低公平感知，但作用较弱；4. 对社会不平等结果的关注作用有限且受政治立场调节：右翼受访者认为不平等结果更不公平，左翼受访者接受对高排放者不利的不平等；5. 这些模式基本独立于具体政策领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了自我中心不平等厌恶和社会不平等厌恶对公平感知的不同作用；2. 揭示了公平感知更多由关系比较而非抽象再分配原则塑造；3. 阐明了政治意识形态如何调节对不平等结果的接受度；4. 为碳税公平性感知提供了机制性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 碳税设计应最小化净结果的显著差异；2. 政策制定者需要提供跨政治光谱的可信理由；3. 关注个人相对得失比强调社会整体不平等更有效；4. 为提升碳税公众接受度提供具体策略。

title: Rising Student Employment and Tuition Fees
affiliations: Wilfrid Laurier University

detail.title: Rising Student Employment and Tuition Fees

declarations.declarationOfInterest: na
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not required

detail.abstract: In 1979, less than 30 per cent of full-time university students in Canada worked for pay during the academic term. By 2000 this had risen to 45 per cent. We find that no economic variable other than tuition fees-which can account for half of the rise-can explain this increase. Groups that saw the biggest increases in employment in response to tuition fee increases also had a relatively small enrolment response. The results suggest that the ability to increase earned income during the semester plays an important role in mitigating the effects of fee increases on individuals' enrolment decisions.

AI.tldr: 加拿大大学生学期期间兼职比例从1979年的不到30%上升到2000年的45%，研究发现学费上涨是主要驱动因素（可解释一半的增长），学费上涨对就业影响大的群体入学率下降较小，表明学期期间增加收入能力能缓解学费上涨对入学决策的影响。
AI.research_question: 加拿大大学生学期期间兼职比例大幅上升的原因是什么？特别是学费上涨在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 观察到加拿大全日制大学生在学期期间工作的比例从1979年的不到30%显著上升到2000年的45%，需要探究这一现象背后的驱动因素，特别是经济变量如学费的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本投资理论、教育经济学、学生劳动供给决策理论，关注学费变化对学生就业行为和入学决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 实证分析方法，使用加拿大大学生就业和学费的时间序列数据，通过回归分析识别学费对学期期间就业的影响，并比较不同群体对学费变化的就业和入学反应。
AI.findings: 1. 学费上涨是学期期间就业增加的主要驱动因素，可解释约一半的增长；2. 其他经济变量无法解释这一趋势；3. 对学费上涨就业反应最大的群体入学率下降较小；4. 学期期间增加收入的能力能缓解学费上涨对入学决策的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了学费上涨对学生学期期间就业行为的因果影响；2. 揭示了学生通过增加学期期间收入来应对教育成本上升的适应性行为；3. 为理解教育融资和学生劳动供给决策提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育政策制定者提供了学费政策影响学生行为的实证证据；2. 帮助学生和家庭理解应对学费上涨的策略；3. 为高等教育机构设计学生支持服务提供参考；4. 对劳动力市场政策有启示意义，因为更多学生参与学期期间工作。

title: Factor-Based Performance Attribution: Structural Limits and Double Unidentifiability
affiliations: Independant

detail.title: Factor-Based Performance Attribution: Structural Limits and Double Unidentifiability
detail.abstract: Holdings-based factor attribution routinely applies a multi-factor risk model to a problem it was not designed to solve. We show that this produces a decomposition that is doubly unidentified: the named factor return vector is not uniquely determined by the covariance structure the model estimates, and the reference portfolios that define factor returns are unconstrained replicators that real investment mandates cannot hold. Both failures are structural, not statistical. Observable attribution pathologies (e.g., highly correlated factor and specific contributions) are their predictable consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于持仓的因子归因方法存在结构性缺陷：因子收益向量在协方差结构下不唯一确定，且定义因子收益的参考组合是实际投资无法持有的无约束复制组合，导致归因结果双重不可识别。
AI.research_question: 基于持仓的因子归因方法为什么会产生不可靠的归因结果？其结构性缺陷是什么？
AI.motivation: 实践中广泛使用基于持仓的因子归因方法，但该方法将多因子风险模型应用于其并非设计解决的问题，导致归因结果存在系统性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子归因理论、多因子风险模型、投资组合理论、识别性问题理论
AI.method: 理论分析、数学推导、实证观察
AI.findings: 基于持仓的因子归因存在双重不可识别问题：1）命名的因子收益向量在模型估计的协方差结构下不唯一确定；2）定义因子收益的参考组合是实际投资无法持有的无约束复制组合。这些是结构性而非统计性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了因子归因中的结构性识别问题，提出了"双重不可识别"的理论框架，解释了实践中观察到的归因异常现象（如因子贡献与特定贡献高度相关）。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示投资从业者基于持仓的因子归因方法的局限性，为改进归因方法提供理论基础，帮助投资者更准确地评估投资表现来源。

title: The Urban Blind Spot Aligning Electrification Ambition with Distribution Reality
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Urban Blind Spot Aligning Electrification Ambition with Distribution Reality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, confidential data, or ethical approval requirements.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Medium and low-voltage networks across Europe were not designed for the combined effects of synchronised high-power EV charging and sustained electricity demand growth from data centres and AI-related workloads. In dense urban environments where a substantial share of residents lack private parking and depend on shared or public charging infrastructure, these pressures compress local utilisation margins and heighten sensitivity to reinforcement timing.

Drawing on distribution network ageing data, grid investment requirements, and simulation-based evidence on transformer stress dynamics, this paper defines an emerging “reinforcement gap”: a structural misalignment between electrification adoption velocity and distribution reinforcement cycles. The resulting risk is not immediate systemic failure, but cumulative infrastructure friction expressed through accelerated asset ageing, connection delays, and uneven deployment feasibility across metropolitan districts.

Comparative acceleration pathways demonstrate that compressed electrification timelines amplify coordination challenges between infrastructure expansion and demand growth. Aligning electrification ambition with distribution reality will therefore require spatially informed deployment strategies, improved grid headroom transparency, and stronger coordination between policy frameworks, distribution system operators, and charging infrastructure providers.

Electrification at scale remains technically achievable. Its durability will depend on whether infrastructure pacing is synchronised with policy momentum in high-density urban systems.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了欧洲中低压电网面临的结构性"加固缺口"：电动汽车充电、数据中心和AI负载的同步增长与电网加固周期之间的错配，导致基础设施摩擦风险，需要空间化部署策略和更好的协调机制。
AI.research_question: 欧洲中低压电网如何应对电动汽车充电、数据中心和AI负载同步增长带来的压力？电网加固周期与电气化采用速度之间的结构性错配（"加固缺口"）如何影响城市电网的可持续性？
AI.motivation: 欧洲中低压电网最初设计时未考虑电动汽车同步高功率充电、数据中心和AI相关负载的持续电力需求增长。在密集城市环境中，大量居民缺乏私人停车位，依赖共享或公共充电设施，这些压力压缩了本地利用率余量，增加了对电网加固时机的敏感性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施投资周期理论、电网老化动态模型、电气化采用速度与电网加固周期错配理论（"加固缺口"概念）、城市电网容量约束理论。
AI.method: 基于配电网络老化数据、电网投资需求分析，以及变压器应力动态的仿真证据，进行对比加速路径分析。
AI.findings: 识别出"加固缺口"——电气化采用速度与配电加固周期之间的结构性错配。风险不是立即的系统性故障，而是通过加速资产老化、连接延迟和城市各区部署可行性不均等方式表现的累积性基础设施摩擦。压缩的电气化时间表放大了基础设施扩展与需求增长之间的协调挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"加固缺口"概念框架，解释了电气化采用速度与电网加固周期之间的结构性错配；发展了城市电网容量约束下的电气化采用理论；为基础设施投资周期与需求增长协调提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议需要空间化部署策略、提高电网容量余量透明度、加强政策框架、配电系统运营商和充电基础设施提供商之间的协调；为大范围电气化提供可行的技术路径，但强调基础设施节奏必须与政策动力同步。

title: Farm Size and its Attributes Revisiting an old debate
affiliations: Institute for Human Development and

detail.title: Farm Size and its Attributes Revisiting an old debate

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no potential conflict of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/ or publication of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no financial assistance for the research, authorship, and/ or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This paper revisits the relatively less talked about but yet vehemently argued debate in Indian agriculture compared to earlier, concerning the relationship between farm size and productivity. It then extends the analysis to related dimensions such as profitability and labour use across different farm-size categories so as to through light of the quality of life of the farmers. Using plot-level data from the Cost of Cultivation Surveys for 2021-22, conducted by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India, the study examines these relationships for six major crops across nine key crop producing states representing the diverse agroclimatic regions in the country. The findings indicate a mild positive association between farm size and productivity, much in contrast to the earlier prevailing thought. However, this relationship has substantially weakened by pervasive land fragmentation driven by high demographic pressure and limited employment opportunities outside agricultureall sizes of land yield somewhat similar yields. Next, pronounced regional and crop-specific variations constrain the possibility of drawing uniform or generalisable conclusions regarding the farm size-productivity relationship in India. It follows that there is a case for invoking laws (that already exist), which would permit land consolidation.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了印度农业中农场规模与生产率的关系，发现两者存在轻微正相关，这与早期观点相反。但由于土地碎片化严重，这种关系已大大减弱。研究还发现存在显著的地区和作物差异，因此建议实施土地整合政策。
AI.research_question: 印度农业中农场规模与生产率、盈利能力和劳动力使用之间的关系是什么？这种关系在不同农场规模类别中如何影响农民的生活质量？
AI.motivation: 重新审视印度农业中相对较少讨论但激烈争论的农场规模与生产率关系问题，并将分析扩展到相关维度如盈利能力和劳动力使用，以了解不同农场规模类别农民的生活质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农场规模与生产率关系的理论（包括逆规模-生产率关系理论），土地碎片化理论，以及农业结构转型理论。
AI.method: 使用印度农业和农民福利部2021-22年进行的种植成本调查的田块级数据，分析六个主要作物在九个主要作物生产州的情况，这些州代表了印度不同的农业气候区域。
AI.findings: 1. 农场规模与生产率之间存在轻微正相关关系，与早期普遍观点相反；2. 由于高人口压力和有限非农就业机会导致的普遍土地碎片化，这种关系已大大减弱；3. 存在显著的地区和作物特定差异，难以得出统一结论；4. 所有规模的土地产量相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了印度农业中农场规模与生产率逆相关的传统观点；2. 揭示了土地碎片化对规模-生产率关系的调节作用；3. 强调了农业研究中考虑地区和作物差异的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为土地整合政策提供了实证依据；2. 强调了需要针对不同地区和作物制定差异化政策；3. 为改善农民生活质量提供了政策方向；4. 支持实施现有法律允许的土地整合。

title: The Compute Heat Rate: Quantifying AI-Driven Electricity Price Tolerance and Its Implications for Wholesale Market Repricing
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Compute Heat Rate: Quantifying AI-Driven Electricity Price Tolerance and Its Implications for Wholesale Market Repricing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a practicing energy advisory professional with 15 years of experience in wholesale electricity markets and corporate PPA advisory. This research was conducted independently using exclusively publicly available data. The author has no financial relationships with any data center operators, GPU manufacturers, or electricity market participants that could be perceived to have influenced this study.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence data centers represent a fundamentally new class of electricity demand with price tolerance characteristics that have no historical precedent in wholesale power markets. This paper introduces the Compute Heat Rate (CHR), a metric that quantifies the maximum electricity price at which AI computation remains economically viable, measured in dollars per megawatt-hour (and expressible as a demand-side price tolerance multiple relative to traditional industrial curtailment thresholds). Drawing on publicly available data on GPU economics, cloud computing pricing, and facility cost structures, the CHR is calculated across five workload categories. Results indicate that AI workloads can tolerate electricity prices ranging from approximately $500/MWh for frontier model training to over $53,000/MWh for frontier inference services, with a blended average of approximately $6,350/MWh, representing a 127-fold multiple over the conventional gas heat rate benchmark of approximately $50/MWh. At projected data center capacity of 62 to 134 GW by 2025 to 2030, this price tolerance applies to tens of gigawatts of load that will not curtail at any price level observed in U.S. wholesale markets.

The CHR establishes a theoretical ceiling for wholesale electricity prices in markets where AI-driven data center load constitutes the marginal demand. Combined with the Cost of New Entry (CONE), which sets the long-run equilibrium price floor, the CHR defines a pricing spectrum within which wholesale prices will settle as supply-demand gaps persist. This paper provides a conceptual framework for the CHR, derives the metric from first principles, and presents preliminary empirical evidence from PJM and ERCOT settlement points suggesting a measurable and distinct AI load price component is emerging in wholesale markets. The implications for industrial electricity consumers, forward curve construction, procurement strategy, and financial risk management are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"计算热率"(CHR)指标，量化AI数据中心对电价的承受能力，发现AI负载能承受比传统工业高127倍的电价，这将重塑批发电力市场的定价机制。
AI.research_question: AI数据中心作为新型电力需求，其价格承受能力如何量化？这种价格承受能力对批发电力市场的定价机制有何影响？
AI.motivation: AI数据中心代表一类全新的电力需求，其价格承受特性在批发电力市场中无历史先例，需要新的分析框架来理解其对市场定价的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计算热率(CHR)理论框架，结合新建成本(CONE)形成定价区间理论，CHR设定价格上限，CONE设定价格下限。
AI.method: 基于GPU经济学、云计算定价和设施成本结构的公开数据，计算五个工作负载类别的CHR，并在PJM和ERCOT市场进行实证分析。
AI.findings: AI工作负载的电价承受范围从前沿模型训练的约500美元/MWh到前沿推理服务的超过53,000美元/MWh，平均约6,350美元/MWh，是传统燃气热率基准的127倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出CHR作为量化AI数据中心价格承受能力的新指标，建立AI驱动负载作为边际需求时的批发电价理论上限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业电力消费者、远期曲线构建、采购策略和金融风险管理提供决策框架，预测AI负载将在批发市场中形成可识别的价格成分。

title: Not In My Back Yard! The Effects of Data Centers on Housing Prices
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: Not In My Back Yard! The Effects of Data Centers on Housing Prices
detail.abstract: Data centers have become a focal point of local opposition in the United States, with communities citing environmental, noise, and aesthetic concerns. Using a novel dataset of air permit issuances in Virginia matched to ZIP code-level home price indices, this paper estimates the causal effect of data center permitting on nearby residential property values in a difference-indifferences framework. Across multiple specifications and event-study designs, the estimated effects are economically small and slightly positive, providing no evidence of large negative impacts of data centers on home prices. Confidence intervals rule out substantial price declines, and results are similar for recent permits associated with AI-related facilities. Overall, the findings suggest that data center development appears to have little measurable impact on local housing prices.

AI.tldr: 数据中心许可对附近住宅价格的影响很小且略微正面，没有证据表明数据中心对房价有大的负面影响
AI.research_question: 数据中心许可对附近住宅物业价值有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 数据中心在美国已成为地方反对的焦点，社区担心环境、噪音和美观问题，但缺乏关于数据中心对房地产价值实际影响的实证证据
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）框架来估计数据中心许可对住宅价格的因果效应
AI.method: 使用弗吉尼亚州空气许可发放的新数据集，匹配到邮政编码级别的房价指数，在双重差分框架下进行因果效应估计，包括多种规范和事件研究设计
AI.findings: 估计效应在经济上很小且略微正面，没有证据表明数据中心对房价有大的负面影响；置信区间排除了大幅价格下跌的可能性；与AI相关设施的最新许可结果类似
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于数据中心对房地产价值影响的第一个因果证据，挑战了社区对数据中心负面影响的普遍担忧
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、开发商和社区提供了实证依据，表明数据中心开发对当地房价影响有限，有助于更理性的决策过程

title: Integrating Survey and Administrative Data to Estimate Firms' Turnover in Unplanned Domains: Evidence from the Invind Survey
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Italian National Institute of Statistics (ISTAT), University Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Italian National Institute of Statistics (ISTAT), Bank of Italy and Italian National Institute of Statistics (ISTAT)

detail.title: Integrating Survey and Administrative Data to Estimate Firms' Turnover in Unplanned Domains: Evidence from the Invind Survey

keywords: integration of survey and administrative data

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 995
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study introduces a methodology that combines Banca d’Italia’s Survey of Industrial and Service Firms (Invind) with Istat’s Frame-SBS archive to estimate changes in firms’ turnover for unplanned domains, namely, levels of detail finer than those envisaged in the original sampling design (for instance, economic sectors at the regional level). Linking the two data sources yields a substantial reduction in the Mean Squared Error (MSE) of the estimators, largely driven by the strong temporal autocorrelation of the target variable. In addition to supporting the estimation phase, the Frame-SBS archive can also inform sample design. Our analyses indicate that achieving reliable estimates in currently unplanned domains would require increasing the sample size in the services sector and in specific regions, particularly Lombardy and Lazio.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合意大利银行企业调查与统计局数据，开发了一种估计未规划领域企业营业额变化的方法，显著降低了估计误差，并为样本设计提供指导。
AI.research_question: 如何利用意大利银行企业调查与统计局数据相结合的方法，准确估计未规划领域（如区域层面的经济部门）的企业营业额变化？
AI.motivation: 现有抽样设计无法提供比原计划更细粒度的领域（如区域层面的经济部门）的可靠估计，需要开发新方法来支持这些未规划领域的决策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合调查数据与行政数据的小域估计理论，利用时间自相关特性提高估计精度，以及样本设计优化的统计理论。
AI.method: 将意大利银行工业和服务企业调查（Invind）与意大利统计局Frame-SBS档案数据相结合，通过数据链接构建估计模型，分析均方误差变化，并评估样本设计需求。
AI.findings: 1. 结合两种数据源显著降低了估计器的均方误差，主要归因于目标变量的强时间自相关；2. Frame-SBS档案不仅支持估计阶段，还能指导样本设计；3. 要在当前未规划领域获得可靠估计，需要增加服务业和特定地区（特别是伦巴第和拉齐奥）的样本量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合调查数据与行政数据的小域估计新方法，证明了时间自相关在提高估计精度中的关键作用，扩展了小域估计理论在未规划领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更细粒度领域的企业营业额变化估计工具，指导调查样本设计的优化，特别是针对服务业和特定地区的样本分配，提高统计数据的实用性和决策支持能力。

title: The Effects of US Tariffs on Italian Firms: An Ex-ante Micro-Level Perspective
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Banca d’Italia

detail.title: The Effects of US Tariffs on Italian Firms: An Ex-ante Micro-Level Perspective

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 994
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This analysis provides an ex-ante assessment of the potential effects of the 2025 US tariff shock on Italian firms, combining granular data on trade, firm balance sheets, and supply-chain linkages. First, we highlight some key specific features of the US tariff shock that can affect the impact on Italian firms. Then, we focus on three key mechanisms: (i) the direct effects on Italian exporters to the United States; (ii) the indirect effects on Italian suppliers of those exporters; and (iii) the trade deflection of Chinese exports displaced from the US to other world markets. We also find that, for direct exporters, the tariffs are expected to reduce profit margins by about 0.3 percentage points on average in the short run, with limited impact on firms’ overall profitability. Most domestic suppliers have a low exposure to the US market through their customers, though a subset of highly exposed small firms may face sharper profit declines, potentially affecting local employment. Finally, trade deflection resulting from the redirection of Chinese exports displaced from the US market poses moderate, but non-negligible, risks for Italian exporters, concentrated in sectors that differ from those more directly exposed to US markets. Conversely, increased imports of intermediate goods from China could lower input costs for some Italian producers.

AI.tldr: 本文对2025年美国关税冲击对意大利企业的潜在影响进行事前评估，结合贸易、企业资产负债表和供应链关联的细粒度数据，分析直接出口效应、间接供应商效应和中国出口贸易转移三个关键机制。
AI.research_question: 2025年美国关税冲击对意大利企业会产生怎样的潜在影响？具体通过哪些机制产生影响？
AI.motivation: 评估即将到来的美国关税政策对意大利经济的潜在影响，为政策制定者和企业提供前瞻性分析，帮助理解全球贸易政策变化对特定国家企业的传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论、关税传导机制、供应链关联分析、贸易转移效应、企业异质性理论
AI.method: 结合细粒度贸易数据、企业资产负债表数据和供应链关联数据的实证分析，采用事前评估方法，分析直接效应、间接效应和贸易转移三个机制。
AI.findings: 1) 直接出口商短期利润边际平均下降约0.3个百分点，但对整体盈利能力影响有限；2) 大多数国内供应商通过客户对美国市场暴露度低，但部分高度暴露的小企业可能面临更大幅度的利润下降，可能影响当地就业；3) 中国出口从美国市场转移带来的贸易转移对意大利出口商构成中等但不可忽视的风险，集中在与美国市场直接暴露不同的行业；4) 从中国进口的中间品增加可能降低部分意大利生产商的投入成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了关税冲击传导机制的理论框架，纳入直接出口效应、间接供应链效应和贸易转移效应三个维度；2) 提供了企业异质性在关税冲击中作用的新证据；3) 丰富了事前评估方法在贸易政策分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为意大利政策制定者提供关税冲击影响的具体量化评估；2) 帮助企业识别风险暴露程度和应对策略；3) 为中小企业提供针对性预警；4) 为贸易政策调整提供实证依据。

title: Coca's Return and the American Overdose Fallout
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), Department of Economics, University of Oregon - Department of Economics, Old Dominion University and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: Coca's Return and the American Overdose Fallout
detail.abstract: Colombian coca cultivation fell dramatically between 2000 and 2015, a period that saw intense U.S.-backed eradication and interdiction efforts. That progress reversed in 2015, when peace talks and legal rulings in Colombia opened enforcement gaps. Coca plantation has since increased to record levels, which coincided with a sharp rise in cocaine-related overdose deaths in the U.S. We estimate how much of that rise can be causally attributed to Colombia's new coca boom. Leveraging the unforeseen coca supply shock and cross-county differences in pre-shock cocaine exposure, we find that the surge in supply caused an immediate rise in overdose mortality in the U.S. Our analysis estimates on the order of 1,000-1,500 additional U.S. deaths per year in the late 2010s can be attributed to Colombia's cocaine boom. Implicit annual loss in American statistical life values about $48,000 per hectare of cultivation in Colombia. If left untamed, the current level of coca cultivation (over 230,000 ha in 2022) may impose on the order of $10 billion per year in costs via overdose fatalities.

AI.tldr: 哥伦比亚古柯种植在2015年后激增，导致美国可卡因供应冲击，造成每年约1000-1500例额外过量死亡，经济损失约100亿美元/年

AI.motivation: 哥伦比亚古柯种植在2015年后急剧增加，同时美国可卡因相关过量死亡人数激增，需要量化两者之间的因果关系

AI.method: 利用哥伦比亚意外的古柯供应冲击和各县在冲击前的可卡因暴露差异进行因果估计
AI.findings: 哥伦比亚可卡因供应激增导致美国每年额外1000-1500例过量死亡，每公顷古柯种植隐含约48,000美元的生命价值损失
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了国际毒品供应冲击与国内过量死亡率之间的因果联系，量化了毒品政策的外部性
AI.practical_contributions: 为毒品政策制定提供成本效益分析依据，显示哥伦比亚古柯种植控制对美国公共健康的重要性

A Physical Audit Protocol for GCC Sovereign AI Assets: 
Hedging Tech & Geopolitical Risks in Extremes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived as influencing the objectivity or integrity of this independent technical audit framework. All conceptual frameworks, thermodynamic logic derivations, and strategic conclusions were independently authored and verified by the human author. The final output has been rigorously audited to ensure the absence of AI-generated hallucinations and to maintain the integrity of the Sovereign Audit Protocol (SAP).

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces The Sovereign AI Physical Audit Framework, a definitive protocol designed to hedge technical and geopolitical risks for compute infrastructure in the extreme physical environment of the GCC. It argues that transposing conventional real estate investment models to GPU clusters constitutes an asset-class category error, leading to undetected "Silent Impairment" and massive "Sovereign Alpha Evaporation" when perishable compute assets operate at 45°C. 

The framework redefines infrastructure audit across three orthogonal dimensions. First, it establishes Thermodynamic Solvency, mandating a strict 2.0 L/s liquid cooling flow benchmark to prevent chip-level thermal throttling and physical default. Second, it enforces Trust Boundary Integrity, utilizing an Out-of-Band (OOB) Physical Isolation architecture to decouple supply chain geopolitical risks and satisfy strict export control (BIS) compliance. Third, it formalizes a Time Arbitrage model, demonstrating how vascularneural asynchronous deployment mitigates computational half-life decay and captures a 24-week Alpha Window. 

Ultimately, the paper translates thermodynamic first principles into deployable commercial adjudication instruments-the Sovereign Audit Protocol (SAP)-asserting that any performance commitment unverifiable at the physical layer is, by definition, an undisclosed asset impairment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了《主权AI物理审计框架》，这是一个针对海湾合作委员会极端物理环境中计算基础设施的技术和地缘政治风险对冲协议。该框架通过三个正交维度重新定义基础设施审计：热力学偿付能力、信任边界完整性和时间套利模型，最终转化为可部署的商业裁决工具——主权审计协议。
AI.research_question: 如何为海湾合作委员会极端物理环境中的GPU集群计算基础设施开发一个能够对冲技术和地缘政治风险的物理审计框架？
AI.motivation: 将传统房地产投资模型直接应用于GPU集群是一个资产类别错误，导致在45°C高温环境下出现"静默减值"和"主权阿尔法蒸发"问题，需要专门的物理审计框架来识别和防范这些风险。

1. 资产类别理论：GPU集群不同于传统房地产，需要专门的审计框架
2. 热力学第一原理：计算基础设施的物理性能受热力学规律约束
3. 地缘政治风险理论：供应链安全与出口控制合规性
4. 时间套利理论：计算资产的半衰期衰减与阿尔法窗口捕获
AI.method: 提出一个三维正交审计框架：热力学偿付能力（2.0 L/s液冷流量基准）、信任边界完整性（带外物理隔离架构）、时间套利模型（血管神经异步部署）。最终转化为可部署的主权审计协议作为商业裁决工具。
AI.findings:
1. 传统房地产投资模型不适用于GPU集群，会导致资产类别错误
2. 在45°C高温环境下，计算资产会出现"静默减值"和"主权阿尔法蒸发"
3. 通过三维审计框架可以有效识别和防范这些风险
4. 物理层不可验证的性能承诺本质上就是未披露的资产减值
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了主权AI物理审计的理论框架
2. 建立了计算基础设施的热力学偿付能力概念
3. 发展了信任边界完整性的理论模型
4. 形式化了计算资产的时间套利理论
AI.practical_contributions:

2. 制定了具体的液冷流量基准（2.0 L/s）
3. 提出了带外物理隔离架构满足出口控制合规
4. 开发了血管神经异步部署模型以捕获24周阿尔法窗口

title: A Guide to Incorporating Capacity Constraints into Upward Pricing Pressure (UPP) Analysis
affiliations: Charles River Associates (CRA) - Competition Practice

detail.title: A Guide to Incorporating Capacity Constraints into Upward Pricing Pressure (UPP) Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper provides a guide to antitrust economists to incorporate capacity constraints into Upward Pricing Pressure (UPP) analysis. As shown, capacity constraints can be modelled in (at least) three ways: (i) strict capacity limits, which once they are reached, firms cannot serve new customers; (ii) fuzzy limits in which firms have a partial ability to serve new customers and must reject a share; and (iii) upward-sloping marginal costs as output approaches capacity. UPP formulas are shown for each of these cases, also providing numerical examples and practical considerations to guide the modelling choice.

AI.tldr: 本文为反垄断经济学家提供了将产能约束纳入向上定价压力分析的指南，展示了三种建模方式及其对应的UPP公式。
AI.research_question: 如何在向上定价压力分析中有效纳入产能约束？
AI.motivation: 传统UPP分析通常假设企业有无限产能，但现实中企业面临产能约束，忽略这一因素可能导致反垄断分析不准确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向上定价压力理论、产能约束理论、边际成本理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，提出三种产能约束建模方式：严格产能限制、模糊限制、向上倾斜的边际成本，并推导相应的UPP公式。
AI.findings: 1. 严格产能限制下，企业达到产能后无法服务新客户；2. 模糊限制下，企业只能部分服务新客户；3. 向上倾斜边际成本下，成本随产量接近产能而增加。每种情况都有相应的UPP公式。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了UPP分析的理论框架，首次系统地将产能约束纳入分析，提供了三种具体的建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断经济学家提供了实用的分析工具和数值示例，帮助他们在实际案例中更准确地评估并购的竞争效应。

title: The Architecture of Freedom Intelligence: A Design Theory of Path Availability
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Architecture of Freedom Intelligence: A Design Theory of Path Availability

declarations.funderStatement: no funding.

publicationDetails.detailsText: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18636095

detail.abstract: Across the history of science, first-cause theories name matter, energy, spacetime, or law-yet the Big Bang itself presupposes the possibility of occurring. Information presupposes distinguishable states. Causation presupposes counterfactual alternatives. Every framework assumes path availability, then describes traversal. This article reverses the priority: Freedom-the structural availability of paths-is proposed as the ontological primitive. Paths precede perception. Flight did not create transcontinental routes; Earth's atmosphere always permitted them. Vaccines did not create biochemical pathways; molecular dynamics made them structurally possible. Highways reveal geographic traversability terrain already afforded. Five empirical theses follow: (1) Freedom as irreducible cause, (2) the Law of Freedom F = P/D (navigability as differentiation divided by resistance), (3) the generative order: availability produces logic, logic structures relations, relations stabilize as physics, (4) their mutual dependency, (5) the Lightest Path Principle-systems across all domains navigate toward minimum perceived resistance, making design the engineering of possibility itself. What if the condition that makes reality possible is not substance or law, but possibility itself? If not Freedom, then what?

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"自由"（路径的结构可用性）作为本体论原初概念，认为可能性先于实体和法则，并推导出五个经验命题来解释现实生成的基本原理。
AI.research_question: 什么是现实的基本本体论原初？如果传统理论将物质、能量、时空或法则视为第一因，那么是否存在更根本的可能性条件？
AI.motivation: 传统科学理论（如大爆炸理论、信息论、因果论）都预设了路径可用性，但从未将这种"可能性条件"本身作为研究对象。作者认为需要逆转这种优先顺序，将"自由"（路径的结构可用性）作为更基本的本体论概念。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 自由本体论：将"自由"（路径的结构可用性）作为本体论原初
2. 生成顺序理论：可用性产生逻辑，逻辑结构关系，关系稳定为物理
3. 自由定律：F = P/D（导航性=分化/阻力）
4. 最轻路径原则：系统在所有领域都朝着最小感知阻力方向导航
AI.method: 概念分析与理论推导方法。通过分析科学史上的第一因理论（物质、能量、时空、法则），指出它们都预设了可能性条件，然后通过类比（飞行路线、疫苗、高速公路）论证路径可用性的优先性，最后系统性地推导出五个经验命题。
AI.findings:
1. 自由是不可约的原因
2. 自由定律 F = P/D 成立
3. 生成顺序：可用性→逻辑→关系→物理
4. 这些要素相互依赖
5. 最轻路径原则普遍适用
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了全新的本体论框架，将"自由"（可能性）置于实体和法则之前
2. 建立了自由定律和生成顺序理论
3. 为跨学科研究提供了统一的概念框架
4. 挑战了传统科学哲学中的因果和本体论预设
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为工程设计提供了新视角：设计就是可能性本身的工程化
2. 为系统优化提供了理论指导（最轻路径原则）
3. 为创新和问题解决提供了方法论：关注可能性条件而非现有解决方案
4. 为跨领域（从物理到社会系统）的分析提供了统一工具

title: Regulating ESG Disclosure: Capital Allocation and Investor Heterogeneity
affiliations: Research Department, University of Chicago and University of Luxembourg

detail.title: Regulating ESG Disclosure: Capital Allocation and Investor Heterogeneity

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBB WP (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how sustainability disclosure regulation affects mutual fund flows and portfolio choices, accounting for investor heterogeneity. Guided by a model of ESG investing under uncertainty, we exploit the introduction of the European Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR) as a natural experiment, using granular fund–investor holdings data. We show that funds subject to higher disclosure requirements attract significantly larger inflows, particularly for funds with higher pre-regulation uncertainty. Institutional investors respond more strongly than retail investors, and investor trust in environmental labels amplifies these effects. We also find evidence that disclosure induces fund managers to increase portfolio greenness.

AI.tldr: 欧盟可持续金融披露法规（SFDR）通过降低ESG不确定性，显著增加了受监管基金的流入，机构投资者反应更强烈，同时促使基金经理提高投资组合绿色程度。
AI.research_question: 可持续披露法规如何影响共同基金的资金流入和投资组合选择？投资者异质性在其中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG投资兴起，监管机构推出披露要求以解决信息不对称问题，但缺乏关于这些法规实际影响的经验证据，特别是对基金流动和投资组合决策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性下的ESG投资模型，强调信息披露如何降低投资者对基金ESG特征的不确定性，从而影响投资决策。
AI.method: 利用欧盟SFDR实施作为自然实验，使用细粒度的基金-投资者持仓数据，分析法规前后基金流动和投资组合变化。
AI.findings: 1. 受更高披露要求的基金获得显著更大资金流入；2. 法规前不确定性较高的基金效应更强；3. 机构投资者反应比零售投资者更强烈；4. 投资者对环境标签的信任放大效应；5. 披露促使基金经理提高投资组合绿色程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为ESG披露法规的有效性提供实证支持；2. 揭示投资者异质性在ESG投资决策中的作用；3. 证明信息披露如何影响基金层面的资本配置。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计ESG披露框架提供依据；2. 帮助基金公司理解披露要求对资金流动的影响；3. 指导投资者如何利用ESG信息进行投资决策。

title: TFP Elsie: Operationalising the Elsie Agenda for Canada

detail.title: TFP Elsie: Operationalising the Elsie Agenda for Canada

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a member of the Canadian Armed Forces.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
This paper examines Canada’s Elsie Initiative for Women in Peace Operations, a flagship component of the Trudeau administration’s feminist foreign policy, and analyzes the role of the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) in implementing this initiative within a Whole-of-Government (WoG) framework. Drawing on primary and secondary sources, the paper focuses on the operational activities of Task Force PRESENCE Elsie (TFP Elsie) and evaluates the challenges associated with achieving the initiative’s objectives.

The analysis advances the argument that, despite persistent constraints including Canada’s and the CAF’s own history of systemic and structural gender inequalities, the CAF has made a constructive contribution to the implementation of the Women, Peace and Security (WPS) agenda through TFP Elsie. Evidence for this contribution is visible in episodic deployments of TFP Elsie personnel partnering with the Ghana Armed Forces (GAF) and in complementarities between CAF activities and other components of Canada’s Elsie Initiative.

At the same time, the paper identifies areas for improvement. In particular, the CAF must continue advancing its internal culture change agenda and demonstrate tangible adherence to the principles of the Elsie Initiative in order to sustain credibility when engaging partner militaries. The paper contributes to scholarship on Women, Peace and Security, feminist foreign policy, peace operations, and the role of national militaries in implementing gender integration initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了加拿大"Elsie和平行动女性倡议"这一特鲁多政府女权外交政策的旗舰项目，探讨了加拿大武装部队在全政府框架下实施该倡议的角色，特别关注特遣部队PRESENCE Elsie的运作活动及其面临的挑战。
AI.research_question: 加拿大武装部队在全政府框架下如何实施Elsie和平行动女性倡议？特遣部队PRESENCE Elsie在实现该倡议目标方面面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 加拿大特鲁多政府推行女权外交政策，Elsie倡议是其旗舰项目，旨在促进女性在和平行动中的参与。研究加拿大武装部队在该倡议实施中的角色，有助于理解军事机构如何推动性别平等议程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性、和平与安全议程；女权外交政策理论；全政府框架；和平行动理论；性别整合倡议实施理论
AI.method: 基于一手和二手资料的分析方法，聚焦特遣部队PRESENCE Elsie的运作活动，评估实现倡议目标面临的挑战
AI.findings: 尽管加拿大和加拿大武装部队存在系统性性别不平等的历史限制，但通过特遣部队PRESENCE Elsie与加纳武装部队的合作部署，加拿大武装部队为女性、和平与安全议程的实施做出了建设性贡献。同时发现需要改进的领域，特别是加拿大武装部队需要推进内部文化变革议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了女性、和平与安全、女权外交政策、和平行动以及国家军队在实施性别整合倡议中的角色等学术研究领域
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大武装部队继续推进内部文化变革提供建议，强调需要切实遵守Elsie倡议原则以维持与伙伴军队合作时的可信度

title: The Nonlinear Dynamics of Relative Collateralized-Uncollateralized Funding Activity
affiliations: Bank of Mexico, Universidad de Chile, Bank of England and University of Chile

detail.title: The Nonlinear Dynamics of Relative Collateralized-Uncollateralized Funding Activity
detail.abstract: We empirically examine the dynamics of relative collateralized–uncollateralized funding activity by comparing periods of high and low-to-moderate systemic stress. During low-to-moderate systemic stress, increases in systemic risk or the availability of assets accepted as collateral (government bonds) are associated with a shift in funding from the uncollateralized money market (UM) to the collateralized money market (CM). This shift occurs because higher systemic risk raises default probabilities, favoring collateralized lending, while greater collateral availability facilitates CM use. These substitution dynamics are desirable since they can potentially strengthen financial stability by ensuring that at least one segment continues to provide funding under adverse economic conditions. However, these favorable dynamics do not always hold. During periods of high systemic stress, when the broader economy becomes fragile, government bonds used as collateral can be riskier and more information-sensitive—despite being backed by national governments—weakening the protection afforded by collateralized loans. As a result, the beneficial substitution between the UM and the CM can fail during severe systemic uncertainty—exactly when funding is most needed to meet obligations and mitigate economic freezes. Furthermore, during periods of high systemic stress, we show that an increase in systemic risk is associated with a shift in credit toward financially robust borrowers—those with high capital, strong profitability, and low credit risk—in the UM relative to the CM. This is because, in turbulent periods, counterparty strength is crucial, whereas the value of the collateral used in the CM becomes increasingly uncertain.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在低至中度系统性压力时期，抵押融资与非抵押融资之间存在替代关系，有助于金融稳定；但在高系统性压力时期，这种替代关系可能失效，且信贷会向财务稳健的借款人集中。
AI.research_question: 系统性压力水平如何影响抵押融资市场与非抵押融资市场之间的替代关系？在高系统性压力时期，这种替代关系是否仍然有效？
AI.motivation: 理解不同系统性压力水平下抵押与非抵押融资市场的动态关系，对于评估金融体系的稳定性和政策制定具有重要意义，特别是在危机时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统性风险理论、抵押品价值理论、信息不对称理论，分析不同压力环境下抵押融资与非抵押融资的替代机制。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，比较分析高系统性压力时期与低至中度系统性压力时期的数据，考察系统性风险、抵押品可用性等因素对融资市场动态的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 低至中度压力时期：系统性风险增加或抵押品（国债）可用性提高会导致资金从非抵押市场转向抵押市场，这种替代有助于金融稳定。2. 高压力时期：国债作为抵押品变得风险更高、信息更敏感，抵押保护作用减弱，替代关系失效。3. 高压力时期：信贷会向资本充足、盈利能力强、信用风险低的财务稳健借款人集中。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了系统性压力水平对抵押与非抵押融资市场替代关系的调节作用。2. 提出了抵押品价值在高压力时期的不确定性理论。3. 丰富了危机时期信贷分配的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构在不同压力环境下制定融资市场政策提供依据。2. 帮助金融机构在危机时期优化融资策略。3. 为政策制定者设计危机应对机制提供参考，特别是在抵押品价值不确定性增加的情况下。

title: The Nexus of Commercial Certitude: Singapore Contract Law in the Landscape of International Arbitration
affiliations: Senior Judicial Magistrate at Bangladesh Judicial Service

detail.title: The Nexus of Commercial Certitude: Singapore Contract Law in the Landscape of International Arbitration
detail.abstract: Authored by Judge Nazmul Hasan, Senior Judicial Magistrate (11th BJS) and Prime Minister Gold Medalist, this treatise examines Singapore’s contract law within international arbitration. It explores the "Nexus of Commercial Certitude," bridging 19th-century codes with modern pro-arbitration frameworks to ensure global transactional stability and legal legibility.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨新加坡合同法在国际仲裁中的适用，分析19世纪法典与现代支持仲裁框架之间的连接，旨在确保全球交易稳定性和法律可读性。
AI.research_question: 新加坡合同法如何在国际仲裁中运作，以及19世纪法典与现代支持仲裁框架如何相互作用以确保全球交易稳定？
AI.motivation: 随着全球商业交易日益复杂，需要确保合同法律框架在国际仲裁中的确定性和可预测性，以促进跨境商业活动。
AI.theoretical_framework: "商业确定性联结"理论，连接19世纪法典传统与现代支持仲裁的法律框架，分析法律确定性与商业稳定性之间的关系。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究、比较法分析，结合历史法典与现代仲裁实践的比较研究。
AI.findings: 新加坡合同法在国际仲裁中提供了高度确定性的框架，19世纪法典原则与现代支持仲裁制度有效结合，增强了全球交易的稳定性和可预测性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"商业确定性联结"理论框架，解释了历史法律传统如何与现代仲裁实践融合，为国际商事法律理论提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际商业从业者提供了新加坡仲裁法律环境的实用指南，帮助企业和法律从业者更好地理解和利用新加坡的国际仲裁框架。

title: Art and the Machine: Why People Devalue AI-Generated Creative Work
affiliations: and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Art and the Machine: Why People Devalue AI-Generated Creative Work

declarations.ethicsApproval: Research protocols were approved by the Social and Behavioral Sciences Institutional Review Board at the University of Chicago. Participants gave informed consent to participate in all studies, and consent was obtained to publish all information and image(s) in an online open access publication reported hereafter.

detail.abstract: While GenAI has expanded the possibilities of artistic creation, its use has sparked controversy among artists and audiences alike. The psychological mechanisms underlying this reported aversion—and whether it shapes consequential behavior—remain poorly understood. We ran preregistered, incentive-compatible auctions where participants bid to receive physical art prints varying randomly in described AI involvement (N = 351). Our findings suggest that the value of human-made art partly derives from its perceived exclusivity, which even minimal AI involvement erodes. People consistently devalued artwork believed to be made with AI; critically, this gap shrunk when pieces were described as mass-produced. Responses to AI involvement were nonlinear: people showed outsized aversion to even minimal amounts of AI usage, consistent with psychological theories of contamination. These findings advance understanding of the interplay between human and AI creativity, pointing to the importance people place on pure human involvement in creative processes.

AI.tldr: 研究发现人们对AI参与创作的艺术品存在心理排斥，这种排斥源于人类艺术的"纯粹性"价值感知。即使是最低程度的AI参与也会显著降低艺术品价值，这种效应在艺术品被描述为批量生产时会减弱。研究揭示了人类对AI参与创作的非线性厌恶模式，符合心理污染理论。
AI.research_question: 人们对AI参与创作的艺术品是否存在心理排斥？这种排斥的心理机制是什么？它如何影响艺术品的价值评估？
AI.motivation: 虽然生成式AI扩展了艺术创作的可能性，但其使用在艺术家和观众中引发了争议。人们对AI参与创作的艺术品的心理排斥机制及其对实际行为的影响尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 人类艺术的"纯粹性"价值理论：人类艺术的价值部分源于其感知的排他性；2) 心理污染理论：即使微小的"污染"（AI参与）也会导致显著的价值贬损；3) 稀缺性理论：批量生产会降低艺术品的感知价值。
AI.method: 采用预注册、激励相容的拍卖实验，351名参与者对描述不同AI参与程度的实体艺术印刷品进行竞价。艺术品随机分配AI参与描述（从无AI到有AI参与），并控制批量生产描述。
AI.findings: 1) 人们持续贬低被认为有AI参与的艺术品价值；2) 当艺术品被描述为批量生产时，AI参与的价值差距缩小；3) 对AI参与的反应呈非线性：即使是最低程度的AI使用也会引起过度的厌恶，符合心理污染理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了人类对AI参与创作的心理排斥机制；2) 验证了心理污染理论在AI-人类创造力交互中的应用；3) 提出了人类艺术价值的"纯粹性"框架；4) 展示了AI参与与艺术品价值评估的非线性关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为艺术家和艺术市场理解AI艺术品的接受度提供实证依据；2) 为AI艺术创作策略提供指导；3) 为艺术教育和技术伦理讨论提供参考；4) 帮助理解公众对AI参与创意过程的心理反应。

title: Easy Money? Refunding the Second Liberty Loan

detail.title: Easy Money? Refunding the Second Liberty Loan
detail.abstract: Upturning long-standing lore related to the 'easy money' policy of the Federal Reserve Banks, this paper attributes the boom in U.S. stock prices that began in 1927 to the sudden redemption of the Second Liberty Loan. Described as 'one of the largest government operations conducted during peacetime,' the Treasury's programme for retiring the Second Liberty Loan not only unlocked a wall of reinvestment, which it steered into stocks by structurally-lowering the long-term rate, but also impressed itself on the monetary policy of the Federal Reserve Banks.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了传统观点，认为1927年美国股市繁荣并非源于美联储的"宽松货币政策"，而是由财政部赎回第二自由贷款所引发，这一大规模政府操作通过降低长期利率引导资金流向股市，并影响了美联储的货币政策。
AI.research_question: 1927年美国股市繁荣的真正驱动因素是什么？是传统认为的美联储"宽松货币政策"，还是财政部赎回第二自由贷款的操作？
AI.motivation: 挑战关于美联储"宽松货币政策"导致1927年股市繁荣的传统观点，揭示财政政策在金融市场中的重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策与财政政策对金融市场的影响机制，利率传导机制，政府债务管理对资本市场的影响。
AI.method: 历史分析，政策事件分析，利率与股价的关联性研究，政府债务操作对市场流动性的影响评估。
AI.findings: 财政部赎回第二自由贷款的操作通过降低长期利率释放了大量再投资资金流向股市，这一财政政策操作不仅直接影响市场，还间接影响了美联储的货币政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新评估财政政策在金融市场中的作用，挑战货币政策主导的传统观点，提出政府债务管理对资本市场的重要影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了财政政策影响金融市场的历史案例，强调财政与货币政策的协同作用，对当前政府债务管理和市场干预具有借鉴意义。

title:
Presidential Immunity:
A Lesson from Corporate Law
affiliations: Florida State University - College of Law

detail.title:
Presidential Immunity:
A Lesson from Corporate Law
detail.abstract:
In Trump v. United States, the Supreme Court for the first time recognized a presumptive criminal immunity for former Presidents’ official acts. The Court grounded that presumption not in constitutional text or historical consensus, but in functional concerns about executive “energy,” institutional competence, and the chilling effects of post-office prosecution. Yet it declined to articulate when—or how—that presumption may be rebutted. The result is a consequential doctrinal gap in precisely the domain where structural clarity matters most.

This Article argues that the functional logic of Trump requires a structural limitation grounded in electoral legitimacy. Because the Court justified immunity as a mechanism for preserving democratic governance, presumptive immunity must yield where official acts interfere with the electoral process that confers and renews executive authority. The franchise is not merely another policy domain; it is the constitutional mechanism through which executive power is legitimated.

To operationalize this limit, the Article draws on corporate law’s treatment of electoral entrenchment. Under the Blasius doctrine, courts withdraw deference when directors act to impair the shareholder franchise—the mechanism that legitimates managerial authority. The doctrine is narrow, rarely outcome-determinative, and powerful primarily as a structural signal and deterrent. It demonstrates how abstention doctrines can remain robust while yielding in the face of threats to electoral accountability.

The Article does not contend that Presidents are fiduciaries in the private-law sense, nor does it invite routine judicial supervision of executive discretion. It proposes a limited structural constraint derived from the Court’s own methodological commitments. Where official acts interfere with elections, presumptive immunity ceases to serve its justificatory function. In that narrow but critical domain, the presumption must give way.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，最高法院在特朗普诉美国案中确立的前总统官方行为刑事豁免权存在结构性缺陷，需要基于选举合法性原则加以限制，借鉴公司法中的选举权保护理论，在官方行为干涉选举时应取消豁免权。
AI.research_question: 最高法院在特朗普诉美国案中确立的前总统官方行为刑事豁免权应如何受到结构性限制，特别是在涉及选举干预的情况下？
AI.motivation: 最高法院首次承认前总统官方行为享有推定刑事豁免权，但这一推定基于功能性考量而非宪法文本或历史共识，且未阐明何时或如何推翻这一推定，在需要结构性明确性的领域留下了重要的法律空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 选举合法性理论：行政权力通过选举过程获得和更新合法性；2. 公司法中的Blasius原则：当董事行为损害股东选举权时，法院撤回尊重；3. 功能性宪法解释方法。
AI.method: 理论分析和类比推理，将公司法中的选举权保护原则（Blasius原则）应用于宪法语境，提出结构性限制框架。
AI.findings: 基于最高法院的功能性逻辑，推定豁免权必须在官方行为干涉选举过程时让位，因为选举是行政权力合法化的宪法机制。公司法中的选举权保护原则为这一限制提供了操作性框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将选举合法性原则引入总统豁免权理论；2. 建立公司法与宪法之间的跨领域理论联系；3. 为功能性宪法解释提供具体应用框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法院提供评估总统豁免权案件的具体标准；2. 在选举干预领域建立明确的豁免权限制；3. 维护选举过程的完整性，防止行政权力滥用。

title: The Great Crash Revisited: Undigested Securities and the Origins of the Panic

detail.title: The Great Crash Revisited: Undigested Securities and the Origins of the Panic
detail.abstract: This paper identifies the proximate cause of the Great Crash as a colossal overhang of unsold stocks being floated with brokers' loans by underwriters. Reflected in a structural decline in the call rate for a fortnight, the dislocation was targeted by short-sellers, who triggered the first (of three) downdrafts. With the rate path shaped by the initial retreat among underwriters, subsequent onslaughts were driven by the withdrawal of credit by non-bank lenders acting on profit motives. Encompassing an estimated 10.0 million stockholders, the resultant damages explain a lost generation of American shareholders.

AI.tldr: 本文认为1929年大崩盘的直接原因是承销商通过经纪人贷款大量抛售未售出股票，导致市场结构失衡。短期利率下降吸引了卖空者，引发了第一次下跌。随后非银行贷款机构基于利润动机撤资，加剧了后续抛售。约1000万股东受损，导致美国一代人远离股市。
AI.research_question: 1929年大崩盘（Great Crash）的直接原因是什么？市场结构失衡如何引发连锁反应导致崩盘？
AI.motivation: 理解1929年股市大崩盘的具体机制和直接原因，解释为何这次崩盘导致美国一代投资者远离股市，为金融市场稳定性提供历史借鉴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场结构失衡理论、信贷周期理论、行为金融学（卖空行为）、机构投资者行为理论
AI.method: 历史数据分析、市场结构分析、利率路径追踪、信贷流动研究、投资者行为观察
