detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Agency Alignment Design (AAD), a formal introductory theoretical framework for analyzing decision environments in which establishing dominance (D) through alignment (A(t)) to truth-state (t) by independent agency within persistent, juridically enforced, normatively final, rules-based, valence-neutral, causally non-strategic endogenous environment enforcement (E) is a prerequisite for viability under persistent, causally non-strategic, valence neutral exogenous environment enforcement (E).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"代理对齐设计(AAD)"理论框架，用于分析在特定决策环境中，通过独立代理对真实状态的持续对齐来建立主导地位的必要性。
AI.research_question: 在具有特定环境执行特征的决策环境中，独立代理如何通过对真实状态的持续对齐来建立主导地位？
AI.motivation: 需要建立一个理论框架来分析那些要求代理在特定环境约束下通过持续对齐真实状态来建立主导地位的决策环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理对齐设计(AAD)框架，包含主导地位(D)、对齐函数A(t)、真实状态(t)、内源性环境执行(E)和外源性环境执行(E)等核心概念。
AI.method: 形式化理论框架构建，通过概念定义和逻辑关系分析来建立理论模型。
AI.findings: 提出了一个完整的理论框架，明确了在特定环境执行条件下，代理通过对真实状态的持续对齐来建立主导地位的必要条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了代理对齐设计(AAD)理论框架；2) 形式化了主导地位与对齐的关系；3) 区分了内源性和外源性环境执行的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计需要在特定环境约束下确保代理行为有效性的决策系统提供了理论指导。

title: Grief, Instinct, and the Limits of Analytical Frameworks in Crisis Decision-Making
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Grief, Instinct, and the Limits of Analytical Frameworks in Crisis Decision-Making

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Director of Preparedness at Integrated Solutions Consulting (ISC), whose proprietary Odysseus™ platform is referenced in this paper. This relationship is disclosed in the manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This autoethnographic study is based solely on the author's own professional experience and does not involve human subjects research. No IRB approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted as independent scholarly work.

detail.abstract: This autoethnographic analysis examines a human-added word—"please"—to an AI-generated communication during acute bereavement, illuminating structural limits in emergency management's analytical frameworks. Extending vulnerability scholarship, it argues that the field over-prioritizes codified, compliance-driven systems (the "90%") while undervaluing embodied crisis knowledge—the experiential judgment under duress that determines outcomes when plans confront reality. AI excels at analytical optimization but cannot originate state-dependent responses rooted in lived human experience. Implications address expertise, credentialing, preparedness, and AI integration. As AI commoditizes the 90%, embodied knowledge—linking individual duress to broader social vulnerability—becomes the critical differentiator. This autoethnographic reflection extends vulnerability scholarship by examining how embodied, state-dependent knowledge operates within professional crisis judgment, revealing gaps in how the field operationalizes social processes at the individual level.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自传民族志分析，探讨了在急性丧亲期间人类为AI生成通信添加"请"字的行为，揭示了应急管理分析框架的结构性局限。研究认为该领域过度优先考虑编码化、合规驱动的系统（"90%"），而低估了体现式危机知识——即在压力下基于经验的判断，当计划面对现实时决定结果的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 在应急管理领域，人类为AI生成通信添加"请"字的行为如何揭示该领域分析框架的结构性局限？体现式危机知识在专业危机判断中如何运作，以及该领域在个体层面如何操作社会过程存在哪些差距？
AI.motivation: 应急管理领域过度依赖编码化、合规驱动的系统（"90%"），而忽视了体现式危机知识的重要性。AI虽然擅长分析优化，但无法产生基于人类生活经验的、状态依赖的响应。需要重新评估专业知识和准备工作的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脆弱性研究理论框架，强调社会脆弱性、体现式知识、状态依赖响应等概念。研究扩展了脆弱性研究，探讨体现式知识在专业危机判断中的运作机制。
AI.method: 自传民族志分析方法，通过个人在急性丧亲期间的亲身经历，分析人类为AI生成通信添加"请"字的行为，以此作为案例研究。
AI.findings: AI擅长分析优化但无法产生基于人类生活经验的状态依赖响应。应急管理领域过度优先考虑编码化系统（"90%"）而低估体现式危机知识。当AI商品化"90%"时，体现式知识——将个体压力与更广泛社会脆弱性联系起来——成为关键差异化因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了脆弱性研究理论，通过分析体现式、状态依赖知识在专业危机判断中的运作，揭示了该领域在个体层面操作社会过程的差距。提出了"90%"系统与体现式知识的二分法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对应急管理领域的专业知识、认证、准备工作和AI整合具有实际意义。强调在AI时代，体现式危机知识的重要性，为培训、评估和系统设计提供指导。

title: Activating Talent Vitality through "Non-Systemic Scientific Research": A Systematic Reform Strategy to Resolve Employment Dilemmas and Boost Innovation Drivers

detail.title: Activating Talent Vitality through "Non-Systemic Scientific Research": A Systematic Reform Strategy to Resolve Employment Dilemmas and Boost Innovation Drivers
detail.abstract: The employment pressure of over ten million college graduates annually is deeply intertwined with the misallocation of intellectual resources caused by the administrativeization and identity barriers in China's scientific research system. Based on the historical experience of activating employment through the private economy in the 1980s and the deployment of scientific and technological system reform at the Third and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, this paper proposes the core idea of constructing a "dual-wheel drive" pattern of "systemic tackling key problems + non-systemic innovation". By analyzing the current chronic problems of administrative constraints and identity discrimination in the scientific research system, drawing on international experience from Germany, the United States and other countries in supporting independent researchers, and combining the successful practices of domestic non-systemic scientific research teams, this paper constructs a non-systemic scientific research development system oriented by "achievement-first" from three aspects: funding guarantee, risk prevention and control, and transition paths. It focuses on improving the diversified funding source mechanism, the quantitative evaluation criteria for non-thesis achievements, refining the connection points between reform measures and existing policies, and designing a phased reform roadmap. The research aims to provide actionable paths to resolve employment dilemmas, release the innovation vitality of the whole society, and promote China's scientific research from "following" to "leading".

AI.tldr: 本文提出"体制性攻关+非体制创新"双轮驱动模式，通过构建以"成果优先"为导向的非体制科研发展体系，解决高校毕业生就业压力与科研体制行政化、身份壁垒导致的智力资源错配问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过构建"体制性攻关+非体制创新"双轮驱动模式，解决高校毕业生就业压力与科研体制行政化、身份壁垒导致的智力资源错配问题？
AI.motivation: 1. 每年千万高校毕业生就业压力与科研体制智力资源错配问题交织；2. 科研体制存在行政约束和身份歧视等痼疾；3. 需要释放全社会创新活力，推动中国科研从"跟跑"向"领跑"转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 双轮驱动理论（体制性攻关+非体制创新）；2. 非体制科研发展体系理论；3. 国际比较理论（德美等国支持独立研究者的经验）；4. 历史经验借鉴（1980年代民营经济激活就业经验）。
AI.method: 1. 历史经验分析（1980年代民营经济激活就业）；2. 政策文本分析（二十届三中全会、四中全会科技体制改革部署）；3. 国际比较分析（德国、美国支持独立研究者经验）；4. 国内实践案例分析（非体制科研团队成功实践）；5. 体系构建方法（从经费保障、风险防控、过渡路径三方面构建体系）。
AI.findings: 1. 构建了以"成果优先"为导向的非体制科研发展体系；2. 提出了多元化经费来源机制；3. 设计了非论文成果量化评价标准；4. 细化了改革措施与现有政策衔接点；5. 制定了分阶段改革路线图。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"体制性攻关+非体制创新"双轮驱动理论框架；2. 发展了非体制科研发展体系理论；3. 构建了"成果优先"导向的评价理论；4. 丰富了科技体制改革的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为解决高校毕业生就业困境提供可行路径；2. 为释放全社会创新活力提供制度设计；3. 为中国科研从"跟跑"向"领跑"转型提供实施方案；4. 为科技体制改革提供具体操作指南。

title: Generative AI as an Equaliser in Cognitive Work: Evidence on Seniority Bias from EU-LFS

detail.title: Generative AI as an Equaliser in Cognitive Work: Evidence on Seniority Bias from EU-LFS
detail.abstract: Generative AI compresses the performance gap between average and top cognitive workers by democratising procedural execution (techne). As technical output becomes replicable, scarcity shifts toward contextual judgment (phronesis), generating a seniority-biased technological change that favours experienced workers over younger ones whose technical-fluency advantage is eroded. Yet the effect is self-undermining: automation of entry-level tasks disrupts phronesis acquisition; output replicability erodes the excellence premium; and the diffusion of "good enough" output lowers demand for genuine judgment. Moreover, the human advantage is structurally transitory, compressing as systems absorb tacit knowledge, accountability migrates to impersonal processes, and digital ecosystems converge. An exploratory EU-LFS exercise across EU-27, Italy, and Denmark shows suggestive evidence: in high-GenAIadoption sectors, the Senior-to-Junior employment ratio rises sharply after 2023, whereas it remains stable in low-adoption sectors. The paper concludes that the residual boundary of human contribution is mobile and politically determined.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI通过民主化程序执行（技术）缩小了普通与顶尖认知工作者之间的绩效差距。随着技术输出变得可复制，稀缺性转向情境判断（实践智慧），产生了偏向资深工作者的技术变革，侵蚀了年轻工作者的技术流利度优势。但这种效应是自我削弱的：入门级任务的自动化破坏了实践智慧的获取；输出可复制性侵蚀了卓越溢价；"足够好"输出的扩散降低了对真正判断的需求。此外，人类优势在结构上是暂时的，随着系统吸收隐性知识、责任转移到非人格化过程以及数字生态系统的趋同，优势被压缩。欧盟劳动力调查的探索性分析显示，在高GenAI采用率行业，资深与初级就业比率在2023年后急剧上升，而在低采用率行业保持稳定。论文结论：人类贡献的剩余边界是流动的且由政治决定。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何影响认知工作者的绩效差距和就业结构？具体而言，它如何改变技术（techne）与实践智慧（phronesis）的相对价值，以及这种变化对资深与初级工作者有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在重塑认知工作，但现有研究主要关注技术替代，而忽视了其对工作技能结构和代际就业动态的复杂影响。需要理解AI如何改变不同类型认知工作的相对价值，以及这对劳动力市场结构的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于亚里士多德的技能分类：技术（techne，程序性知识）与实践智慧（phronesis，情境判断）。结合技术变革理论，特别是技能偏向型技术变革，但提出"资深偏向型技术变革"的新概念。
AI.method: 理论分析结合探索性实证研究。使用欧盟劳动力调查（EU-LFS）数据，比较欧盟27国、意大利和丹麦在高GenAI采用率行业与低采用率行业中，资深与初级就业比率在2023年前后的变化趋势。
AI.findings: 1. 生成式AI民主化了技术执行，缩小了普通与顶尖工作者的绩效差距。2. 稀缺性转向实践智慧，产生了偏向资深工作者的技术变革。3. 但这种效应是自我削弱的：自动化入门级任务破坏实践智慧获取；输出可复制性侵蚀卓越溢价；"足够好"输出降低对真正判断的需求。4. 人类优势是暂时的，随着系统吸收隐性知识而压缩。5. 实证显示：高GenAI采用率行业中，资深与初级就业比率在2023年后急剧上升，而低采用率行业保持稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"资深偏向型技术变革"概念，补充了技能偏向型技术变革理论。2. 将亚里士多德的技能分类应用于AI时代的工作分析。3. 揭示了AI影响劳动力市场的自我削弱机制。4. 提出人类贡献边界是流动且政治决定的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计AI时代的人才发展路径提供见解。2. 警示自动化入门级任务可能破坏实践智慧的代际传递。3. 为政策制定者提供应对AI对就业结构影响的参考。4. 帮助教育机构调整技能培养重点。

title: Breaking Boundaries and Empowering Innovation: Constructing a Nationwide Participation-Oriented System for Cultivating Indigenous Original Creations

detail.title: Breaking Boundaries and Empowering Innovation: Constructing a Nationwide Participation-Oriented System for Cultivating Indigenous Original Creations
detail.abstract: Based on the national strategic deployments of "enhancing cultural originality" and "prospering new mass literature and art in the internet era", this paper addresses the issue of constrained potential of indigenous original creations caused by identity barriers and evaluation barriers in the current scientific research ecosystem. It proposes to construct a nationwide participation-oriented system for cultivating original creations, which integrates a zero-threshold preprint platform, the OA Journal Original Creations, a two-way review mechanism, targeted support measures, and an industry-university-research-application closed loop. By supplementing regional innovation characteristics, improving incentive mechanisms, strengthening technological empowerment and risk prevention and control, the paper aims to form a full-chain support system covering "discovery, cultivation, transformation, and protection". The ultimate goals are to activate grassroots innovative forces, promote the rise of indigenous original theories, and provide an operable practical path for the implementation of national innovation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文针对当前科研生态中身份壁垒和评价壁垒制约本土原创潜力的问题，提出构建全国性参与式原创培育体系，包含零门槛预印平台、OA期刊、双向评审机制、定向支持措施和产学研用闭环，旨在激活基层创新力量，促进本土原创理论崛起。
AI.research_question: 如何突破当前科研生态中的身份壁垒和评价壁垒，构建有效的全国性参与式原创培育体系，以激活基层创新力量并促进本土原创理论崛起？
AI.motivation: 基于国家"增强文化原创性"和"繁荣互联网时代新群众文艺"的战略部署，当前科研生态中的身份壁垒和评价壁垒制约了本土原创创作的潜力发挥，需要构建新的培育体系来激活基层创新力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新生态系统理论、开放式创新理论、参与式文化理论、产学研用协同创新理论，以及国家创新战略实施路径理论。
AI.method: 提出系统性构建方法：通过构建零门槛预印平台、OA期刊《原创创作》、双向评审机制、定向支持措施和产学研用闭环，形成覆盖"发现、培育、转化、保护"的全链条支持体系。
AI.findings: 提出的全国性参与式原创培育体系能够有效补充区域创新特色、完善激励机制、强化技术赋能和风险防控，为激活基层创新力量提供系统性解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 拓展了开放式创新理论在基层创新中的应用；2) 丰富了参与式文化理论在科研生态中的实践路径；3) 提出了本土原创理论培育的系统性框架；4) 发展了国家创新战略实施的微观操作理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了可操作的全国性原创培育体系实施方案；2) 为突破科研身份壁垒和评价壁垒提供了具体路径；3) 为基层创新者提供了零门槛参与平台；4) 为国家创新战略实施提供了实践参考；5) 建立了产学研用闭环的转化机制。

title: Reforming the Civil Service: Impacts on Engagement, Job Satisfaction, Burnout, and Turnover Intentions
affiliations: The George Washington University and

detail.title: Reforming the Civil Service: Impacts on Engagement, Job Satisfaction, Burnout, and Turnover Intentions
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the causal impact of the 2025 U.S. federal personnel reforms on employment, employee engagement, job satisfaction, burnout, job search behavior, and perceptions about their workplace. Using administrative and survey data, we implement a differencein-differences design comparing federal employees to observationally similar state-and local government employees before and after the reforms. Event-study estimates show near-parallel pre-trends (2022-2024) and a sharp post-reform divergence in 2025. Baseline estimates indicate a meaningful decline in federal employment and employee engagement relative to the state control group, accompanied by reductions in job satisfaction and corresponding increases in reported burnout and job search activity. Heterogeneity analyses show that these effects are driven almost entirely by federal workers who identify as Democrats, and to some extent Independents, with little to no impact on their Republican colleagues. We also find that perceptions of workplace practices, like trust in leadership, play a moderating role.

AI.tldr: 2025年美国联邦人事改革对联邦雇员产生了显著的负面影响，包括就业减少、员工敬业度下降、工作满意度降低、职业倦怠增加和求职行为增多，这些影响主要集中在民主党认同的联邦雇员中。
AI.research_question: 2025年美国联邦人事改革对联邦雇员的就业、员工敬业度、工作满意度、职业倦怠、求职行为和职场认知有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 评估联邦人事改革的实际效果，了解政策变化对公共部门员工的影响，特别是不同政治倾向员工之间的差异效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织行为学、公共管理理论和政策评估框架，关注政治认同与工作态度之间的交互作用，以及领导信任等组织因素的调节作用。
AI.method: 使用双重差分法设计，比较联邦雇员与观察上相似的地方政府雇员在改革前后的变化，结合行政数据和调查数据，进行事件研究和异质性分析。
AI.findings: 改革导致联邦就业和员工敬业度显著下降，工作满意度降低，职业倦怠和求职行为增加；这些影响几乎完全由民主党认同的联邦雇员驱动，对共和党同事影响甚微；领导信任等职场认知因素具有调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政治认同在政策影响中的调节作用，扩展了公共部门改革评估的理论框架，深化了对组织变革中员工反应的异质性理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改革效果评估，建议考虑员工政治倾向的差异影响，强调领导信任在缓冲负面效应中的重要性，为未来人事政策设计提供实证依据。

title: How Open Source Coordinates: A Guide for Policy Makers

detail.title: How Open Source Coordinates: A Guide for Policy Makers
detail.abstract: Free and open source software underpins critical infrastructure worldwide, yet policy makers struggle to engage effectively with this ecosystem. The challenge is that FOSS coordinates through horizontal networks of self-governing communities, not through central authority or hierarchical control. This article explains how coordination typically works in the FOSS ecosystem: through upstream-downstream dependencies, open governance processes, and self-organizing communities. Understanding these mechanisms reveals both powerful policy opportunities (technology transfer, standards enforcement, industrial policy) and fundamental constraints (reduced control, borderless collaboration, global investment impacts). Effective policy requires working with horizontal coordination structures, not against them.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了开源软件生态系统的协调机制，指出政策制定者需要理解并适应其水平网络结构，而非试图施加中央控制，以有效利用政策机会并应对约束。
AI.research_question: 政策制定者如何有效参与自由开源软件生态系统，该生态系统通过水平网络而非中央权威进行协调？
AI.motivation: 自由开源软件支撑着全球关键基础设施，但政策制定者难以有效参与这一生态系统，因为其协调机制与传统中央控制模式不同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于水平网络协调理论、自组织社区理论和开源治理理论，强调去中心化、自我调节的协作模式。
AI.method: 概念性分析，通过解释FOSS生态系统的典型协调机制：上下游依赖关系、开放治理流程和自组织社区。
AI.findings: FOSS通过三种主要机制协调：1)上下游依赖关系；2)开放治理流程；3)自组织社区。这揭示了政策机会（技术转移、标准执行、产业政策）和根本约束（控制力减弱、无国界协作、全球投资影响）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理解FOSS生态系统协调机制的理论框架，强调水平网络结构对政策制定的影响，为数字治理理论提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体指导：需要适应水平协调结构，利用技术转移、标准执行等机会，同时接受控制力减弱等约束，以更有效地参与开源生态系统。

title: The Short-and Long-Run Impact of Comparative Noncognitive Skills

detail.title: The Short-and Long-Run Impact of Comparative Noncognitive Skills

declarations.ethicsApproval: This project has been reviewed by the IRB offices at Stanford University (clearance numbers 66665 and 66541) and at Yale University (clearance number 2000040434). The survey experiment has also been preregistered in the AEA RCT Registry with RCT ID number AEARCTR-0017599.

detail.abstract: This study documents a new fact about educational production: Students' relative standing in noncognitive skills has lasting effects on educational trajectories that are distinct from those of absolute skill levels and cognitive achievement. Using administrative data covering the universe of public school students in Greece, I exploit quasi-random classroom assignment to identify the causal impact of comparative noncognitive skills-measured as students' grade 10 classroom rank in grade 9 unexcused absences. A worse ranking in noncognitive skills generates persistent and nonlinear effects on short-run academic performance and longer-run educational trajectories. A worse behavioral rank predicts weaker achievement in Greek Language and Mathematics for both boys and girls in grades 10 and 11. Starting in grade 11, however, responses diverge by gender. A worse ranking in noncognitive skills predicts stronger sorting into vocational schools and less competitive academic tracks for girls, whereas boys sort into more competitive tracks. A worse ranking in noncognitive skills is also associated with greater participation in and higher performance on national examinations for boys only. Boys with a worse ranking in noncognitive skills also apply more frequently to, and are more likely to gain admission to, higher-earning degree programs, while girls' admissions and expected earnings are unaffected. Gender differences in comparative noncognitive skills account for 37 percent of the gender gap in expected post-college salaries. Complementary evidence from a survey experiment shows that comparative behavioral labels systematically shift teachers' expectations and attribution patterns for otherwise identical students. This suggests that relative-standing effects operate through belief-driven institutional responses.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现学生非认知技能的相对排名（而非绝对水平）对教育轨迹有持久影响，且存在性别差异。在希腊公立学校数据中，较差的非认知技能排名导致男女短期学业表现均下降，但从11年级开始，男女反应分化：女生更倾向选择职业学校和竞争力较弱的学术轨道，男生则选择更具竞争力的轨道并更积极参与全国考试，最终导致男生申请更高收入专业，解释了37%的大学后薪资性别差距。
AI.research_question: 学生的非认知技能相对排名（而非绝对水平）如何影响其教育轨迹？这种影响是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 现有教育生产研究主要关注认知技能和非认知技能的绝对水平，但忽视了相对排名的重要性。理解相对排名如何通过制度性反应（如教师期望）影响学生教育选择，对解释教育不平等和性别差距至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对地位理论（相对排名效应）、教师期望理论（皮格马利翁效应）、性别社会化理论、教育追踪与选择理论
AI.method: 使用希腊全国公立学校行政数据，利用准随机的班级分配识别非认知技能相对排名的因果效应（以10年级学生在9年级无故缺勤的班级排名作为非认知技能代理变量），辅以调查实验验证机制。
AI.findings: 1. 较差的非认知技能排名对男女10-11年级的希腊语和数学成绩均有负面影响；2. 从11年级开始，男女反应分化：女生更倾向选择职业学校和竞争力较弱的学术轨道，男生则选择更具竞争力的轨道；3. 较差的排名仅与男生更高的全国考试参与度和成绩相关；4. 男生因此更常申请并被更高收入专业录取，女生不受影响；5. 这种性别差异解释了37%的大学后预期薪资性别差距；6. 调查实验表明相对行为标签会系统性地改变教师期望和归因模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统论证非认知技能相对排名的独立因果效应；2. 揭示相对排名效应通过教师期望等制度性反应运作的机制；3. 发现相对排名影响的性别异质性，拓展了性别与教育研究；4. 为理解教育追踪和选择提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育政策制定者提供干预相对排名效应的依据；2. 帮助教师意识到相对标签对学生期望的影响；3. 为减少教育性别差距提供具体切入点（关注非认知技能相对排名的性别差异）；4. 对学校分班、学生评价和职业指导实践有启示意义。

title: Market Orientation: Finding a New Roadmap for Sustainable Archaeological Sites
affiliations: Complutense University of Madrid, , Universidad Complutense Madrid and University of Valencia - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Market Orientation: Finding a New Roadmap for Sustainable Archaeological Sites

publicationDetails.detailsText:
TOURISMOS: AN INTERNATIONAL MULTIDISCIPLINARY JOURNAL OF
TOURISM
Volume 14, Number 1, pp. 236-256 2020

detail.abstract: While there is quite substantial research on how marketing strategies for archaeological sites affect destination branding, little can be found in literature on the impact of a market orientation adoption in these heritage assets on the development of sustainable tourism. This study aims to examine and propose a market orientation model which variables best define tourism sustainability in archaeological sites. The methodology is based on a qualitative and quantitative research to empirically test the model, using an international sample of eleven heritage management experts for the qualitative study, and 129 managers of archaeological sites worldwide for the quantitative research. This research provides empirical evidence indicating that market orientation positively influences tourism sustainability in archaeological sites, and proves the relevance of analysing the tourism functionality of these assets before implementing a market orientation plan.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性和定量方法，检验市场导向对考古遗址旅游可持续发展的影响，发现市场导向正向影响旅游可持续性，并强调在实施市场导向计划前分析旅游功能的重要性。
AI.research_question: 市场导向如何影响考古遗址的旅游可持续发展？哪些变量最能定义考古遗址的旅游可持续性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注考古遗址营销策略对目的地品牌的影响，但缺乏关于市场导向对遗产资产可持续旅游发展影响的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场导向理论、可持续旅游理论、遗产管理理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：定性研究包括11位国际遗产管理专家的访谈；定量研究包括全球129位考古遗址管理者的问卷调查
AI.findings: 市场导向对考古遗址的旅游可持续性有正向影响；在实施市场导向计划前分析旅游功能具有相关性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考古遗址市场导向模型；填补了市场导向与遗产可持续旅游关系的研究空白；扩展了市场导向理论在文化遗产领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为考古遗址管理者提供了实证依据，证明市场导向能促进旅游可持续性；强调在制定市场导向计划前评估旅游功能的重要性；为遗产管理实践提供了具体指导

title: Separate the Art from the Artist? Goodreads Readers Did Not

detail.title: Separate the Art from the Artist? Goodreads Readers Did Not

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the research reported in this paper. The author has no affiliation with Goodreads, Amazon, Peter Attia, or any party referenced in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analyzed publicly available user-generated content (book reviews and star ratings) collected from the Goodreads platform. No human subjects were recruited, surveyed, or interviewed. All data were observational and drawn from publicly accessible sources. Institutional review board (IRB) approval was not required per San Diego State University guidelines for research involving publicly available data that does not constitute human subjects research.

detail.abstract: On January 30, 2026, millions of records from convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein were released by the U.S. Department of Justice. Dr. Peter Attia, physician, podcaster, and author of the best-selling health book Outlive: The Science and Art of Longevity, appeared in more than 1,800 of them. That day, his life changed. But the book he wrote did not. Every sentence, every data point, every recommendation remained exactly as it had been the day before. However, the interpretive frame through which many readers evaluated it shifted immediately. This paper treats that public persona shock as a quasi-natural experiment in the reputation-performance puzzle: when an author is morally reclassified, does perceived product quality change even when the product is fixed? Using 8,253 star-rated Goodreads reviews, I compare rating distributions before and after the event. The mean star rating collapsed from 4.18 (pre-shock, N = 8,090) to 2.54 (post-shock, N = 156), a drop of 1.63 stars (Cohen's d = 1.716, p < 0.001). The 1-star share rose from 1.3% to 44.2%. Critically, 38.5% of post-shock reviews were retroactive edits to previous reviews, and these edits were substantially more negative (mean 1.53) than entirely new post-shock reviews (mean 3.18). The data are consistent with a horns-effect interpretation: a moral signal about the author recolored evaluations of a product causally unrelated to that signal. The retroactive editing pattern, in which readers revise previously favorable reviews, represents direct evidence of backward-looking moral reappraisal.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Jeffrey Epstein案件文件公开导致Peter Attia医生声誉受损的准自然实验，研究作者道德重分类如何影响读者对其固定产品质量的感知。通过分析Goodreads书评数据发现，声誉冲击后平均评分从4.18降至2.54，一星评价比例从1.3%升至44.2%，且38.5%的冲击后评论是对先前评论的负面修订。
AI.research_question: 当作者被道德重分类时，即使产品本身保持不变，感知的产品质量是否会发生变化？
AI.motivation: 研究声誉与绩效之间的复杂关系，特别是当个人道德声誉受损时，这种声誉如何影响对其客观产品质量的评估。利用Epstein案件文件公开这一准自然实验，可以隔离产品本身变化的影响，专门考察声誉冲击的效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 声誉-绩效谜题、光环/尖角效应（halo/horns effect）、道德信号理论、回顾性道德重新评估
AI.method: 准自然实验设计，使用8,253条Goodreads星级书评数据，比较事件前后的评分分布。分析包括均值比较、评分分布变化、Cohen's d效应量计算，特别关注38.5%的冲击后评论是先前评论的修订这一现象。
AI.findings:
1. 平均星级评分从4.18（冲击前）降至2.54（冲击后），下降1.63星（Cohen's d = 1.716，p < 0.001）
2. 一星评价比例从1.3%大幅上升至44.2%
3. 38.5%的冲击后评论是对先前评论的修订，这些修订比全新的冲击后评论更加负面（均值1.53 vs 3.18）
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为声誉-绩效谜题提供了实证证据，表明道德声誉变化可以显著改变对固定产品质量的感知
2. 展示了尖角效应在道德领域的运作机制
3. 提供了回顾性道德重新评估的直接证据，读者会修订先前对产品的正面评价
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 对内容创作者和品牌管理者有警示意义：个人道德声誉可能显著影响产品评价
2. 为平台设计者提供洞见：需要考虑如何处理声誉冲击后的评价修订
3. 对消费者行为研究有启示：道德判断可能超越对产品本身质量的客观评估

title: Government Agencies’ Demand for Audit Quality: Evidence from Government Audit Procurement
affiliations: Texas A&M University - Department of Accounting, Texas A&M University - Department of Accounting and

detail.title: Government Agencies’ Demand for Audit Quality: Evidence from Government Audit Procurement
detail.abstract: We examine government agencies’ audit firm selections when procuring financial audit services. Using a sample of 2,760 financial audit contracts across 17 European countries and a staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that government agencies are more likely to contract with audit firms that receive PCAOB inspection reports with more deficient audits. This tendency is more pronounced in countries with greater illegal diversion of public funds and weaker accountability mechanisms, but does not vary with budgetary constraints, consistent with results being driven by opportunism rather than cost-savings incentives. In supply-side tests, we do not find evidence consistent with audit firms seeking to replace lost public company audits with government audits. These findings suggest that, in low-accountability environments, government agencies may deliberately select lower-quality auditors to reduce the likelihood of detection and disclosure of illegal or ineffective use of public funds.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在问责机制较弱的国家，政府机构更倾向于选择审计质量较低的会计师事务所，以减少非法或无效使用公共资金被揭露的风险。
AI.research_question: 政府机构在选择财务审计服务时，是否会倾向于选择审计质量较低的会计师事务所？这种倾向在何种制度环境下更为明显？
AI.motivation: 理解政府机构审计师选择的动机，特别是在问责机制薄弱的环境中，是否存在机会主义行为，即故意选择低质量审计师以减少公共资金滥用被揭露的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和问责机制理论，探讨在公共部门审计中，政府机构作为代理人可能存在的机会主义行为，以及制度环境（如问责机制强度、公共资金滥用程度）如何影响这种选择。
AI.method: 使用17个欧洲国家的2,760份财务审计合同样本，采用交错双重差分设计，分析政府机构选择与PCAOB检查报告中审计缺陷较多的会计师事务所之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 政府机构更可能选择审计缺陷较多的会计师事务所；2. 这种倾向在公共资金非法转移更严重、问责机制更弱的国家更明显；3. 与预算约束无关，表明是机会主义而非成本节约驱动；4. 供给方测试未发现会计师事务所用政府审计替代流失的上市公司审计业务。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了公共部门审计选择理论，揭示了在低问责环境中政府机构的机会主义行为机制，为代理理论在公共部门的应用提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供政策启示：应加强公共部门审计的问责机制，防止政府机构通过选择低质量审计师来掩盖公共资金滥用问题。

title: Thirukkural Ethical Framework A 2,000-Year-Old Classical Text as Constitutional Architecture for AI Alignment

detail.title: Thirukkural Ethical Framework A 2,000-Year-Old Classical Text as Constitutional Architecture for AI Alignment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with any organization that could be perceived to influence this study. The AI system Claude (Anthropic) was used as a research collaborator for corpus construction, philological verification, and argument development, as disclosed in full in §8 of the paper. No compensation was received from Anthropic or any other organization in connection with this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves no human participants, patient data, clinical procedures, or personal data collection. It is a theoretical and philological analysis of a classical literary corpus (the Thirukkural) and its application to AI alignment frameworks. No ethics approval is required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently, without institutional, governmental, or private financial support.

detail.abstract: Contemporary AI alignment frameworks — Constitutional AI (Anthropic, 2022), the OECD Principles on Artificial Intelligence (2019), and the EU AI Act (2024) — share a profound structural limitation: they are designed entirely within Western philosophical traditions, primarily utilitarian and deontological. This paper presents the Thirukkural Ethical Framework (TEF), a formalised set of 12 constitutional principles derived from the Thirukkural, a Tamil classical text attributed to Thiruvalluvar (c. 1st century CE). We demonstrate, through systematic corpus analysis of all 1,330 couplets verified against the Project Madurai primary source, that this 2,000-year-old text contains ethically-grounded constraints that correspond point-for-point to the needs identified by contemporary AI alignment research — and, critically, that it formalises dimensions systematically absent from Western frameworks: reciprocity, relational resilience, accountability, and mutual alignment. The TEF architecture follows the tripartite structure of the Thirukkural itself: Aram (ethical foundations, 4 principles), Porul (governance and action, 4 principles), Inbam (relational dynamics, 4 principles). This paper constitutes, to our knowledge, the first operational precedent for the integration of non-Western classical wisdom into AI alignment architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于泰米尔古典文本《蒂鲁库拉尔》的伦理框架(TEF)，包含12条宪法原则，填补了西方AI对齐框架在互惠性、关系韧性、问责制和相互对齐等维度的缺失。
AI.research_question: 如何将非西方古典智慧（特别是泰米尔古典文本《蒂鲁库拉尔》）整合到AI对齐架构中，以弥补现有西方伦理框架的结构性局限？
AI.motivation: 当前AI对齐框架（如Constitutional AI、OECD原则、欧盟AI法案）完全基于西方哲学传统（功利主义和道义论），存在结构性局限，缺乏互惠性、关系韧性、问责制和相互对齐等关键维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《蒂鲁库拉尔》的伦理框架(TEF)，该文本包含1,330对句，分为三个部分：Aram（伦理基础）、Porul（治理与行动）、Inbam（关系动态）。
AI.method: 通过对Project Madurai主要来源验证的所有1,330对句进行系统语料分析，识别出与当代AI对齐需求相对应的伦理约束原则。
AI.findings: 这部2000年前的文本包含与当代AI对齐研究需求一一对应的伦理约束，并形式化了西方框架中系统缺失的维度：互惠性、关系韧性、问责制和相互对齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为非西方古典智慧整合到AI对齐架构提供了可操作的先例；提出了基于《蒂鲁库拉尔》的三部分结构（Aram、Porul、Inbam）的12条宪法原则框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI对齐实践提供了更全面、文化包容的伦理框架；为政策制定者和AI开发者提供了基于非西方传统的具体操作原则；增强了AI系统的文化适应性和伦理稳健性。

title: Optimizing Solid-State Battery Performance Through Intelligent Remaining Useful Life Estimation

detail.title: Optimizing Solid-State Battery Performance Through Intelligent Remaining Useful Life Estimation
detail.abstract: Solid-state batteries (SSBs) are widely regarded as a next-generation energy storage solution due to their enhanced safety and high energy density; however, their long-term performance remains constrained by degradation uncertainty and limited predictive management strategies. Recent advances in prognostics and health management (PHM), artificial intelligence (AI), and hybrid modeling have demonstrated strong potential in improving Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation accuracy for advanced battery systems (Sadegh Kouhestani et al.; Wang et al., 2025; Long et al.). This study develops an intelligent RUL estimation framework tailored specifically for solid-state battery architectures by integrating multi-kernel regression, fusion-based health indicator extraction, and digital twin-enabled battery management systems (Cao, Wang, and Fernandez; Tao et al.; Madani et al.). The results indicate that hybrid physical-data-driven approaches outperform purely statistical or single-model learning strategies in prediction robustness and lifecycle optimization (Rahman and Lu; Cheng et al.). The study concludes that embedding intelligent RUL estimation into smart battery management systems significantly enhances reliability, safety margins, and lifecycle utilization in solid-state batteries.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个针对固态电池架构的智能剩余使用寿命(RUL)估计框架，通过整合多核回归、融合健康指标提取和数字孪生电池管理系统，结果表明混合物理-数据驱动方法在预测鲁棒性和生命周期优化方面优于纯统计或单模型学习策略。
AI.research_question: 如何为固态电池架构开发一个智能的剩余使用寿命(RUL)估计框架，以提高其长期性能和可靠性？
AI.motivation: 固态电池因其增强的安全性和高能量密度被视为下一代储能解决方案，但其长期性能受到退化不确定性和有限预测管理策略的限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于预测与健康管理(PHM)、人工智能(AI)和混合建模的最新进展，这些方法在提高先进电池系统的剩余使用寿命估计精度方面显示出强大潜力。
AI.method: 开发了一个智能RUL估计框架，整合多核回归、融合健康指标提取和数字孪生电池管理系统，采用混合物理-数据驱动方法。
AI.findings: 混合物理-数据驱动方法在预测鲁棒性和生命周期优化方面优于纯统计或单模型学习策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 为固态电池架构开发了专门的智能RUL估计框架，推进了混合物理-数据驱动方法在电池健康管理中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 将智能RUL估计嵌入智能电池管理系统，显著提高了固态电池的可靠性、安全裕度和生命周期利用率。

title: A Structural Constraint Theory of Long-Horizon Systems: Understanding Structural Limits of Anticipatory Capacity and Long-Term Self-Correction
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Structural Constraint Theory of Long-Horizon Systems: Understanding Structural Limits of Anticipatory Capacity and Long-Term Self-Correction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, animals, or personal data; therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the fragility of complex, long-horizon systems and proposes a theoretical framework for understanding structural limits on anticipatory capacity. Rather than attributing systemic failure to individual decision errors or policy design flaws, the framework models collapse risk as emerging from non-volitional structural constraints that shape how systems detect errors, interpret signals, and perform corrective actions over extended time horizons. The paper introduces a five-process structure—error detection, error naming, impact feedback, cost assessment, and meta-correction—and argues that long-term system viability depends on the joint integrity of these processes under growing coordination and complexity burdens. Through conceptual analysis and illustrative cases, the framework clarifies why improved foresight, intelligence, or governance capacity alone does not guarantee long-term stability. The paper does not provide predictions or policy prescriptions; instead, it offers a diagnostic lens for assessing structural vulnerability and a theoretical roadmap for future formalization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个理解复杂长期系统脆弱性的理论框架，认为系统性失败源于非意志性结构约束而非个体决策错误，并引入五个关键过程来分析系统长期存续能力。
AI.research_question: 复杂长期系统的结构性脆弱性根源是什么？为什么改进预见性、智能或治理能力本身无法保证长期稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统分析倾向于将系统性失败归因于个体决策错误或政策设计缺陷，但忽视了非意志性结构约束对系统长期存续能力的根本影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出了一个五过程结构框架：错误检测、错误命名、影响反馈、成本评估和元校正，认为系统长期存续能力取决于这些过程在协调和复杂性负担下的联合完整性。
AI.method: 概念分析和案例说明，通过理论框架构建和案例阐释来阐明观点，而非实证检验或预测。
AI.findings: 系统性崩溃风险源于非意志性结构约束，这些约束塑造了系统如何检测错误、解释信号和执行长期校正行动；改进预见性、智能或治理能力本身无法保证长期稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了理解复杂长期系统脆弱性的诊断视角和理论路线图，为未来形式化研究奠定基础，将系统性失败分析从个体层面转向结构性约束层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了评估结构脆弱性的诊断工具，帮助决策者识别系统长期存续的关键约束，但不提供具体预测或政策处方。

title: Measurement and Validation of the Interrelationships Between Job Satisfaction, Social Support, and Work-life Balance Among Police Personnel
affiliations: Tumkur University - Tumkur University, Department of Studies and Research in Commerce, Students and Tumkur University

detail.title: Measurement and Validation of the Interrelationships Between Job Satisfaction, Social Support, and Work-life Balance Among Police Personnel

publicationDetails.detailsText: SEMCOM Management & Technology Review, Volume 12, Issue 1, Pp 15-20

detail.abstract: Work-life balance refers to an individual's capacity to harmoniously segregate between professional and personal life so that they do not collide. Socializing is essential in both workplace and personal lives as it enhances the quality of relationships, improves coordination, and builds a sense of belonging. Job satisfaction is a key factor for every employee that motivates them to sustain and enhance their morale. In this study, the researchers aim to examine the relationship between social support and work-life balance among police personnel and whether job satisfaction mediates this relationship. This study is focused on the WLB of policemen of Southern Bengaluru. A 28-item research instrument was developed to examine the relationship between social support, work-life balance (WLB), and job satisfaction. Data was collected from 400 respondents. Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) have been used to test the direct relationship and indirect relationship between social support and WLB, using Jamovi. Results of the study indicate a strong positive association between social support and WLB. A partial mediation r!f job satisfaction was established between social support and WLB, backed by statistical evidence.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了社会支持对警察人员工作生活平衡的影响，并检验了工作满意度在这一关系中的中介作用。研究发现社会支持与工作生活平衡呈显著正相关，且工作满意度在其中起到部分中介作用。
AI.research_question: 社会支持与警察人员工作生活平衡之间的关系是什么？工作满意度是否在这一关系中起到中介作用？
AI.motivation: 工作生活平衡对个人职业和个人生活和谐分离至关重要，社会支持在职场和个人生活中都极为重要，而工作满意度是激励员工保持和提高士气的关键因素。警察作为特殊职业群体，其工作生活平衡问题值得特别关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会支持理论、工作生活平衡理论和工作满意度理论，探讨三者之间的理论关系框架。
AI.method: 研究针对班加罗尔南部警察，开发了28项研究工具，收集了400名受访者的数据，使用验证性因子分析（CFA）和结构方程模型（SEM）通过Jamovi软件检验直接和间接关系。
AI.findings: 研究结果表明社会支持与工作生活平衡之间存在强烈的正相关关系。工作满意度在社会支持与工作生活平衡之间起到部分中介作用，这一结论得到了统计证据的支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 为工作生活平衡理论提供了实证支持，明确了社会支持对工作生活平衡的影响机制，验证了工作满意度的中介作用，丰富了警察职业群体的相关理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为警察组织管理者提供了改善警察工作生活平衡的具体策略：通过增强社会支持系统（如同事支持、家庭支持、组织支持）来提升警察的工作满意度，进而改善其工作生活平衡状况。

title: Review Makes Workers Less Likely to Revise AI Output
affiliations: and Shandong University

detail.title: Review Makes Workers Less Likely to Revise AI Output
detail.abstract: Can review-a cornerstone of organizational accountability-encourage workers to collaborate with AI rather than outsource their work entirely to it? Across seven experiments (N = 2,895), we find that review has the opposite effect: participants who expected their work to be evaluated by a peer or supervisor modified AI-generated content significantly less than those who did not anticipate review. In other words, reviewing a worker's final work makes them more likely to copy and paste from AI rather than collaborate with it. This pattern emerged consistently across tasks (social media posts, holiday postcards, lesson plans), populations (undergraduate students, online panelists, teachers from six countries), and reviewer types (peers and supervisors). We propose that outcome-focused review leads workers to defer to AI's perceived expertise rather than risk introducing errors through modification. Consistent with this account, we find that the effect attenuates when workers know that reviewers will see the process, which features both the original AI output and the final submission, alongside the outcome. Workers under review modified AI content as much as those not being reviewed.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，预期工作会被评审（同行或主管）反而会降低员工修改AI生成内容的意愿，使他们更倾向于直接复制粘贴AI输出，而非与AI协作。这种效应在多种任务、人群和评审者类型中均一致出现。只有当评审者能看到工作过程（包括原始AI输出和最终提交）时，这种效应才会减弱。
AI.research_question: 评审（作为组织问责的基石）是否能鼓励员工与AI协作，而不是将工作完全外包给AI？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在工作场所的普及，理解组织问责机制（如评审）如何影响员工与AI的协作方式变得至关重要。需要探究评审是否会促进员工批判性地使用AI，还是反而导致他们过度依赖AI。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于问责理论和风险规避理论。预期评审会促使员工关注结果质量，导致他们倾向于依赖AI的感知专业性，避免因修改而引入错误的风险。
AI.method: 通过7个实验（N=2,895），采用多种任务（社交媒体帖子、节日贺卡、教案）、不同人群（本科生、在线参与者、来自6个国家的教师）和评审者类型（同行和主管）进行检验。
AI.findings: 预期评审的员工修改AI生成内容的程度显著低于不预期评审的员工。评审导致员工更可能直接复制粘贴AI输出，而非与AI协作。只有当评审者能看到工作过程（原始AI输出和最终提交）时，这种效应才会减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了评审对AI协作的意外负面影响；2. 提出了结果导向评审导致风险规避的理论机制；3. 区分了结果评审与过程评审的不同效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计AI协作流程提供指导；2. 建议采用过程可见的评审机制；3. 帮助管理者理解如何促进员工与AI的有效协作而非简单外包。

title: DAO and Tokenized Governance: The Problem of Decentralized Decision-Making

detail.title: DAO and Tokenized Governance: The Problem of Decentralized Decision-Making
detail.abstract:
This chapter analyses how the tokenization of decisional power-enabled by blockchain-based governance token offers new governance models while simultaneously revealing structural, technological, and legal limits. 
After illustrating how electronic voting and tokenbased identification address challenges such as deepfakes, the chapter examines the functioning of DAOs, their governance procedures, and the informal community dynamics that shape decision-making. It then discusses the conceptual difficulties surrounding 'decentralization,' reviews existing metrics, and proposes alternative normative criteria, including minimum independent decision centres and the 'mutualistic symbiosis' between protocol, users, and developers. The final section evaluates legal obstacles under Italian law, showing the limited feasibility of tokenizing corporate participations and the centralizing effects introduced by the Fintech Decree. The chapter concludes that regulators must develop a coherent legal definition of decentralization and simplify regulatory frameworks for tokenized equity instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了区块链治理代币如何通过决策权代币化创造新的治理模式，同时揭示了结构、技术和法律限制。探讨了DAO治理、去中心化概念难题，并提出替代性规范标准，最后评估意大利法律障碍。
AI.research_question: 区块链治理代币如何实现决策权代币化，创造了哪些新的治理模式，同时面临哪些结构、技术和法律限制？
AI.motivation: 区块链技术通过治理代币实现了决策权的代币化，这为组织治理带来了新的可能性，但同时也暴露出各种限制和挑战，需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去中心化自治组织(DAO)理论、治理代币化理论、电子投票与代币身份识别理论、去中心化概念框架、互惠共生理论
AI.method: 概念分析、案例研究、法律文本分析、规范标准构建
AI.findings: 1) 电子投票和代币身份识别可应对深度伪造等挑战；2) DAO治理涉及正式程序和非正式社区动态；3) "去中心化"概念存在理论困难；4) 意大利法律对代币化公司参与有限制；5) 金融科技法令产生中心化效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了替代性规范标准：最小独立决策中心和协议、用户、开发者之间的"互惠共生"关系；为去中心化概念提供了新的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 建议监管机构制定一致的去中心化法律定义，简化代币化股权工具的监管框架；为DAO治理实践提供指导

title: How would Reforms made on Zoning Policies in Istanbul affect the SME's?
affiliations: Robert College

detail.title: How would Reforms made on Zoning Policies in Istanbul affect the SME's?

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on the analysis of publicly available data and existing literature. No human participants were involved; therefore, ethics approval was not required.

contentType.other: Forthcoming in the Oxford Journal of Student Scholarship (Spring 2026)

detail.abstract: This paper examines the economic implications of urban zoning reforms in Istanbul specifically large-scale urban transformation and housing projects on Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs). Given that SMEs constitute approximately 99% of Turkish enterprises, their resilience against spatial restructuring is a critical factor for urban economic sustainability. Integrating existing literature with statistical data and specific case studies, this study identifies a systemic displacement of SMEs from central business districts, exacerbated infrastructure disparities in peripheral regions, and heightened regulatory hurdles that drive operational instability. The analysis suggests that Istanbul’s current urban development model disproportionately prioritizes residential and showcase projects, often marginalizing the SME-driven economic ecosystem. The study concludes with evidence-based policy recommendations, emphasizing the necessity of participatory planning, spatial protection of local economic clusters, and targeted infrastructure incentives to mitigate the adverse effects of top-down zoning reforms.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了伊斯坦布尔大规模城市改造和住房项目对中小企业的经济影响，发现这些项目导致中小企业从中心商业区系统性迁移、加剧了外围地区基础设施差距，并增加了监管障碍。研究建议采取参与式规划、保护地方经济集群和提供基础设施激励等政策。
AI.research_question: 伊斯坦布尔的城市分区改革（特别是大规模城市改造和住房项目）对中小企业产生了哪些经济影响？
AI.motivation: 中小企业占土耳其企业的99%，它们对空间重构的韧性是城市经济可持续性的关键因素。当前城市发展模式可能过度优先考虑住宅和展示性项目，而忽视了中小企业驱动的经济生态系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市经济学、空间重构理论、中小企业韧性理论、城市分区改革影响分析框架
AI.method: 整合现有文献、统计数据和具体案例研究，进行综合分析
AI.findings: 1. 中小企业从中心商业区系统性迁移；2. 外围地区基础设施差距加剧；3. 监管障碍增加导致运营不稳定；4. 当前城市发展模式过度优先住宅和展示性项目，边缘化中小企业经济生态系统
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了城市分区改革对中小企业影响的理论理解；2. 提出了空间重构与中小企业韧性之间的理论联系；3. 为发展中国家大都市的城市经济发展提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 基于证据的政策建议：参与式规划、地方经济集群的空间保护、有针对性的基础设施激励；2. 为政策制定者提供了缓解自上而下分区改革负面影响的实用方案；3. 为其他面临类似挑战的城市提供了参考

title: Sudden Incapacitation or Death at the Wheel: Unravelling the Predictors of Catastrophic Multi-Vehicle Collisions

detail.title: Sudden Incapacitation or Death at the Wheel: Unravelling the Predictors of Catastrophic Multi-Vehicle Collisions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it involved the retrospective analysis of de-identified, secondary data from the National Traffic Accident Database (NTAD) . The research was conducted in accordance with the ethical standards of the institutional research committee and the 1964 Helsinki Declaration.
declarations.funderStatement: For your SSRN submission, you can use these standard academic statements. Since your study is a retrospective analysis of an existing national database, the requirements are straightforward. Funder Statement This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was supported by AN Holdings Co.

detail.abstract: Sudden fatal health events in drivers are a critical road safety concern that can lead to devastating multi-vehicle collisions (MVCs). This study identifies key predictors that escalate a driver's sudden incapacitation into an MVC. We conducted a retrospective cohort study using a national traffic accident database from 2015-2024, analysing 1,258 incidents caused by a driver's sudden medical event. A binary logistic regression model was used to assess variables including road type, vehicle type, speed, and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS). Results showed that 32.8% of incidents became MVCs. Crashes on highways were over three times more likely to result in an MVC (OR = 3.12), as were those involving heavy vehicles (OR = 2.58) and higher initial speeds (OR = 1.45). Conversely, vehicles equipped with ADAS showed a significantly lower likelihood of causing an MVC (OR = 0.61). We conclude that the transition to an MVC is not random but is dictated by predictable factors, primarily high-speed highway environments and heavy vehicle involvement. The protective effect of ADAS highlights a critical avenue for technological intervention.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析2015-2024年1258起驾驶员突发健康事件导致的交通事故，发现32.8%会升级为多车碰撞。高速公路、重型车辆和高速行驶显著增加多车碰撞风险，而ADAS系统则能有效降低风险。
AI.research_question: 驾驶员突发健康事件导致的事故中，哪些关键因素会使其升级为多车碰撞？
AI.motivation: 驾驶员突发健康事件是严重的道路安全问题，可能导致灾难性的多车碰撞事故，了解其升级机制对预防措施至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于事故因果链理论，研究驾驶员突发健康事件如何通过特定环境因素（道路类型、车辆类型、速度等）升级为多车碰撞。
AI.method: 采用回顾性队列研究设计，使用2015-2024年全国交通事故数据库，分析1258起驾驶员突发健康事件导致的事故。使用二元逻辑回归模型评估道路类型、车辆类型、速度和ADAS系统等变量。
AI.findings: 32.8%的驾驶员突发健康事件升级为多车碰撞。高速公路事故多车碰撞风险增加3.12倍，重型车辆增加2.58倍，高速行驶增加1.45倍。配备ADAS系统的车辆多车碰撞风险降低39%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别了驾驶员突发健康事件升级为多车碰撞的关键预测因素，建立了从个体健康事件到群体事故的转化机制理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高风险环境（高速公路、重型车辆）制定针对性安全措施提供依据；证明ADAS系统的保护作用，支持技术干预策略；为驾驶员健康监测和道路安全政策提供实证基础。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Firm-Level Productivity: Early Evidence from a Small Open Economy
affiliations: Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI) Dublin and Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI)

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Firm-Level Productivity: Early Evidence from a Small Open Economy
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a modern general-purpose technology (GPT) with the potential to enhance the productivity of firms in every sector of the economy. Notwithstanding the growing interest in AI as a new source of productivity growth, evidence on firm-level productivity gains from using AI is scarce. This paper contributes to filling this evidence gap using firm-level data from Ireland over 2013-2024. By leveraging a Local Projection Difference-in-Differences framework and Propensity Score Matching, we find that, at this early stage, on average, the productivity gains from AI adoption are small, delayed, and short-lived in time. However, the heterogeneity analysis reveals more substantial, immediate, and persistent effects for firms that use AI for specific purposes, particularly in marketing, business administration, and ICT security as well as for those adopting technologies that automate workflows or assist in decision-making, such as robotic process automation (RPA) .

AI.tldr: 该研究使用爱尔兰2013-2024年企业层面数据，通过局部投影双重差分法和倾向得分匹配发现：在AI应用的早期阶段，企业采用AI带来的生产率提升平均较小、延迟且短暂；但异质性分析显示，将AI用于特定目的（如营销、行政管理、ICT安全）以及采用自动化工作流程或辅助决策技术（如RPA）的企业，其生产率提升更显著、更及时且更持久。
AI.research_question: 企业采用人工智能（AI）是否以及如何影响其生产率？AI采用带来的生产率提升在不同应用场景和技术类型下是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: AI作为现代通用技术（GPT）有潜力提升各行业企业的生产率，但关于企业层面AI采用带来生产率提升的实际证据仍然稀缺。本研究旨在填补这一证据空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通用技术理论（GPT）、技术创新扩散理论、生产率分析框架、异质性企业理论。
AI.method: 使用爱尔兰2013-2024年企业层面数据，采用局部投影双重差分法（Local Projection Difference-in-Differences）和倾向得分匹配（Propensity Score Matching）进行因果推断分析。
AI.findings: 1. 在AI应用的早期阶段，企业采用AI带来的平均生产率提升较小、延迟且短暂；2. 异质性分析显示：将AI用于特定目的（营销、行政管理、ICT安全）的企业，其生产率提升更显著、更及时且更持久；3. 采用自动化工作流程或辅助决策技术（如RPA）的企业同样获得更明显的生产率提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为AI作为通用技术的生产率效应提供了早期实证证据；2. 揭示了AI采用效果的时间动态特征（延迟且短暂）；3. 识别了AI应用场景和技术类型的异质性效应，丰富了技术创新扩散理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业决策者提供指导：AI投资应聚焦于特定应用场景（如营销、行政管理、ICT安全）；2. 建议优先采用自动化工作流程和辅助决策技术（如RPA）；3. 政策制定者可针对不同AI应用类型设计差异化的支持政策。

title: Art Prices, Disparities, and Cultural Leadership
affiliations: Maastricht University - Department of Finance

detail.title: Art Prices, Disparities, and Cultural Leadership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no funding.

detail.abstract: This article explores the development and dynamics of investment in the arts, focusing on how persistent disparities in income and wealth lead to changes in art auction sales prices. The paper provides a framework which provides guidance for cultural leaders as a response to these disparities. Using auction sales data collected from both auction house catalogues and from Artnet, from 1909 until 2024, the analysis first reveals significant disparities in the art market. Secondly, building upon scholarship in the field of cultural economics and art investment, we develop a theoretical model where changing income and wealth inequality mechanically amplifies art price movements, generating both booms and fragility in art market cycles. Using long-run art market indices, we find empirical support for the model. Demand for art is concentrated among the super-rich, and changes in income and wealth inequality drive changes in art price indices. Thirdly, the results provide a guiding framework for cultural leaders as a response to addressing disparities as a risk management tool for arts management.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了艺术投资的发展与动态，重点关注收入和财富不平等如何影响艺术品拍卖价格。研究发现艺术市场需求高度集中于超级富豪群体，收入财富不平等的变化会放大艺术品价格波动，导致市场繁荣与脆弱性并存。研究为文化领导者提供了应对不平等风险的管理框架。
AI.research_question: 收入和财富不平等如何影响艺术品拍卖价格的动态变化？艺术市场中的价格波动与不平等变化之间存在怎样的机制关系？
AI.motivation: 艺术市场中存在显著的财富和收入不平等现象，这些不平等如何影响艺术品价格波动和市场周期，对文化管理和艺术投资具有重要意义。理解这些机制有助于文化领导者更好地管理市场风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文化经济学和艺术投资领域的学术研究，构建理论模型：收入和财富不平等的变化会机械地放大艺术品价格波动，导致艺术市场周期中出现繁荣与脆弱性并存的现象。
AI.method: 使用1909年至2024年的拍卖数据，来源包括拍卖行目录和Artnet。首先分析艺术市场中的不平等现象，然后构建理论模型，最后使用长期艺术市场指数进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 1. 艺术市场存在显著的不平等现象；2. 艺术需求高度集中于超级富豪群体；3. 收入和财富不平等的变化驱动艺术品价格指数的变化；4. 不平等变化会放大价格波动，导致市场繁荣与脆弱性并存。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了收入财富不平等与艺术品价格波动之间的理论联系机制；2. 解释了艺术市场周期中繁荣与脆弱性并存的成因；3. 拓展了文化经济学中关于不平等影响艺术市场的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为文化领导者提供了应对不平等的风险管理和决策框架；2. 帮助艺术管理者将不平等视为风险因素进行管理；3. 为艺术投资决策提供了基于不平等动态的分析工具。

reference: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Forthcoming; Agribusiness, 0[10.1002/agr.70076]
title: Household-Level Food Price Inflation Heterogeneity: Evidence and Insights from the U.S. Consumer Panel Data (2013-2023)
affiliations: University of Minnesota

detail.title: Household-Level Food Price Inflation Heterogeneity: Evidence and Insights from the U.S. Consumer Panel Data (2013-2023)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Agribusiness, 0[10.1002/agr.70076]

detail.abstract: This paper investigates heterogeneity in household-level food price inflation in the United States from 2013 to 2023 using scanner data from the NielsenIQ Consumer Panel. By combining prices paid and quantities purchased, we compute household-specific inflation rates and document substantial variation in inflation experiences across U.S. households-variation that widened sharply during the post-pandemic inflation surge. Inflation inequality is especially pronounced among low-income, older, single-person, Asian, Black, and SNAP-eligible households, who faced higher food inflation than other demographic groups. We further analyze the behavioral mechanisms households use to mitigate inflation exposure, showing that strategies such as increasing shopping frequency, visiting multiple retailers, and purchasing products on sale are associated with lower inflation exposure. However, the strength of these strategies declined during the recent high-inflation period. We also find strong evidence of substitution toward lower-priced products as households adjust to rising prices. Finally, we discuss the managerial implications of these findings for food retailers and agribusiness firms, highlighting how pricing, promotions, and product assortment strategies can be tailored to support consumers facing disproportionate inflation burdens. In general, our results highlight the role of household-level heterogeneity in understanding the unequal burden of inflation and its managerial implications for agribusiness retailers.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2013-2023年美国尼尔森消费者面板数据，发现家庭层面的食品通胀存在显著异质性，低收入、老年人、单身、亚裔、黑人和SNAP资格家庭面临更高通胀。家庭通过增加购物频率、多店购物、购买促销品等策略缓解通胀压力，但这些策略在高通胀时期效果减弱。研究还发现强烈的向低价产品替代行为。
AI.research_question: 美国家庭层面的食品价格通胀存在怎样的异质性？哪些人口群体面临更高的通胀负担？家庭采用哪些行为策略来缓解通胀压力？这些策略在高通胀时期效果如何？
AI.motivation: 传统通胀指标（如CPI）反映的是平均通胀水平，但不同家庭的实际通胀体验可能存在显著差异。理解这种异质性对于评估通胀的不平等影响以及为面临更高通胀负担的家庭提供政策支持至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论和价格理论，研究家庭层面的通胀异质性及其决定因素。结合人口统计学特征（收入、年龄、种族等）分析通胀不平等，并探讨家庭应对通胀的行为机制。
AI.method: 使用2013-2023年尼尔森IQ消费者面板的扫描数据，结合支付价格和购买数量计算家庭特定通胀率。采用统计分析方法量化通胀异质性，识别高通胀风险群体，并分析家庭应对策略与通胀暴露的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭食品通胀存在显著异质性，疫情期间通胀差异扩大；2. 低收入、老年人、单身、亚裔、黑人和SNAP资格家庭面临更高通胀；3. 增加购物频率、多店购物、购买促销品等策略与较低通胀暴露相关；4. 这些策略在高通胀时期效果减弱；5. 家庭强烈转向低价产品替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了家庭层面通胀异质性的实证证据；2. 识别了通胀不平等的人口统计学模式；3. 揭示了家庭应对通胀的行为机制及其在不同通胀环境下的有效性变化；4. 拓展了消费者行为理论在通胀环境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为食品零售商和农业企业提供定价、促销和产品组合策略建议，以支持面临不成比例通胀负担的消费者；2. 为政策制定者设计针对性通胀缓解措施提供依据；3. 帮助企业理解不同消费者群体的通胀体验差异，优化市场策略。

title: Executive Judgment Under Complexity
affiliations: University of Charleston

detail.title: Executive Judgment Under Complexity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial relationships with people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this paper.

detail.abstract: Complex environments require leaders to make quick decisions that often lead to the conflation of decision-making and judgment (Tichy & Bennis, 2007). This paper demonstrates that these terms are separate by showing that decision-making is a momentary action, and judgment emerges as a developmental capacity expressed over time (Tichy & Bennis, 2007; Useem, 2010). Viewing judgment through the lens of complexity (Boulton et al., 2015; Wheatley, 2006), this paper further argues that judgment is not simply a skill, but instead is a capacity developed over time through enhancing sensemaking (Ancona, 2012), dialogue (Bohm, 2004), and suspension (Isaacs, 1999). Together, these capacities work together to surface biases and raise awareness of competing interpretations, all while holding tensions long enough for judgment to emerge. By distinguishing judgment from decision-making and showing how sensemaking, dialogue, and suspension support the development of judgment, this paper demonstrates that effective leadership under complexity depends less on the speed of decisions and more on cultivating judgment over time.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文区分了决策与判断，认为决策是瞬时行动，而判断是随时间发展的能力。在复杂环境中，有效领导力不取决于决策速度，而在于通过意义建构、对话和悬置来培养判断力。
AI.research_question: 在复杂环境中，领导者的判断与决策有何区别？如何培养有效的判断能力？
AI.motivation: 复杂环境要求领导者快速决策，但往往导致决策与判断的混淆。需要澄清这两个概念的区别，并探索如何在复杂环境中培养有效的判断能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂性理论（Boulton et al., 2015; Wheatley, 2006）；判断与决策理论（Tichy & Bennis, 2007）；意义建构（Ancona, 2012）；对话理论（Bohm, 2004）；悬置概念（Isaacs, 1999）
AI.method: 理论分析论文，通过文献综述和概念分析来区分决策与判断，并构建判断能力发展的理论框架。
AI.findings: 决策是瞬时行动，判断是随时间发展的能力。判断能力通过意义建构、对话和悬置三个相互关联的能力发展而来，这些能力共同作用以揭示偏见、提高对竞争性解释的意识，并在张力中保持足够长时间让判断浮现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 清晰区分了决策与判断的概念；2. 提出了判断作为能力而非技能的理论框架；3. 建立了意义建构、对话和悬置作为判断发展关键要素的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为领导者提供培养判断能力的具体方法；2. 强调复杂环境中领导力发展应注重判断而非决策速度；3. 为领导力培训项目提供理论指导。

title: When Does Responsible AI Attract Investors? Technology, Institutional, and Ecosystem Boundaries in Healthcare AI Ventures
affiliations: University of Cambridge and University of Cambridge

detail.title: When Does Responsible AI Attract Investors? Technology, Institutional, and Ecosystem Boundaries in Healthcare AI Ventures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participant
declarations.funderStatement: Cambridge Trust

detail.abstract: Responsible artificial intelligence (RAI) is increasingly advocated as a design principle for socially beneficial innovation, yet whether RAI orientation creates tangible value in entrepreneurial finance remains unclear. Drawing on signal theory, we examine how RAI orientation affects investor syndication in healthcare AI ventures and how this relationship is contingent on technology, institutional, and ecosystem contexts. Analysing 1,123 investment deals in healthcare AI/ML clinical software ventures sourced from a leading private capital market database, we employ a two-way fixed-effects framework with sub-region and year fixed effects. We find that RAI orientation is positively associated with investor syndication (β = 0.191, p < 0.05), supporting its role as a credibility-enhancing signal under information asymmetry. However, this baseline effect is moderated by three contextual boundaries. First, generative AI capability substitutes for the RAI signal, reducing its value (β =-0.402, p < 0.01). Second, developed-market institutions crowd out the RAI signal (β =-0.215, p < 0.01), consistent with institutional substitution. Third, location in a US technology hub amplifies the RAI signal (β = 0.278, p < 0.01), reflecting ecosystem-level certification. Marginal effect analysis reveals that the RAI signal is most valued in emerging-market, non-generative-AI contexts (+0.191) and in technology hub ecosystems (+0.253), but is redundant in developed non-hub settings (-0.024, n.s.) and penalised in generative AI ventures (-0.211). These findings contribute to the socially responsible AI ecosystems literature by demonstrating that investor responses to RAI are not universal but are shaped by the socio-technical and institutional environment in which ventures operate.

AI.tldr: 研究负责任人工智能（RAI）导向如何影响医疗AI初创企业的投资者联合投资，发现RAI作为可信度增强信号在信息不对称下能促进联合投资，但这种效应受到生成AI能力、发达市场制度和科技中心生态系统的调节。
AI.research_question: RAI导向如何影响医疗AI初创企业的投资者联合投资？这种关系如何受到技术、制度和生态系统环境的调节？
AI.motivation: 虽然RAI被提倡为社会有益创新的设计原则，但RAI导向是否在创业融资中创造实际价值尚不清楚，特别是在医疗AI领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论：RAI导向作为可信度增强信号，在信息不对称环境下影响投资者决策。
AI.method: 分析1,123个医疗AI/ML临床软件初创企业的投资交易数据，采用双向固定效应模型（子区域和年份固定效应）。
AI.findings: 1. RAI导向与投资者联合投资正相关（β=0.191, p<0.05）；2. 生成AI能力替代RAI信号（β=-0.402, p<0.01）；3. 发达市场制度挤出RAI信号（β=-0.215, p<0.01）；4. 美国科技中心位置增强RAI信号（β=0.278, p<0.01）。RAI信号在非生成AI的新兴市场环境中最有价值，在科技中心生态系统中价值增强，但在发达非中心环境中变得冗余，在生成AI初创企业中甚至受到惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将信号理论应用于RAI研究；2. 揭示投资者对RAI的反应不是普遍的，而是由社会技术和制度环境塑造；3. 识别RAI信号的三个情境边界（技术、制度、生态系统）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医疗AI初创企业提供融资策略建议：在特定情境下强调RAI导向；2. 为投资者提供评估框架：考虑RAI信号在不同环境中的价值差异；3. 为政策制定者提供启示：在不同市场环境中推广RAI的差异化策略。

title: Deep Learning Projects Jurisdiction of New and Proposed Clean Water Act Regulation
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley, Yale University and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Deep Learning Projects Jurisdiction of New and Proposed Clean Water Act Regulation

publicationDetails.detailsText: []
NBER Working Paper No. w34947
publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Projecting the effects of proposed policy reforms is challenging because no outcome data exist for regulations that governments have not yet implemented. We propose an ex ante deep learning framework that can project effects of proposed reforms by mapping outcomes observed under past regulations onto the legal criteria of proposed future policies (i.e., by “relabeling”). We apply this framework to study changes in jurisdiction of the US Clean Water Act (CWA). We compare our ex ante deep learning projection of jurisdiction under the Supreme Court’s Sackett decision against widely used projections from domain experts. Ex ante machine learning generates exceptional performance improvements over the leading domain expert model that the US Environmental Protection Agency currently uses, with 65 times more accurate identification of jurisdictional sites. We also develop an ex post deep learning model trained with data after policy implementation. Ex post deep learning performs best. Sackett deregulates one-third of all previously regulated US waters, particularly floodplains and pristine fish habitats, totaling 700,000 deregulated stream miles and 17 million deregulated wetland acres. Deep learning can effectively project consequences of far-reaching regulatory reforms before they are implemented, when projections are both most uncertain and most useful.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的先验预测框架，用于评估尚未实施的政策改革效果，并将其应用于美国《清洁水法案》管辖权变化的研究中。该方法通过"重新标记"技术，将过去法规下的观测结果映射到未来政策的法律标准上，相比专家模型实现了65倍的准确性提升。
AI.research_question: 如何在没有实施数据的情况下，准确预测拟议政策改革的效果？具体而言，如何预测美国《清洁水法案》管辖权在最高法院Sackett裁决下的变化？
AI.motivation: 预测拟议政策改革效果具有挑战性，因为尚未实施的法规没有结果数据。当前依赖领域专家预测的方法存在不确定性，需要更准确、数据驱动的方法来支持政策决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的政策效果预测框架，采用"重新标记"技术将历史法规下的观测结果映射到未来政策的法律标准上，建立先验预测模型。
AI.method: 开发了两种深度学习模型：1）先验深度学习模型，使用政策实施前的数据进行训练；2）后验深度学习模型，使用政策实施后的数据进行训练。将两种模型应用于美国《清洁水法案》管辖权变化的研究，并与美国环保署当前使用的领域专家模型进行比较。
AI.findings: 1）先验深度学习模型比美国环保署当前使用的领域专家模型准确65倍；2）后验深度学习模型表现最佳；3）Sackett裁决使美国三分之一的水域解除管制，包括70万英里的溪流和1700万英亩的湿地，主要影响洪泛区和原始鱼类栖息地。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个创新的先验深度学习框架，能够在政策实施前预测改革效果，填补了政策评估方法论的空白，为政策分析提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了更准确的政策效果预测工具；2）揭示了Sackett裁决对水域管制的具体影响；3）展示了深度学习在政策分析中的实际应用价值，特别是在政策实施前这一最不确定但最有用的阶段。
